play_as: * Anti-nades are more impactful than healing nades. Even when you need to heal an ally, try to get an enemy with the splash damage of Biotic Nade.
* Scoping makes Ana an easy target. Only ADS when you need the extra precision to land shots and spend most of your time unscoped.
* Nano allies who are already in position to easily attack the enemy. If the enemy can stay away from your Nano’d ally, the ult gets completely wasted.
play_against: * Sleep Dart is Ana’s primary means of survival. If you see her shoot it or sleep an ally, that is your signal to go attack her.
* When playing Tank or any dive hero, you’ll need to play around anti-nades. Try to predict her timing and use your mitigation or evade ability to make sure you don’t get anti-healed.

* Don’t overcommit to trying to kill her Tank if she hasn’t used Nano in a while. After you use up your cooldowns trying to get the kill, she’ll Nano the Tank, and their counterattack will be too much for you to survive.
specific_counters_81: ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma

* Sigma’s shield and Kinetic Grasp absorb every single one of Ana’s abilities. The best move for Sigma against an Ana is usually to push his shield between the Ana and the rest of her team. Doing so forces her to reposition since her poke damage is too low to quickly break the shield. Ana has very few counterplay options against Sigma as he can predict when Sleep and Nade will be used and block their effects.
![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)Sombra
* Sombra is one of the easiest heroes to consistently harass and eliminate Ana with. Stealth → Hack → Virus → shoot, wipes Ana and makes it very difficult to reactively Sleep Sombra.
![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

* Protection Suzu instantly cleanses Ana’s best abilities: Sleep and Nade. Suzu even cleanses Ana’s primary fire damage over time and can save a hero just before they lose health. Kiriko also tends to win in 1v1 duels against Ana because she can get in, Suzu, then TP out after getting the kill.
team_comp_synergies: The combination of high healing output and high impact abilities, but also being easy to eliminate, means Ana needs a team that can keep her alive. She can pair great with any team comp, but needs an ally dedicated to peeling for her when being focused. In dive comps, she’s often paired with a Brig to keep her alive against the dive. For poke and brawl comps, she’ll be best paired with Baptiste or Lucio to keep her alive.

strengths.title: Fight-winning abilities
content: Ana’s greatest strength lies in the potential power of Biotic Nade, Sleep Dart, and Nano Boost. Each of these abilities can single-handedly decide the outcome of a team fight. Sleeping an enemy during their ult can prevent a loss, landing the anti-heal on an aggressive tank stops them in their tracks, and a well-timed Nano can teamwipe. The difficulty of doing these things, however, is extremely high. Knowing when to use these abilities, then properly aiming and landing them, and on the right target are all difficult split-second decisions.

strengths.title: Balanced damage and healing
content: As opposed to most Supports, Ana provides her team with high amounts of damage and healing. Both Biotic Nade and Rifle can be used either defensively or offensively. Depending on what her team needs, she can focus on dealing damage or pumping her allies with healing.

strengths.title: Long Range support
content: Ana is the only true sniper Support. She possesses the sole ability to sit in the back of the map area while still providing max value. This also favors her in dive compositions because even though she lacks any mobility, she doesn’t need to physically follow an ally to enable them as they flank or dive the enemy squishies.

weaknesses.title: Low survivability
content: Ana has very poor survivability. If she is isolated, she almost always loses 1v1 duels and has no way to deal with multiple threats simultaneously. Even if she sleeps an enemy flanker, she still struggles to kill them on her own upon waking up. Her best move is often to sleep, then run away.

weaknesses.title: High skill floor and ceiling
content: To get even basic value out of Ana, the player needs to be quite mechanically skilled. Genjis know better than any as they’ll jump around mashing “I need healing!” while accidentally dodging every healing shot from their Ana. Although Sleep Dart shuts down just about every ability in the game, its slow projectile speed and long cooldown make it difficult to use efficiently. Landing Anti-nades also often ends without any follow-up since your team only has 3 seconds of no healing to take advantage of.

weaknesses.title: No mobility
content: Ana's biggest weakness is her lack of mobility. OW has been steadily moving more and more towards a mobility meta game. There is no way for Ana to access high ground, escape from an enemy attack, or quickly reposition herself to follow up on her own team's aggression.

* When playing Tank or any dive hero, you’ll need to play around anti-nades. Try to predict her timing and use your mitigation or evade ability to make sure you don’t get anti-healed.

* Don’t overcommit to trying to kill her Tank if she hasn’t used Nano in a while. After you use up your cooldowns trying to get the kill, she’ll Nano the Tank, and their counterattack will be too much for you to survive.

minor.title: Groggy
content: * Best against dive
* * Ana is always a dive priority target, so anything that helps her counter their attacks is huge for her viability.
* The extra damage and slow debuff is basically a guaranteed kill against any hero without an invincible escape tool.
* Shutdown enemy ults
* * Sleep is already one of the best ability counters to ults in Overwatch, but the added slow can give your team the extra space they need to avoid the enemy ult after they awake.
* Ex: Ram ulting at your team, Ana Sleeps him, and by the time he wakes up, then slow walks, your team can get out of his AoE and end his ult early.
minor.name: Groggy
minor.description: Enemies waking up from Sleep Dart are slowed and take 50 damage for 2 seconds.

minor.title: Speed Serum
content: * Best when aggressive Nano targets like Reinhardt who struggle to chase down retreating enemies.
* If you absolutely need to, you can Nano the nearest or easiest target just to give yourself the speed boost if you will die otherwise.
minor.name: Speed Serum
minor.description: Nano Boost grants a 40% movement speed boost to both Ana and her target.

major.title: Headhunter
content: * Just to flex
* * Refer to the _“Tips for Biotic Rifle”_ section, and you’ll see ADS shots against enemies have a significantly decreased bullet size. This makes landing headshots with Ana quite difficult.
* Additionally, the multiplier is only 1.5x, so the return isn’t that great.

* Head hurtboxes are mostly hidden when looking at the backs of heroes, and you’ll essentially always be looking at the backs of your teammates. Consequently, critical hits on allies are also impractical.
major.name: Headhunter
major.description: Biotic Rifle can crit enemies.

major.title: Biotic Bounce
content: * Win button
* * Although the damage and healing are reduced on the 2nd bounce, the anti and heal buffs are the same.
* Potentially, Ana can hit the enemy frontline with the first bounce, then mid or back enemies with the second bounce. Anti-healing on a majority of the enemy team
* Hitting a nade into a wall next to or behind a target is also a very effective means of hitting tricky angles.
major.name: Biotic Bounce
major.description: After exploding, Biotic Grenade bounces and explodes again for 60 damage and healing.

minor.name: Double-Barreled
minor.description: Knocking an enemy back with Coach Gun briefly allows it to be used again with 25% reduced knockback.

major.title: Viper's Sting
content: * Best poke Perk
* * The extra damage is very powerful on maps with long sight lines. The bonus damage is also not affected by falloff, so the extra 25 damage keeps its effectiveness at all ranges.

* Also useful for pressure ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks as landing two shots in a row is very easy on their large bodies.
* Bonus damage reset
* * The “consecutive scoped shots” reset after every hit, 2 scoped shots, when missing a scoped shot, or after 3 seconds of no shots.
* Hip fire shots do not affect Viper’s Sting’s counter.
major.name: Viper's Sting
major.description: Hitting 2 consecutive scoped shots on a target deals 25 extra damage and reloads 1 ammo.

major.title: Airburst
content: * Best anti-brawl Perk
* * When the enemy team plays as a deathball, the larger AoE will help you burn more targets with each use.

* Increase ![](/data/assets/guide/6d41bdb3da6b2de8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-viper.png)The Viper uptime

* * Even if you don’t hit any targets with ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite, every time ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe shoots it out of the air, she reloads 3 ammo. This helps her reduce reload time and increases the time she spends firing.

* Don’t pick against a ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

* * The increased AoE is essentially negated by ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu. Remember Suzu heals extra when cleansing effects like Burning, so you’ll be feeding her a lot of Ult charge.
major.name: Airburst
major.description: Dynamite has a 40% increased detonation radius while airborne and refunds 3 ammo when thrown.

play_as: * Multitask healing and damage. Don’t tunnel vision on only healbotting or only attacking, and forget to keep your team alive.
* Be patient with Immortality Field. Wait for the enemy to commit their abilities and ultimates before deploying it.
* Don’t sit still. Use Exo Boots to take high ground, fall to safety, and jump back up to the fight.
play_against: * Don’t commit long cooldowns or ultimates until after you’ve seen him use Immortality Field. Try to attack with your standard attacks or short CDs, retreat, then re-engage after he’s used it.
* Watch his jumps, and track him in the air. He’s easiest to elim while he’s locked in the jump arc.
* His primary fire has severe damage falloff. Keep your distance and take him down with heroes like Ana, Kiri, and Widowmaker.
team_comp_synergies: Team comps built around Baptiste can take full advantage of his superior AoE sustain abilities. Biotic Launcher healing, Regenerative Burst, and Immortality get the most value when used in teams that tend to position close together. He has difficulty healing small and highly mobile heroes. Although he has excellent vertical mobility, he can’t keep up with flankers and dive heroes who quickly engage the enemy.

strengths.title: DPS Support
content: As far as Supports go, Bap has some of the best offense. His damage output is on par with some DPS heroes. If you feel your team is lacking damage, swapping to Bap can make up for it without sacrificing sustain.

strengths.title: Immortality Field
content: Just having an ability that makes everyone in its AoE unkillable is a power of gigantic proportions. The use of Immortality Field can control the pace of fights and determine when the enemy team can get elims.

strengths.title: AoE and Burst Healing
content: Bap is unique in having great single-target, AoE, and burst healing. Whether the enemy team is focusing one ally or his whole team is taking damage, Bap has no trouble providing the sustain needed.

weaknesses.title: Long Cooldowns
content: The primary and most exploitable weakness of his kit is that both his cooldowns are on long timers. When trading Regen Burst or Immortality Field with enemy abilities, they will generally have their abilities to use again long before Bap has his.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable against dive comps
content: Enemy Tanks like D.Va and Winston, or DPS like Venture and Tracer, see Bap as an easy pick. He can make up for this a bit later in a game with Rocket Boots Major Perk and make avoiding their attacks easier.

weaknesses.title: Exo Boots are a two-edged sword
content: Jumping over a wall and blasting the enemy makes for some cool aggro play, but anytime Bap jumps, it's like painting a huge target on his face. Depending on the enemy comp and specific situation, jumping or staying grounded may be the better play, and it can be difficult to know which to choose.

play_against_summary: * Don’t commit long cooldowns or ultimates until after you’ve seen him use Immortality Field. Try to attack with your standard attacks or short CDs, retreat, then re-engage after he’s used it.
* Watch his jumps, and track him in the air. He’s easiest to elim while he’s locked in the jump arc.
* His primary fire has severe damage falloff. Keep your distance and take him down with heroes like Ana, Kiri, and Widowmaker.

minor.title: Expanded Field
content: Makes Barrier Field tosses much more consistent and forgiving. The AoE is huge, so even if your placement isn’t perfect, you have a much higher chance of getting yourself and your teammates within the field.
minor.name: Expanded Field
minor.description: Immortality Field radius increased by 30%.

major.title: Automated Healing
content: * Nice to have for some extra healing. May not feel game-changing because his cooldowns are so long, but the extra 120 can make the difference of life and death for an ally.
major.name: Automated Healing
major.description: Using any ability triggers Baptiste's Shoulder Turret, periodically firing up to 3 shots at allies, each restoring 25 health.

major.title: Rocket Boots
content: * Strengthens Bap's biggest weakness
* * With only vertical mobility, Bap struggles against high mobility enemies. He just jumps up and gets destroyed mid-air. With Rocket Boots, he becomes significantly more evasive.
* Also comes in handy when jumping over barriers and walls, as you can mix up your movement and make it less likely to get sniped out of the air.
* The best choice, especially against dive comps.
major.name: Rocket Boots
major.description: While airborne from Exo Boots, use (SPACE) to dash horizontally.

strengths.title: Tank buster
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion is the best hero in all of Overwatch when it comes to deleting ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks. He can melt through a ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya bubble and kill her before she gets another or can run away. Many ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank players feel forced to swap to ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion-specific counters and off their mains. The team with ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion will always win the tank duel because his damage is too high to heal through without ults.

strengths.title: Tanky DPS
content: The most health in the DPS roster, armor health, passive damage reduction, and he hides his head hitbox behind him while in turret form. In standard modes, he also has access to two self-sustaining abilities. This survivability helps ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion be a good dive counter because dive heroes simply can’t kill him fast enough.

strengths.title: Area lockdown
content: Grenade, Assault mode, and Artillery ult all excel at taking control of areas and sight lines. Grenade’s large explosion radius forces enemies to run away, and the high damage of Assault mode makes standing in ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion's LoS too dangerous. Whenever the enemy is trying to contest the objective, his ult is excellent for blowing up anyone who wants to stay on point.

content: Turret form is a double edged sword. ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion deals high damage but moves very slowly which makes him easy to kill. Even after his size reduction in Season 17, he still has a larger hitbox than most non-Tank heroes. He has the survivability needed to make up for it, but he can also end up feeding enemy ult charge, and get burst down by projectiles.

Unless you combo with an allies stun, his ult is difficult to get kills with against many team comps.

minor.title: Armored Artillery
content: * Good against dive
* * When multiple heroes full dive you and you can’t run away, the overhealth can save your life and force the enemy to retreat.
* Activate ult and instantly drop one on your body and on your attackers. If allies are nearby, this should buy them enough time to peel for you.
minor.name: Armored Artillery
minor.description: Configuration: Artillery grants 300 temporary overhealth.

major.title: Lindholm Explosives
content: * Even better for pressuring backlines

* * The splash damage forces ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports not only to retreat, but also hide way behind cover where they won’t get hit by the splash damage. * * Against full dive comps, running these two perks give ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion the self-sustain required to survive dive attacks by multiple enemies simultaneously.
major.name: Self-Repair

When in range, use Flail to proc Inspire and save Whip Shot.
* Primarily use Shield Bash as a movement tool. Use it to either quickly advance on the enemy or escape to a safer position.

Brig is great at protecting her allies, so if everyone has a lot of their own survivability, she doesn’t bring her maximum value. strengths.title: Backline Protector
content: Brig specializes in keeping her fellow backliners safe from flanks and dives. Between her healing, a ranged knockback, and a Shield, Brig creates a second line of defense that the enemy must fight hard to break through. When paired with a high healing Support, Brig protects while the other Support pumps out endless healing.

strengths.title: AoE and ranged healing
content: While she doesn’t heal as quickly, she can heal indefinitely. Inspire and Rally have large AoE healing that the entire team can simultaneously benefit from, and Repair Packs are great for healing allies deep in enemy territory. Also, unlike many other Supports, Brig doesn’t have to swap between healing and damage.

strengths.title: 1v1 dueler
content: A Shield to block damage and high damage in close range makes her someone you do not want to end up in a 1v1 with. Other than Tanks, Brig can outduel any hero as long as she has a healthy Shield.

weaknesses.title: Brawl range, but squishy
content: Unlike early release Brig in the days of GOATS, the current Brig gets quickly punished for bad positioning and being overly aggressive. Her attacks have limited range, but if she tries to brawl with her Tank, she’ll get deleted.

weaknesses.title: Lacks burst healing
content: Aside from the tiny 25 instant health from Repair Pack, all of Brig's healing is slow. When an ally is on the verge of death, Brig is not the Support to heal them back to life. Be prepared for plenty of games where people ask you to swap because they think the answer is always, “more healing.”

weaknesses.title: Struggles against poke comps
content: Brig has very advantageous matchups, but she also has multiple hard counters. She can’t contribute anything to the poke phase of fights. She has a limited number of Repair Packs and would be much better off as any other Support if she’s gonna sit back and heal-bot. Also, there’s not much she can do on her own to counter poke comps, and she ends up spending most of the match hiding.

play_against_summary: * Poke. Brig can’t directly deal with poke damage, and it's a great way to pressure her Shield and keep her playing passively.

* Soft engage to get ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shotout, then use movement cooldowns when she can’t knock you away.
* Target her allies. Brig’s healing is pretty slow, so often the best strategy is to kill the rest of her team first, then her last.

minor.title: Combat Medic
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Keep an eye on your ![](/data/assets/guide/8053c37a257e8067.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frepair-pack.png)Repair Pack cooldowns when brawling. Try to not let it sit at 3 packs when you have the opportunity to swing on the enemy so that you can maximize the benefit and extra healing output.
* Good when the team needs extra healing
* * When you see the other Support struggling to keep your allies alive, Combat Medic is the way to go.
minor.name: Combat Medic
minor.description: Melee attacks reduce the cooldown of Repair Pack by 0.5 seconds.

minor.title: Morale Boost
content: * Pick when struggling to keep Inspire up.
* Whip Shot and Inspire

* * Inspire lasts four seconds, and ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot is a four-second cooldown. Therefore, if you land two Whip Shots in a row, you won’t even be benefiting from Morale Boost.
* If you find your Inspire uptime is low or are struggling to find consistent opportunities to proc Inspire, Morale Boost can be a good choice.
minor.name: Morale Boost
minor.description: Inspire lasts 3 seconds longer when activated by Whip Shot.

major.title: Inspiring Strike
content: * Movement
* * Bash movement is one of the most important tools Brig has in her arsenal. Gaining even movement speed buff just makes it that much stronger.
* Increased aggression
* * Brig can be more aggressive with her positiong when using Inspiring Strike because she can dive and rush down enemies faster, and disengage faster as well.
* The instant Inspire healing also makes her tankier in duels.
major.name: Inspiring Strike
major.description: Shield Bash grants 30% increased movement speed for 2 seconds. Inspire's healing is instant when activated by Shield Bash.

major.title: Whiplash
content: * Situational, but clutch

* * You won’t be benefiting from wall damage every time you ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot, but when you do, the extra damage can secure kills or create the pressure needed to win the fight.
* Best on enclosed maps
* * Maps with lots of structures and walls give you more opportunities to line up wall slams.
* Try to strafe and line up enemies with any structure to get more wall slams in each game.
* Unique breakpoints
* * The extra 50 damage creates new “one-shot” combos against 225 and 275 HP heroes:
* 235 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Whip Shot-wall-slam
* 280 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Flail → Whip Shot-wall-slam
major.name: Whiplash
major.description: Whip Shot's knockback can slam enemies into walls, dealing 50 extra damage.

play_as: * Off angle. Don’t fall into the trap of standing in the center of the payload path or objective area. ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy is best when positioned around corners, attacking from the side of his team.
* Stay close. His revolver has severe damage falloff. Stay close to your targets to maximize your damage output.

If your hero has a way to block or dodge Flashbang, be sure to save it when getting into close range against a Cassidy.

* Watch for ![](/data/assets/guide/4c3fdbb733566161.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeadeye.png)Deadeye. If you don’t see Cassidy for a bit, he’s likely setting up a flank Deadeye. Stay near cover; you can hide behind it or prepare your counterattack.
team_comp_synergies: Team comps built around Cassidy push into the enemy team in stages. Because he lacks mobility and has harsh damage falloff, Cassidy pairs best with teams who keep the fights in close to medium ranges. Tanks that repeatedly contest space by soft engaging, then reengaging, enable Cassidy to position up front with them and keep more enemies in his ideal primary fire range. All he really needs from Supports is reliable healing because he tends to take more damage than the average DPS hero. His damage output is extremely high, so he looks for utility and sustain from his allies.

strengths.title: Anti-flanker
content: Cassidy is one of the best DPS for countering flanking enemies. His combination of burst damage and CC from Flashbang makes him extremely dangerous to dive. He’s also great at protecting his supports from enemy DPS like Sombra and Tracer.

strengths.title: Consistent burst damage
content: Unlike other DPS, whose burst damage comes from cooldowns, Cassidy can burst the enemy at any given moment. Two headshots eliminate 275 HP heroes in a single second! Fan the Hammer is also always a threat of burst damage at very close range.

strengths.title: Versatile offense
content: Depending on the enemy team's comp and his own, Cassidy can adapt his positioning and playstyle to best fit the situation. He can be a Tank buster, anti-dive, anti-flier, a backline assassin, or just hold down the main choke point.

weaknesses.title: Poor mobility
content: The biggest difference between Cassidy and most DPS is his complete lack of mobility. He’s the least mobile DPS in the entire OW roster. He can’t take high ground, chase down targets, or escape attacks. If the whole team is trying to reposition, Cassidy either stays behind or is the last to arrive.

weaknesses.title: Inconsistent Ult value
content: Many DPS ults feel like “win buttons.” Deadeye, on the other hand, sometimes gets used just to reload his revolver. Although it has the potential for team wipes, its value is far from guaranteed.

weaknesses.title: Limited Range
content: Compared to the rest of the ranged hitscan heroes, Cassidy has the worst range. He has the upper hand at close range, but needs to spend time and resources getting into position. Poking at long range is much easier and more consistent. Even projectile heroes like Pharah give him a lot of trouble on maps where she can stay far away while flying.

minor.title: Bang Bang
content: * New breakpoints
* * Landing both Flashbangs creates new instakill combos for Cassidy
* * Bang Bang + headshot = 230 Dmg (225HP hero one-shot)
* Best for anti-dive
* * Extra damage and range make Bang Bang the superior choice against enemy DPS and Support flankers.
minor.name: Bang Bang
minor.description: Cassidy throws a second Flashbang that travels farther, but both Flashbangs deal 40% reduced damage.

minor.title: Even the Odds
content: * Tank damage over time
* * In standard 5v5 games, Cassidy can generate up to 150 HP of self-healing every second. Even if there are only a couple of targets, the extra healing helps to survive against non-burst damage
* If the enemy is running Moira / Juno, for example, neither of them can burst or stun Cassidy, and he’s very likely to survive channeling Deadeye with the extra healing.
* When to avoid picking
* * If the enemy has easy ways of stopping Deadeye with stuns like Sleep Dart, or burst damage like Widow Maker, then the healing is not helpful.
minor.name: Even the Odds
minor.description: Regenerate 30 health per second for each enemy targeted by Deadeye.

major.title: Rollin' Round-Ups
content: Rollin' Round-Up
* As you should normally be using Roll to reload a full clip, you will naturally get a lot of sustain value from this perk.
major.name: Rollin' Round-Ups
major.description: Combat Roll heals 15 health for each bullet reloaded.

major.title: Silver Bullet
content: * Swap out the close-range burst for more min-range lethality.
* * Silver Bullet crit + plus primary fire body shot will kill 275 HP heroes
* The burst damage is quite good, but you have to sacrifice Fan the Hammer and the sustain Rollin' Round-Up would give you.
* Two Silver Bullet body shots will eliminate 275 HP heroes if the shots are spaced out.
* * Bleed does not stack. You'll need to wait between Silver Bullet shots if you want to maximize damage over time.
major.name: Silver Bullet
major.description: Peacekeeper's secondary fire is replaced with a piercing shot that inflicts bleeding. Combat Roll and Deadeye reset its cooldown.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The most distinct advantage ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va has over the rest of the Tanks is her ability to fly for 2 seconds, every 3 and a half seconds. She gets the most value from maps with extensive high-ground areas. Her damage is only effective at very short ranges, so maps with flat and open areas are bad for her. However, that doesn’t mean she wants to sit and brawl on the objective. Capture and Control points that are cramped don’t give her enough room to move around, and she’ll likely lose the face-to-face Tank battle.

play_as: * Be reactive. Use ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va's mobility to respond to where and who the enemy team is attacking.

* Peel and enable. ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix should be used to keep your backline alive and to protect your DPS during their attack.

Attacking ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va from multiple directions stops her from Matrixing all your team's damage.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va has no protection against beam and melee attacks. If you’re struggling, consider swapping to counter.

For her to deal meaningful damage, she needs to be point-blank right in the enemy's face. Because of this, ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va is often ran with dive heroes who suddenly collapse on a single target.

As a defender and enabler, ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va allows her ranged and hitscan allies to take aggressive positions while she protects them with her presence and Matrix.

* **Supports**: ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta, ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana

strengths.title: Low cooldown mobility
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)Boosters have the lowest cooldown of any Tank movement ability in OW. On top of that, they allow her to fly in any direction. ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va can quickly engage and then disengage, fly to defend her team, or fly to help her team secure an elim.

strengths.title: Defense Matrix
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix, being resource-based and not health points, means she can absorb infinite damage during its duration. She’s also the only Tank who can completely absorb ultimates like ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge and ![](/data/assets/guide/7578824db04164d2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblizzard.png)Blizzard. The power and versatility of ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix make ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va the best team enabler among tanks.

strengths.title: Burst damage
content: Up close, she has great burst damage when firing her shotguns and ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles together. When your team can’t seem to stop the enemy Supports, ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va can go in as the backline assassin and kill one before the rest of the enemy has time to react.

weaknesses.title: Terrible ranged damage
content: Anytime ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va isn’t right in the face of the enemy, her damage can pretty much be entirely ignored. The slow travel speed of ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles also causes them to be an unreliable source of ranged damage.

weaknesses.title: Directional damage mitigation
content: While some Tanks can block damage from multiple directions or large areas in front of them, ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va’s ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix is a cone-shaped straight in front of her. If you aren’t precise with ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix's aiming, you’ll waste the resource and not even absorb the damage you intended to. This also makes her struggle in the open because of crossfire.

weaknesses.title: Zoning Ult
content: In the lowest ranks, you may be able to get away with launching ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va bomb into the sky and getting random team wipes. Once you begin to climb, however, you’ll quickly find that players are good at hiding from ![](/data/assets/guide/182487a51a584671.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fself-destruct.png)Self-Destruct as it flies through the air.

The best use at higher ranks is often as a zoning tool. Only being able to force the enemies to walk away for a few seconds is much less impactful than stunning the entire team with ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)Earthshatter or Grav.

play_against_summary: * Create crossfire. Attacking ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va from multiple directions stops her from Matrixing all your team's damage.
* Stay together. Focus on keeping each other alive and forcing her to retreat. Every time she leaves close range, her value goes way down.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va has no protection against beam and melee attacks. If you’re struggling, consider swapping to counter.

minor.title: Bunny Power
content: * Safer Minor Perk

* * The extra health makes it way easier to survive long enough to remech. Enemies look to instantly kill pilot ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va when she ejects from her mech. Bunny Power helps her to tank those attacks.
minor.name: Bunny Power
minor.description: Eject grants 75 temporary overhealth and Call Mech's damage radius is increased by 50%.

minor.title: Extended Boosters
content: * Good for diving
* * When diving the enemy backline, you can Boosters through their Tank and any other enemies in the path to proc Extended Boosters.

* Chasing a ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy, for example, is much easier when you have more flight time.
* Numbers
* * Each boop deals 25 damage.
* Base Boosters have a 2-second duration. Hitting two enemies extends the duration by 50%.
minor.name: Extended Boosters
minor.description: Hitting an enemy with Boosters deals 40% increased damage and extends the duration by 0.5 seconds.

major.title: Shield System
content: * Increased self-sustain

* * Shield health moves to the front of ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va’s health pool and is damaged first.
* Matrix converting damage absorbed to recover lost shield health increases your survivability mid-fight.
major.name: Shield System
major.description: Convert 150 health to shields. Defense Matrix restores shields based on 25% of its damage absorbed.

major.title: Precision Fusion
content: * Best when you want to focus on offensive power and kill potential.
* Save for finishing blows instead of using it at the start of attacks.
major.name: Precision Fusion
major.description: Press Reload to reduce Fusion Cannons' Spread by 75% for 3 seconds.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist and his incredible mobility are best utilized on maps where teams tend to play spread out. The only thing he requires is natural cover to rotate around. ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist typically takes space in chunks so long sight lines and wide open areas are difficult for him. Tight areas with lots of walls and structures give him more opportunities for wall slams off ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch which greatly raises his overall impact. Additionally, his knockback is quite far so maps with nearby ledges give him the chance for environmental kills.

play_as: * Use your superior mobility to quickly get in and get out. ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist should constantly disrupt the enemy and get in the way of their attacks.

* Always save one ability (Punch, Slam, or Block) to survive or disengage from your dive. Dumping all three into a team with full health just results in ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist feeding.

* Track enemy stuns like ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, and either Slam Cancel Power Block to dodge or don’t Block unless you’ve already seen the stun used.
play_against: * While he’s blocking or charging ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, stun him. He’s sitting still, and cancelling his ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)Power Block is the best method for eliminating ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist.

* Dodge his engage attack. Keep track of ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist and watch for when he’s coming in with ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam or ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch. If you dodge his initial attack, he misses out on overhealth and will have to reset.

* To counter ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist, play heroes with stuns or high mobility heroes who can evade him. If you can’t run away or stun him, ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist will harass you all game.
team_comp_synergies: Ideal team comps built around ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist take advantage of his explosive playstyle. ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist's gameplay loop constantly shifts between engaging and disengaging. Heroes with similar styles or who have high value burst abilities are the best pairings.

Essentially, every ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist comp utilizes a dive playstyle that anchors on his attacks. Thanks to his block and bonus health, ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist is rather self sufficient so he doesn't demand a lot of healing resources which opens up more flexibility for Support pairings.

strengths.title: Hyper-mobile
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist has frequent mobility tools that he can use for both horizontal and vertical movement. Nowhere is safe from ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist. He can rapidly traverse the map, bypass the enemy frontline, or retreat to safety.

strengths.title: Crowd Control
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch is on a short 4-second cooldown and can be instantly refreshed by ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)Power Block. ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist has more frequent knockback than any other hero. He’s great at controlling space by repeatedly displacing the enemy.

strengths.title: Disruption
content: Even when ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist doesn’t get the kill, his presence is extremely disruptive. When he’s diving a hero or group of enemies, they have to use their cooldowns to counterattack. He takes up a lot of attention, and during that distracted time, the rest of his team has greater opportunities to make big plays of their own.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to stuns
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)Power Block has damage reduction, but Doom has no way of actually blocking stuns. During his channelled abilities, he’s barely moving and is an easy target. Since his best moves are movement-based, landing a stun on ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist shuts him down hard.

weaknesses.title: Melee hero
content: The main limiting factor of ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist's kit is that he is primarily a melee hero. ![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon gives him a bit of range and poke, but it’s more of a supplemental ability to increase the lethality of ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch and ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam. ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist has to get in super close, and that exposes him to a lot of danger.

weaknesses.title: High skill ceiling
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist is one of those heroes that only shines in the hands of a committed one-trick. If you are just casually playing ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist and he’s not your main, be prepared to have a lot of rough games. He has a multitude of hero-specific tech, and players need to have high game sense to read and track enemy resources.

* Dodge his engage attack. map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Echo’s quick movement and flying abilities are best utilized on maps with plenty of high ground and natural vertical cover. Peeking over walls, or air strafing around structures high in the air allow Echo to play more aggressively and do so more safely.
On flatter maps, as long as there are lots of side paths for flanking, Echo still performs great thanks to her silent footsteps and horizontal dashing. The maps that hinder her playstyle the most are the long range sniper maps where she has to expose herself down sightlines to approach the enemy. Echo also has difficulty on maps with large open objective areas and maps with too many small areas that hinder her movement.

strengths.title: Mobility
content: Flight and Glide give Echo nearly endless options for movement and positioning. She can outrun most attacks to stay alive, and she’s able to rush down enemies trying to get away. One unique quality of Echo’s mobility is that she can use Flight for vertical and horizontal dashing. Most heroes are limited to one or the other.

strengths.title: Versatile Ult
content: Being able to copy anyone on the enemy team means Echo can adapt her Ult usage to be offensive, defensive, zoning, tempo, or simply as a self-survival tool. Paired with Friendly Imaging, Echo can have up to 11 Duplicate choices in 6v6 game modes. Instantly gaining max HP and all the copy's cooldowns is very strong, plus when Duplicate ends, Echo will always have a minimum of 100 HP.

strengths.title: Burst damage
content: Sticky Bomb followed by Focusing Beam is a lethal combo against all DPS and Support heroes. Echo is great at finishing off enemies who think they are safe because of Focusing Beam and her mobility. Beam against critical health Tanks is one of the best abilities in the entire game to make sure those Tanks don’t get healed back up.

weaknesses.title: All or nothing cooldowns
content: Echo’s primary fire is not particularly strong, and when Beam is used on a target above 50% HP, the damage is very low. Sticky Bombs are also easy to miss due to their slow travel speed. You either are going to get massive or no value from her cooldowns. When Echo isn’t getting solo kills and final blows, she’s not contributing much to her team.

weaknesses.title: Ult hero pool
content: One major drawback to a copy Ult is that you have to achieve at least a base level proficiency with almost the entire cast of Overwatch 2. When the enemy team isn’t running a hero with an ult you want, or a hero in your main pool, you may struggle to do anything other than feed with her ult.

weaknesses.title: Glass Cannon
content: Echo’s lethality comes at the cost of low health and no defensive abilities. She dies quickly when exposed and has to play evasively if she wants to stay alive. When Flight is on cooldown, Echo is a sitting duck against dive heroes. Moreover, if the enemy runs more than two hitscans, staying in the air becomes a problem as Echo can’t sustain the damage.

content: * Install ults

* * A good use of starting with 50% ult charge is for copying heroes with install ultimates like ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage, ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation, ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade, ![](/data/assets/guide/74549b59ef18f026.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverclock.png)Overclock, etc.

* Prioritize earning ult
* * Partial Scan should be treated as a time extension as soon as you activate copy. Take some extra time to play safe, stay alive, and farm your copy's ult.
* Dying (copy ending) before getting ult completely wastes this Minor Perk selection.

major.title: Full Salvo
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Echo can benefit from Full Salvo every 6 seconds as compared to only benefitting from High Beams when specifically getting elims from Beam after using Flight.
* Extra burst damage
* * The math works out to roughly 30% more damage compared to regular Sticky Bombs.
* Full Salvo is more consistent at getting all DPS below half health for Focusing Beam combos (even those with high health and armor).
major.name: Full Salvo
major.description: Sticky Bombs fires 50% more projectiles.

major.title: High Beams
content: * Full aggro beam usage
* * Being able to use Flight twice in a row enables some crazy aggressive plays. You can Flight dive the backline, kill, fly to cover, wait for Beam, and assassinate another.
* Hard to rely on the reset

* * To fully benefit from the Flight reset, you’ll want to fly in deep, secure an elim with Beam, then fly away. However, if the enemy survives your beam, you are left with no cooldowns and a death sentence.
* You should be used to Flight management and not leaving yourself exposed after Focusing Beam use. Therefore, you’ll have to adjust your playstyle to benefit from the Flight reset.
major.name: High Beams
major.description: Focusing Beam eliminations reset Flight's cooldown.

play_as: * Target Supports. Genji’s primary function is assassinating backlines. Use your mobility to bypass the enemy frontline, get close to the Supports, and kill them first.

* Support players know to save ults like ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to counter Blade. If you suspect they have a defensive ult available, hold on to Blade until your team has forced out their ult.

* Force out ![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)Deflect by dealing damage with your standard weapon, then use your cooldown abilities to punish him when he doesn’t have it.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade is extremely lethal and can instantly win team fights. Plan how you will personally survive it, and how you can help your teammates survive with your healing, burst damage, or CC.
