First off, Genji can’t ![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)Deflect his ![](/data/assets/guide/6e13dbd3b63c0f90.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftesla-cannon.png)Tesla Cannon. Secondly, Winston can peel for teammates the enemy Genji is focusing and chase down Genji when he attempts to retreat. Lastly, if the Monke has insane juggle mechanics, ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage beats Dragonblade.
![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo

* Echo’s mobility is very different from Genji’s, but she has the tools to chase him down. At medium range, these two heroes are similarly matched, but ![](/data/assets/guide/9ecb1957f6f092f0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffocusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam goes through ![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)Deflect and melts a low HP Genji.

* Echo tends to provide superior value to her team throughout the match when comparing kits without Ults available. Playing Genji into Echo then gives her access to Dragonblade for her Copy, making Echo a devastating foe.
![](/data/assets/guide/df34545acaf615da.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbrigitte.png)Brigitte

* ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot alone interrupts Genji's entire game plan. ![](/data/assets/guide/2b083b4a4d737525.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-strike.png)Swift Strike gets shut down when used as an attack or mobility option when booped by Brig. She also sends out ![](/data/assets/guide/8053c37a257e8067.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frepair-pack.png)Repair Packs, which makes it extremely difficult for Genji to eliminate targets in her range. ![](/data/assets/guide/199388013619eeee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frally.png)Rally can also counter ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade by giving everyone armor, and if she lands her stun on the Genji.
![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira

* Moira is the classic Genji counter since her ![](/data/assets/guide/112e6bfacd58fe0e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grasp.png)Biotic Grasp auto-tracks Genji’s fast movement and ![](/data/assets/guide/b4447c9cc5302954.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-orb.png)Biotic Orb damages Genji during Deflect unless he directly Deflects the projectile. ![](/data/assets/guide/c2024d883333803a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoalescence.png)Coalescence gives Moira a third method of damaging through ![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)Deflect.

* Additionally, ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade’s invincibility and movement are also difficult for Genji to deal with and can interrupt him from chaining together dash resets during Dragonblade. Unlike ![](/data/assets/guide/df34545acaf615da.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbrigitte.png)Brigitte, however, Moira struggles to keep her allies alive against Genji. Moira is an easier way to survive against and kill Genji, but Brig is technically the better counter.
team_comp_synergies: Team comps built around mobility can best utilize Genji’s power. Full dive team comps can be explosive with Genji, but rely on coordination and timing. A team built around strong mobility abilities can completely control a game and dictate when, where, and with whom fights occur.
**Ideal Team Comp built around Genji:**

* Tank: ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)Winston

* DPS: ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji, ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn

* Supports: ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, Lucio

On the other hand, Genji can also play well as the solo dive or flank hero on his team. In these team comps, he functions as an elimination confirmer, following up on team damage. Teammates who output high levels of consistent damage can greatly enable Genji with dash reset after dash reset on low health enemies.

**Example team comp:** ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya, ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji, ![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)Junkrat, ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste

strengths.title: 1v1 duels
content: As one of the best duelers in the game, Genji wants to take on isolated targets as often as possible. Shurikens are easiest to hit from close range because of their slow travel speed. Double jumping over and around his target makes aim tracking a Genji very difficult. The threat of Deflect makes it very difficult for enemy players to use their abilities. Getting their ability Deflected means certain death for the enemy.

strengths.title: Mobility
content: Combining his three mobility tools enables Genji to take paths around the map that are only available to very few other heroes. Genji’s mobility can be used defensively to evade damage, escape fights, or offensively to quickly approach enemies.

strengths.title: Team Kill Potential
content: Dragonblade on its own is a decent ult. When combined with a Support ult like Nano Boost or Kitsune Rush, Genji can realistically wipe out the entire enemy team.

weaknesses.title: Low poke damage
content: During the Poke phase of a fight, when both teams are still a good distance from each other, Genji provides little value. Spread out Shurikens with slow travel speed are one of the weakest long-range abilities.

weaknesses.title: Heavily reliant on his cooldown cycle
content: When Genji has already used Deflect and Swift Strike, he becomes a sitting duck defensively, and barely a threat offensively. Players who are able to chain Swift Strike Resets together are incomparably stronger than players who have yet to master the skill.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to beams
content: Because Deflect is Genji’s primary means of surviving, he struggles against heroes with beams. Winston jumps on him, he'd better have dash to get away. If he lets them get into range, heroes like Zarya, Sym, and Moira quickly eliminate Genji.

play_against_summary: * Don’t get isolated. Genji is one of the best 1v1 duelists in OW, so stay close to your allies so he always has to fight at least two enemies.

* Force out ![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)Deflect by dealing damage with your standard weapon, then use your cooldown abilities to punish him when he doesn’t have it.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade is extremely lethal and can instantly win team fights. Plan how you will personally survive it, and how you can help your teammates survive with your healing, burst damage, or CC.

minor.title: Swift Cuts
content: **Acrobatics**
* Not very useful
* * Compared to Dragon’s Thirst, Acrobatics brings very little value to Genji. You’re rarely going to find a use for being able to double jump, dash, then double jump again.
minor.name: Swift Cuts
minor.description: Quick Melee reduces the cooldown of Swift Strike by 3 seconds.

minor.title: Dragon's Thirst
content: * Best Minor Perk
* * Lifesteal during Dragonblade enables you to be even more aggressive than normal during your ult.
* Less reliant on team resources
* * When running Dragon’s Thirst, Genji has more agency to make big plays without the need for healing or comboing with ults like Nano Boost.
* When swinging repeatedly, Genji gains up to ~45 healing per second, and with Nano, it jumps up to ~70 healing per second!
* Still not invincible
* * Always remember that just because you are lifestealing, you aren’t invincible, so take your standard precautions and don’t try to 1v5 the enemy team.
minor.name: Dragon's Thirst
minor.description: Dragonblade swings gain 30% lifesteal.

major.title: Blade Twisting
content: * More damage, ult charge, and elims

* * More damage is more good. But, you'll need to use ![](/data/assets/guide/2b083b4a4d737525.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-strike.png)Swift Strike late in your combos to ensure you get the bonus damage.

* Against the 175 HP heroes ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer and pilot ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va, the extra 25 damage makes ![](/data/assets/guide/2b083b4a4d737525.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-strike.png)Swift Strike > ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade slash kill.
major.name: Blade Twisting
major.description: Swift Strike deals 25 additional damage over time if the enemy is below half health.

major.title: Meditation
content: * Significantly increase survivability
* * Restore up to 70 health during Deflect. The extra health enables Genji to stay in fights longer, and thereby deal more damage.
* Help with beams
* * While 35 healing per second is lower than the damage per second of every beam, it will still help Genji to survive some situations where he would’ve otherwise died.
major.name: Meditation
major.description: Regenerate 35 health per second while Deflect is active.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)Hanzo have open long and narrow sightlines lines like Circuit Royal, first point Colosseo, and Havana. These are areas funnel the enemy into predictable positions he can spam arrows down and abuse the threat of a long-range one-shot.
Since he can ![](/data/assets/guide/7d1c537e6929240e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwall-climb.png)Wall Climb to high ground repeatedly, he does especially well by taking the high ground surrounding objectives.
Maps with enclosed objective areas are difficult for him because outside of using ![](/data/assets/guide/fd60def8b68baca3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fstorm-arrows.png)Storm Arrows, he's at the disadvantage in close-ranges.
The only draw back to high ground maps like Dorado, is that these are also common maps for the enemy to play his main counters like ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji and ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va.

play_as: * Spam fully charged shots down long-sight lines. Even when not getting kills, his arrows pose a huge threat and force the enemy team to play cautiously.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/7d1c537e6929240e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwall-climb.png)Wall Climb to control position on high ground where it’s difficult for the enemy to contest Hanzo.

* Use ![](/data/assets/guide/0867ccdb950bcb34.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsonic-arrow.png)Sonic Arrow before the fight starts to gain information about enemy positions before they can see you.
play_against: * Respect his sightlines. If he’s already aiming down the main choke point, stay behind a barrier or take a different path.
* Vary your left/right strafing movement to make it more difficult for him to predict your direction.
* If you are playing a flank or dive hero, keep pressuring him so he can’t freely shoot the rest of your team.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)Hanzo wants a barrier Tank like ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina or ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt to stand behind so he can safely aim at this targets while protected. Although he can also play high ground and off angles, barriers make his job much easier.

The other type of Tank that helps him most are those like ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa and ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog who can shutdown enemy divers and flankers who try to get close and target Hanzo.

Because his damage can be a bit inconsistent, and mostly covers the main sightlines, he also benefits from flankers like ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer who can attack from behind the enemy team, and hitscans like ![](/data/assets/guide/e4d3354cf66c9e62.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Femre.png)Emre and ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion who can lay down consistent damage on attackers.

strengths.title: Pick Potential and Threat
content: Hanzo’s ability to one-shot squishy heroes makes him a constant threat in fights. A single well-placed arrow can instantly swing the match's momentum. Just the threat of being instantly killed puts immense pressure on the enemy team and makes them cautious to push up.

strengths.title: Information Gathering
content: Sonic Arrow gives Hanzo great scouting capabilities. Knowing enemy positions and pathing gives his team extra time to adapt their position and strategy.

strengths.title: Versatile
content: Wall Climb and Lunge let Hanzo access high ground, safely shoot over walls, and play off-angles. When pressured, he can either escape or pop Storm Arrow to battle it out.

weaknesses.title: Inconsistent
content: Hanzo’s effectiveness is heavily aim-dependent. Missed shots provide little value, and even the best Hanzo players have times when they can’t land a headshot. Compared to many DPS, Hanzo struggles to bring consistent value to his team.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to Dive and Rush
content: Although Hanzo has the threat of Storm and Frost Arrow, he struggles against high mobility dive heroes, who are especially difficult to land shots on. These heroes also tend not to stand in straight lines or on the objective, so they naturally counter Hanzo’s main game plan.

weaknesses.title: Low Team Utility
content: Beyond Sonic Arrow, Hanzo doesn’t bring any benefit to his team outside of getting solo kills. He doesn’t directly enable team play, and he’s not particularly good at peeling for his backline.

play_against_summary: * Respect his sightlines. If he’s already aiming down the main choke point, stay behind a barrier or take a different path.
* Vary your left/right strafing movement to make it more difficult for him to predict your direction.
* If you are playing a flank or dive hero, keep pressuring him so he can’t freely shoot the rest of your team.

minor.title: Sonic Disruption
content: * Useful for inconveniencing enemy flankers who rely on health packs to get back into the fight.
* If there is a flanker like Tracer, or a Tank like Wrecking Ball harassing your team, grabbing health packs and attacking you again, Sonic Disruption can be used to hinder their gameplay loop,.
minor.name: Sonic Disruption
minor.description: Sonic Arrow hacks nearby Health Packs for 30 seconds.

minor.title: Dragon Fury
content: * Even if you only hit one out of every 3 shots, the increased draw speed is very strong for Hanzo.
* Take by default. Especially powerful when being pressured by Tanks.
* Recommended Minor Perk
minor.name: Dragon Fury

major.title: Scatter Arrows
content: * In theory, you can get some cheeky KOs against retreating enemies inside rooms or around corners, but it’s too niche to be worth taking in any scenario over Frost Arrow.
major.name: Scatter Arrows
major.description: On first ricochet, Storm Arrows split into 5 shots dealing 33% damage and bounce 1 extra time.

major.title: Frost Arrow
major.name: Frost Arrow
major.description: Press Reload to ready an explosive frost arrow that slows enemies by 35% for 3 seconds.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard's mobility is best utilized on maps with lots of walls to climb, and plenty of high ground to move around on. Since he has limited range, his playstyle is hindered on maps with large open areas and maps with long sightlines. He also likes to set up his dive engagements by utilizing corners and structure, so maps with sectioned-off areas give him more opportunities. content: ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard can climb walls and ledges, Leap, and bunny hop. He can even ![](/data/assets/guide/0288db79a40ae52f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvault.png)Vault on ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall when needed. When positioning and managing his cooldowns properly, there should never be a time when you have no mobility options.

content: As the only ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank and only hero other than ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei with a deployable wall, ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard can execute plays that no other ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank can. Wall is equally good for blocking doorways, used as a barrier, isolating enemies, cutting off enemy escape routes, and for a bit of damage.

strengths.title: High uptime
content: With multiple strong abilities and a short cooldown cycle, ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard never has to sit around waiting for his resources to refresh before he can engage. Compared to many other ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks with a main long cooldown ability that their entire game plan is centered around, ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard spends far more time in the heat of battle.

weaknesses.title: Has to get in close
content: Slash and ![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)Bonespur are only effective at very close range. Depending on the map and enemy team comp, ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard may waste a lot of time trying to approach the enemy while getting poked down.

His movement range, however, is quite limited compared to the other dive ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks. ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard struggles to chase down enemies with mobility and escape tools of their own.

weaknesses.title: Weak to crowd control
content: Without a barrier and only one use of ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall, ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard is particularly susceptible to CC. If the enemy has heroes with stuns and displacement abilities, expect to be targeted every time you use ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard.
