minor.title: Deep Leap
content: * Counter high mobility

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard can have difficulty keeping up with targets who have lots of mobility, like ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno, ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy, and ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn. The extra Leap distance helps him to close the gap and stay in a more advantageous range for him.
* Faster engages
* * With the increased distance, you won’t have to break up your approach into as many stages since you can dive from farther away.
* More often, you’ll be able to bypass the enemy frontline and instantly reach the backline with Leap.
* Pairs with Off The Top
* * You can go all in on Leap perks and structure your game plan around Leap and Slash. Just know you’ll be sacrificing Lifesteal and Wall uptime to do so.
minor.name: Deep Leap
minor.description: Violent Leap’s range is increased by 15%.

minor.title: Anarchic Zeal
content: * Self healing

* * A full-duration ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard with Anarchic Zeal will heal you for approximately 50 HP per target.

* Combined with the damage reduction, this makes ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard significantly more tanky, and alleviates some healing resource demand on your ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports.
* Run with Reconstitution
* * When planning to use Anarchic Zeal, you should select Reconstitution as your Minor Perk to capitalize on the Lifesteal.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard can trap an enemy in a corner between his body and ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall while holding ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard.

* Every couple of seconds, they’ll retrigger ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall and Reconstitution's energy refill. Enjoy watching them panic as you slowly drain their life.
minor.name: Anarchic Zeal
minor.description: Spike Guard’s spikes gain 30% Lifesteal.

major.title: Reconstitution
content: * Significantly increased uptime

* * Upon reading the Perk description, you may think it sounds weak. What makes Reconstitution powerful, however, is that ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard uses the base ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard resource before depleting the overfill. Also, the overfill does not decay, so you can hold onto it as long as needed.

* Between the instant refill and overfill, you’ll be able to use ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard considerably more often or for longer uses.
major.name: Reconstitution
major.description: Jagged Wall hits charge Spike Guard with 25 energy, up to 50 extra.

major.title: Explosive Impalements
content: * Extra burst damage

* * Very good for securing elims with your team and solo kills. You don't have to do anything special because all ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard players should already be using the combo listed above of shoot > Leap > Melee. Basically, a free extra 40 damage.
major.name: Explosive Impalements
major.description: Bonespur hits mark targets with spikes. Quick Melee and Violent Leap's slash detonate them for 40 explosive damage.

play_as: * Focus on keeping up your damage output. If you aren’t applying a lot of offensive pressure, playing a different Support would be better.

* Place ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon behind walls where it is hidden from the enemy team. Only move it when your whole team is repositioning.
* Use your ult to target enemies that your allies are already attacking. That way, they can quickly trigger the Sunstruck explosion.
play_against: * ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari has great ranged damage, but struggles with close-range duels. Try to avoid her LoS until you can catch her in a close-range fight.

* Teams with Illari are at a disadvantage in longer fights that require a lot of sustain. Play patient and only commit to the attack after she’s lost her ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon and used up her Solar Energy.
* When you hear her ult voice line, prepare your countermeasures. Shoot her out of the sky, block the projectile, stun her before she fires, or escape out of her LoS.
specific_counters_81: ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va

![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari is weak to dive in general. D.Va’s Booster cool down is half of Captive Sun making it virtually impossible to outrun D.Va. Defense Matrix alone is the hardest counter to ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari since it mitigates any damage Illari can deal. D.Va also has rather easy time countering Illari’s Ult since she can fly and Defense Matrix Captive Sun pretty much anywhere she shoots it. Even if ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari lands Captive Sun, Matrix can prevent any damage that would trigger Sunstruck.
![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji

A good Genji can ruin Illari’s day. His mobility allows him to position and consistently destroy Healing Pylon. If ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari is positioned with some distance from her team as she often will be, Genji dives her and is at a huge advantage in the 1v1 duel because of his high mobility, Deflect, and Illari’s slow rate of fire makes it even harder to hit Genji jumping all around her. The charge timer also makes Illari’s shots more predictable and thereby easier to Deflect. Top all that off with the fact that he can Deflect Captive Sun back to your team and ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari has her work cut out for her.
![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

Although not as consistent, Kunai can challenge ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari's ranged damage because of its high headshot damage and lack of fall off damage. If ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari doesn’t purposely wait for Protection Suzu to be used, Captive Sun becomes completely useless since it cleanses everyone in the AoE of the debuff.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari performs best within poke team comps that are based around doing as much ranged damage as possible, and burning down the enemy team before they even have a chance to close the distance. For the other Support hero, ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari benefits from having someone who can focus primarily on healing the team so she can further focus on dealing max damage. ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari struggles to find value in teams with a lot of fast high mobility like dive comps. Ideally, ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari can place ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon, and focus on shooting the enemies together with a DPS ally possessing strong ranged damage.
**Ideal comp built around Illari:**

* ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma, ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, ![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)Junkrat, ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari, ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste

strengths.title: High poke damage
content: The long range and high damage of her primary fire make ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari feel more like a DPS hero who just so happens to be able to heal her allies as well. Oftentimes in OW2, burst damage ends up being the most valuable ability any hero can possess. Landing critical hits with ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari forces the enemy to either start playing out of her LoS where they struggle to get value, or ego duel to the death.

strengths.title: Passive healing ability
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon is a really strong healing ability. The deployable can be positioned near your team and auto-heals everyone within its range. The automated healing frees up ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari to focus on clicking heads or use her healing beam to give a quick burst of health to a low-health ally.

strengths.title: Knockback movement ability
content: Heroes with the ability to simultaneously CC their enemy and reposition themselves possess an advantage against close-range enemies. Outburst can be used for quick vertical or horizontal movement for ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari, or can be used to boop away the enemy out of position. ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari wants to maintain distance from her enemies to take advantage of her ranged power, so Outburst is a great tool to keep that distance.

weaknesses.title: Poor close-range performance
content: When paired with teammates who want to play in close range to the enemy team, ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari can struggle to keep up. ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon benefits from teams holding positions for extended periods and staying within its range. Her slow rate of fire can also make dueling at close range very challenging and typically puts her at a disadvantage.

weaknesses.title: Limited healing
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon only has 125 total HP, making it easy to break if spotted. When an enemy does break the Pylon, its cooldown doubles to 14 seconds. That is a long time for her team to rely solely on Solar Rifle's healing. Even when up, she can only heal a single target and has a very limited healing resource from Solar Rifle.

weaknesses.title: Ultimate easily countered
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b00bbcb63e12ae6d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcaptive-sun.png)Captive Sun can either feel like a massive fight-winning ult, or completely useless. First, Illari’s voice line alerts everyone she’s ulting, then she flies up into the air at a slightly fast speed that’s not too hard to track. Finally, she only has a 5-second window to fire the projectile. During this time, her enemies can prepare their countermeasures, which can vary from ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix to ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu, to a simple phase ability to self-cleanse.

play_against_summary: * ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari has great ranged damage, but struggles with close-range duels. Try to avoid her LoS until you can catch her in a close-range fight.

* Teams with Illari are at a disadvantage in longer fights that require a lot of sustain. Play patient and only commit to the attack after she’s lost her ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon and used up her Solar Energy.
* When you hear her ult voice line, prepare your countermeasures. Shoot her out of the sky, block the projectile, stun her before she fires, or escape out of her LoS.

minor.title: Rapid Construction
content: * Increase Pylon Uptime

* * As previously stated, the biggest weakness of ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari and her ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon is how much downtime there is between uses. The CD reduction has a more notable effect when replacing the Pylon without taking damage, but it's always helpful.
* Better at saving allies

* * The faster construction time allows ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari to deploy ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon near an ally in danger and begin granting healing significantly faster. Against dive comps, Rapid Construction is the better Minor Perk.
minor.name: Rapid Construction
minor.description: Healing Pylon builds 300% faster and its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

minor.title: Summer Solstice
content: * Makes outplaying your ult more difficult
* * The extra flight time and speed make it harder for the enemy to avoid your ult and makes your fire timing more unpredictable.
* Against comps with a lot of Captive Sun Counters, you should take Summer Solstice.
minor.name: Summer Solstice
minor.description: Activating Captive Sun grants Illari 3 extra seconds of flight, 20% increased flight speed, and 20% increased attack speed.

major.title: Solar Flare
content: * Great for adding burst and AoE healing to ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari's kit, which is one of her main weaknesses for sustain.
* It can be activated as long as the energy resource is not completely depleted.
* Recommended Perk, unless the enemy team is hard-focusing you on dives.
major.name: Solar Flare
major.description: Press Primary Fire while using Solar Rifle's healing beam to heal all allies in front of Illari for 100 healing.

major.title: Sunburn
content: * Anti-dive

* * The main strength of Outburst is the distance it creates between ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari and her attackers. The extra damage over time will help her win 1v1 duels.

* Most effective when you are being sustained by ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon because the burning damage is only ~23 damage /second, so you'll need to stay alive long enough to benefit.
major.name: Sunburn
major.description: Outburst ignites enemies, dealing an additional 70 damage over 3 seconds.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: Maps with primarily flat areas around the objective are the best for ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen. She has good ground mobility from Shout, but lacks vertical mobility or the range to contest enemies on high ground. Maps with too much high ground are difficult for her to find consistent value on. Additionally, areas that are really open or have long sight lines are bad for JQ, as she has no way of directly dealing with poke damage.

play_as: * Only use Shout when you see an opportunity to push up and aggressively attack the enemy team. Don’t use it if everyone is far away.

* Keep up Wound damage. Cycle ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage, ![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade, and Blade melee to always have Wounds applied.

* Wait out Ult counters. ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)Rampage can be easy to counter; don’t use it if the enemy has resources available like ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko's Suzu.
play_against: * CC her. ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen has no countermeasure to CC. Stun and knock her around to keep her at bay.
* Keep your distance. Keep moving and try to never let her get into axe range.

* Shoot her team. JQ has a lot of self-healing and can be difficult to kill. But she’s smaller for a ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank and can’t protect her team from your damage.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen thrives in brawl and rush comps where her sustain and ![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout AoE utility can snowball fights quickly. She pairs exceptionally well with DPS who want to fight inside her effective range like ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper, ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei, ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy and ![](/data/assets/guide/90fbc15b3208bec3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmizuki.png)Mizukij who benefit heavily the speed and armor. Everyone pressing W together with Shout enables aggressive engages and lets them take space.

Heroes with burst damage like ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe are effective at converting ![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade pulls into eliminations.

For Supports, Junker Queen has plenty of self-healing, so she primarily wants utility to help her play aggressive. ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio can initiate with @Speed Boost, which allows Queen to save Shout to use in response to the enemies' counterattack attempt. Against any low mobility comp, this will create an overwhelming fight that runs them over.

Kiriko also works extremely well, as ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu can negate anti-heal or crowd control that would otherwise shut Queen down mid-fight, while ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush is practially a second ult for Queen.
In ranked, where coordination can vary, Queen excels when her team commits decisively; half-engages are what punish her most.

strengths.title: Team overhealth and speed boost
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout is the best utility ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen brings to her team. The large AOE instantly grants her and her team overhealth and a speed boost. Because of this, she facilitates a very aggressive play style that revolves around Shout’s cooldown.

strengths.title: Deadly brawler
content: Once ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen closes the distance on you, she brawls with the best of them. ![](/data/assets/guide/21f45973280e0d8a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fscattergun.png)Scattergun deals high damage up close, and she has ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage to penetrate barriers and bypass many ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks' only means of protection.

strengths.title: Self-sufficient
content: Between healing from Wounds, overhealth from Shout, and life steal from Savage Satiation Perk, ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen doesn't even need a ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Support to heal her. Being self-sufficient enables her to push deep into the enemy team, get kills, and get out alive.

weaknesses.title: No barrier or immunity
content: The biggest weakness ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen leaves her team with is not having the ability to protect herself or her team. She stays alive through self-healing, but can't stop the enemy from damaging her or her allies. She especially feels her lack of protection against teams with a lot of crowd control because they can just stack one on top of the other, and she's unable to stop it.

weaknesses.title: Wounds and anti-heal can be cleansed
content: There are a lot of abilities in Overwatch 2 that cleanse ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen's wounds and anti-healing. Heroes with Fades like ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira and ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper can cleanse themselves, and heroes with ally cleanses like ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko and ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver can cleanse their teammates.

weaknesses.title: Only effective at close range
content: If ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen can't get close to the enemy, she is doing nothing and providing no value to her team. Furthermore, she needs to be touching multiple enemies if she wants to get max value out of ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage.

play_against_summary: * CC her. ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen has no countermeasure to CC. Stun and knock her around to keep her at bay.
* Keep your distance. Keep moving and try to never let her get into axe range.

* Shoot her team. JQ has a lot of self-healing and can be difficult to kill. But she’s smaller for a ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank and can’t protect her team from your damage.

minor.title: Rampant Charge
content: * All in on your ultimate compared to Battle Shout bringing lower, but more frequent value.

* Make sure to use all your CDs before activating ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)Rampage.
* You can play hyper aggressive when you have ult because you'll be able to chain two ability cycles together.
minor.name: Rampant Charge
minor.description: Gain Unstoppable and refreshes all cooldowns by 6 seconds when using Rampage.

minor.title: Battle Shout
content: “_Commanding Shout fully reloads Scattergun and increases allied reload speed by 50%.”_
* Extra aggression
* * Battle Shout empowers JQ and all allies in Shout AoE to be more aggressive thanks to the decrease in reload time.
* Reload speed buff
* * Reloading after 5 shots ensures you start reloading before Shout ends and lets you benefit from the 50% increased reload speed.
minor.name: Battle Shout
minor.description: Commanding Shout fully reloads Scatter Gun and increases allied reload speed by 50%.

major.title: Willy-Willy
content: * Land easier Blade direct impacts, and get an bit of extra burst damage to help secure elims.

* Decent, but only take if you are getting hard CC'd everytime you try to ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage and need more ranged presence.
major.name: Willy-Willy
major.description: When recalling Jagged Blade its radius is increased by 100% and it deals 30 additional impact damage.

major.title: Savage Satiation
content: _“Carnage's impact damage gains 100% lifesteal.”_
* Recommended Major Perk
* Extra healing
* * Each enemy hit with her axe gives 105 HP healing. Multiply by the number of enemies hit, plus consider that each enemy hit also reduces the 8-second cooldown by 2 seconds.
* JQ becomes insanely more tanky when running Savage Satiation.

* If you hit just two enemies with an axe swing, JQ gets 390 total healing (Impact lifesteal plus Wound), and gets to use ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage again 4 seconds later.
major.name: Savage Satiation
major.description: Carnage's impact damage gains 100% lifesteal.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)Junkrat have narrow corridors small objective areas and some high ground to play around. Lijiang Tower's Control Center, and New Junk City are good examples of the types of map layouts that let Junkrat pump a barrage of frags down onto objectives, off walls, and into small rooms.
He struggles on maps with long sightlines and open areas like Junker Town and Havana. The slow travel speed of ![](/data/assets/guide/72f7df04b6d0f995.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffrag-launcher.png)Frag Launcher and short range of ![](/data/assets/guide/ba859132aa8f14c2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fconcussion-mine.png)Concussion Mine let long ranged projectile and hitscan heroes out-class him on these maps.

play_as: * Spam chokes relentlessly. Look for walls you can ricochet ![](/data/assets/guide/72f7df04b6d0f995.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffrag-launcher.png)Frag Launchers off of to attack enemies that don’t have LoS on you.

* Control space with traps and mines. You should always have a ![](/data/assets/guide/bcd737fdd37e006d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsteel-trap.png)Steel Trap out to cover the enemy's forward approach or protect your flank.
* Target large and slow enemies like Tanks instead of trying skill-shot small mobile heroes.
play_against: * Avoid tight corridors, rooms, hallways, and low areas. These are the perfect places for Junkrat’s frags to farm your team.
* Keep an eye on the floor. Break traps for your teammates so they don’t walk in and die.
* Heroes with long-range capabilities or small, high-mobility characters have favorable matchups against Junkrat.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)Junkrat mainly positions on off angles, near but separate from his team. Because of this he has a lot of flexibility with Tank pairings. When he has a barrier Tank, he can play more with his team and spam behind their protection. With more mobile Tanks, he mine up to reposition and follow-up on their aggression.

For the second DPS, having a hitscan like ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe is very helpful to cover his weakness against fliers like ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah.

Utility based Supports like ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta with ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord or ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana with ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade can capitalize on his high burst damage to explode enemy heroes and get quick elims.

You can also get creative with ![](/data/assets/guide/9f82e6ddaa52911f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwuyang.png)Wuyang and his controllable primary fire to bombard enemies positioned behind cover where only he and Junkrat can keep attacking them. Dive in with ![](/data/assets/guide/91b2239520de7052.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftidal-blast.png)Tidal Blast, and you are practically guaranteed to secure a kill if you land on someone and knock them down.

strengths.title: Burst Damage
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/ba859132aa8f14c2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fconcussion-mine.png)Concussion Mine combos allow Junkrat to instantly delete squishy targets or heavily damage tanks. When executed cleanly, his burst potential is among the best in game.

strengths.title: Frequent Crowd Control
content: Two Concussion Mine charges, a Trap, and even his Frags have a bit of knockback. Altogether, Junkrat makes it difficult to walk forward. He can control enemy movement better than they can.

strengths.title: Random Eliminations
content: Choke spam really is Junkrat’s specialty. Partly due to his Frags bouncing around and hitting targets he completely missed or didn’t even know were standing there. Even better when he’s shooting over structures or bouncing shots off of walls.

weaknesses.title: Limited Effectiveness at Long Range
content: Junkrat struggles in open maps where enemies can outrange and avoid his projectiles. Smart opponents can exploit range to maintain the advantage. The slow projectile speed makes his consistency fall off the farther away he gets.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable During Ultimate
content: Junkrat is one of the only heroes who cannot protect himself during his ult. If an enemy finds you, it’s a free kill. Additionally, if you send ![](/data/assets/guide/e30d6cf12db48904.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frip-tire.png)RIP-Tire straight at the enemy, they can easily break it.

weaknesses.title: Very Little Counterplay Against Fliers
content: Even though we’ll see crazy clips of flying Top 500 Junkrats, the reality is that fliers destroy Junkrat. If you are doing really well, expect to see ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah and ![](/data/assets/guide/5ecb2adb5abc123f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjetpack-cat.png)Jetpack Cat counter-swaps.

play_against_summary: * Avoid tight corridors, rooms, hallways, and low areas. These are the perfect places for Junkrat’s frags to farm your team.
* Keep an eye on the floor. Break traps for your teammates so they don’t walk in and die.
* Heroes with long-range capabilities or small, high-mobility characters have favorable matchups against Junkrat.

minor.title: Mine Recycling
content: * Rewards efficient mine usage. Try to purposely save a Mine for landing the final blow.
* Very powerful and enables hyper-aggressive play. You can use one Mine to jump in, another to kill with the Frag-Mine combo, then a refreshed third to jump back out.
* Recommended Minor Perk
minor.name: Mine Recycling
minor.description: Killing blows with Concussion Mine restore one charge.

minor.title: Nitro Boost
content: * Makes it much more challenging for the enemy to predict Tire movement and destroy it.
* Particularly valuable on vertical or open maps.
minor.name: Nitro Boost
minor.description: During RIP-Tire, use (LSHIFT) to gain a quick boost of speed. Doing so reduces RIP-Tire’s damage by 50%.

major.title: Frag Cannon
content: * Increased projectile speed makes landing direct hits more consistent.
* Best on maps with longer sight lines, but never a bad choice.
* * The increased speed throws some players' muscle memory off, but most find the adjustment very helpful.
* Take it when you are focusing on long-range spam.
major.name: Frag Cannon
major.description: Frag Launcher’s projectile speed is increased by 25%

major.title: Bomb Voyage
content: * Makes your Mine jumps more lethal. Especially when paired with Mine Recycling and using the aforementioned three Mine jump-kill-jump method.
* Best used when playing flanks or surprising enemies by jumping over a wall and quickly raining Frags on them.
* Pick Bomb Voyage when you want to position more aggressively.
major.name: Bomb Voyage
major.description: After launching with Concussion Mine, Junkrat gains 35% increased attack speed for 3 seconds.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno are flat, have a lot of open space, and encourage fights to be on the objective. ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring gets the most value when her team needs the extra speed to get to the next objective quickly, or when helping her team flank or rush down the enemy backline. If the enemy can set up on high ground or far from the objective, ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring’s value decreases. Because Orbital Ray moves in a slow and fixed path, fights that stay in one place also raise its potential. ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno's horizontal movement is best on flat ground maps and maps with lots of small side rooms she can glide through while evading the enemy.

play_as: * Use ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring when you see your tank trying to rush down the enemy team.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno is vulnerable when flying around and locking on ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes. Be mindful of enemy hitscan heroes, and stay out of their LoS.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/0af76c2c1400b1cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fglide-boost.png)Glide Boost is your best defense. Save it to escape enemy flank attacks.
play_against: * Keep poking her. ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno can’t heal herself, so she relies on shield regen and the Support heal passive. Even the smallest amount of damage to her interrupts the passive self-heal.

* All of ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno's healing requires LoS. Stop her from healing with barriers or by forcing her attention away from her allies through your attacks.

* Without Pulsar Torpedoes, ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno struggles to defend herself against high mobility heroes. Get past her team and chase her down.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno wants to enable her team with ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring. Therefore, she pairs best with heroes who primarily rely on burst damage to win fights.

Whether it's ground-based brawlers like ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt or ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper who can now quickly chase down squishies, or already hyper mobile heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va or ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran to increase their already great movement, ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring enables hyper-aggression and fast fight wins.

Since she offers both high sustain and some utility, ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno pairs well with most Supports. ![](/data/assets/guide/a556e4ed6de03aaf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray is a hybrid of defense and offense, so if your team needs a full-on defensive ult to survive an enemy wombo-combo like ![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)Nano Boost + ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade, go with someone like ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio who can use their ult defensively, while you save yours for an offensive push.

strengths.title: Highly Mobile
content: Between ![](/data/assets/guide/0af76c2c1400b1cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fglide-boost.png)Glide Boost, double jump, and ![](/data/assets/guide/a85755b1f05e3456.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring, ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno is one of the most mobile Supports. She can keep up with her team as they move around the map. Her movement also enables her to escape danger and quickly reposition for her own attack.

strengths.title: Team buffs
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno is the only Support who can give her entire team both damage and speed buffs. Increasing the abilities of an entire team is extremely powerful. She has great utility from the high playmaking potential of Hyper Ring and Orbital Ray.

strengths.title: Lock on projectile
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes are great for a burst of guaranteed healing for your team. They are equally as strong for finishing off low HP enemies. Once locked on, the Torpedoes will even chase around corners.

weaknesses.title: Severe healing and damage fall off
content: If ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno finds herself at medium-long range from her teammates or enemy targets, Mediblaster’s healing and damage drops significantly. Although they are a hitscan weapon, she’s not good at pressuring the enemy at long range, or at providing healing to far-away allies.

weaknesses.title: Struggles in dive metas
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno is very easy for dive comps to eliminate. She doesn’t have any CC, self-sustain, or invincibility. Additionally, played in a dive team, those heroes don’t Hyper Ring to traverse the map, and they don’t want to stand in place to benefit from Orbital Ray.

weaknesses.title: Low self-healing
content: While she has some shield health, ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno doesn’t have any means of burst healing herself like most other Supports do (outside of ![](/data/assets/guide/a556e4ed6de03aaf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray). She’s reliant on her other Support, self-healing passive, or has to be able to hide for long enough to activate shield regen.

play_against_summary: * Keep poking her. ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno can’t heal herself, so she relies on shield regen and the Support heal passive. Even the smallest amount of damage to her interrupts the passive self-heal.

* All of ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno's healing requires LoS. Stop her from healing with barriers or by forcing her attention away from her allies through your attacks.

* Without Pulsar Torpedoes, ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno struggles to defend herself against high mobility heroes. Get past her team and chase her down.

minor.title: Familiar Vitals
content: _“Pulsar Torpedoes lock onto allies 35% faster.”_
* Save low HP allies

* * The only weakness of ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes is the time it takes to lock on, then the slow travel speed of the projectile. Teammates sometimes die before the healing arrives. 35% increase for only healing Torpedoes may not sound like a lot, but in critical moments it means the difference between life and death for ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno's allies.
minor.name: Familiar Vitals
minor.description: Pulsar Torpedoes lock onto allies 35% faster.

minor.title: Locked On
content: _“Reduce the cooldown of Pulsar Torpedoes by 1 second for each enemy hit.”_
* Good when able to play more offensively
* * Getting to use her Torpedoes more often puts extra pressure on the enemy team and builds Ult charge faster.
* You need to frequently get at least one or two enemies locked on.

* Don't tunnel vision on only dealing damage, ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes are your best source of burst healing for your allies.
minor.name: Locked On
minor.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pulsar Torpedoes by 1 second for each enemy hit.

major.title: Faster Blaster
content: * Burst value

* * When picking this Perk, you gain ~30% fire rate increase during ![](/data/assets/guide/0af76c2c1400b1cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fglide-boost.png)Glide Boost.
* That gives you the option for both burst damage and burst healing.
* Good for dueling.
major.name: Faster Blaster
major.description: While using Glide Boost, Mediblaster fires continuosly.

major.title: Lift Off
content: * Extra verticality

* * The extra 3rd jump can be use at any time, including during ![](/data/assets/guide/0af76c2c1400b1cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fglide-boost.png)Glide Boost. This allows ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno to reach new heights and access some high ground that is normally just above her reach.

* Good for hopping above a wall to fire ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes, and for escaping from close-range enemies who lack vertical mobility.
* Counter Perk

* * Against melee, and close-range enemies, Lift Off can be the better Major Perk to choose, because it will help ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno keep distance from her attackers.
major.name: Lift Off
major.description: Martian Overboots can now triple jump.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko's mobility and versatility make her a solid choice on every map. But because she can climb and teleport through walls, maps with lots of structures or rooms give her more outplay potential. Long sight lines are good for her Kunai, but bad for ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda if her allies get too far away from her. Be mindful of the map area you are in and adjust accordingly. Just make sure to always be within lock-on and Swift Step range to your team.

play_as: * Play within ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)Swift Step and Healing Ofuda lock-on range at all times so you can quickly save allies or escape danger without overcommitting.

* Rotate between healing and Kunai pressure to build ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush quickly while still threatening enemy backliners with headshots.

* Save ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu for high-impact debuffs or lethal moments rather than using it purely for healing value.
play_against: * Force out ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)Swift Step or ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu early, then re-engage while those cooldowns are unavailable.
* Pressure her from multiple angles to deny safe teleport targets and limit her escape options.

* Treat ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush like the best offensive ult the enemy team has. Save defensive utility to survive, retreat when possible, or use your own ultimates to prevent her from overwhelming your team.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko has great self-survivability, range, and movement. These qualities mean she pairs best with rush and dive comps, but her versatile kit will allow her to find value in every team comp.

Tanks that want to position and move aggressively are good choices. Especially those without barriers or an absorption to block status effects like anti-![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade. For example, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga benefits greatly from ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko because he has no way to block such abilities, and ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush paired with ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)Cage Fight is a deadly combo.

![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko pairs best with mid and frontline DPS. Thanks to her ranged healing and damage, she wants to always face forward and constantly spam, and never have to turn around. Snipers are her worst pairings since she needs to turn away from the main action to peel for snipers.

She can be played as the primary source of sustain, or focus more on utility. Historically, her best pairing has been ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio because they both are able to play hyper-aggressively, survive without relying on the other, and synergize with the same team comps.

strengths.title: Auto-tracking healing
content: No matter your skill level, everyone misses shots. Kiri never has to worry about that with her forgiving lock-on hitbox. Once locked on, the ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda will even chase allies around corners. Comes especially in handy with small and mobile teammates.

strengths.title: High survivability
content: Supports are often the first players targeted by the enemy team. ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko is one of the most difficult Supports to eliminate because she has so many survival tools. Kunai counts as well since it poses a decent threat to attackers.

strengths.title: Fight-winning Support Ultimate
content: Most Support ults need to be comboed with a Tank or DPS ult to win a fight. ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush empowers the whole team and is often enough of an advantage all on its own to win the teamfight.

weaknesses.title: Slow healing projectile and limited lock-on range
content: The farther away an ally gets from ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko, the more noticeable her slow healing becomes. At max lock-on range, the healing can arrive too late to save them. Additionally, compared to a lot of other Supports, Healing Ofuda’s Lock on range is very limited so Kiri falls behind in ranged capabilities.

weaknesses.title: Weak into barrier Tanks
content: Barriers block both ![](/data/assets/guide/8fd604ed67d2d5bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkunai.png)Kunai and ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda. If a Barrier is between Kiri and her allies, Kunai deals far too little damage to destroy it. She needs to take the extra time to constantly reposition and play around barriers.

weaknesses.title: Difficult to use primary fire
content: The slow travel speed, rate of fire, and low damage of ![](/data/assets/guide/8fd604ed67d2d5bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkunai.png)Kunai hinder Kiri’s offensive prowess. Landing headshots brings big value but is very inconsistent, even for the best aimers.

play_against_summary: * Force out ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)Swift Step or ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu early, then re-engage while those cooldowns are unavailable.
* Pressure her from multiple angles to deny safe teleport targets and limit her escape options.

* Treat ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush like the best offensive ult the enemy team has. Save defensive utility to survive, retreat when possible, or use your own ultimates to prevent her from overwhelming your team.

minor.title: Urgent Care
content: _“Healing Ofuda projectile speed is increased by 50% when seeking critical health allies.”_
* Take if you’ve already noticed your team demanding a lot of healing.
* * Receiving healing sooner when at critical health can mean the difference between life or death for your ally. The farther they are from you, the greater benefit the Perk gives.
minor.name: Urgent Care
minor.description: Healing Ofuda projectile speed is increased by 50% when seeking critical health allies.

minor.title: Fortune Teller
content: _“Kunai hits launch 2 Healing Ofuda to an ally in front of you.”_
* Free healing when attacking
* * If you are able to be aggressive and attack frequently, Fortune Teller is the better Perk to take.

* With the Fortune teller perk, it's worth shooting two Kunai between every ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda. For a slight delay in primary fire, she has the chance to deal damage and increase healing potential from the extra 2 Ofudas per hit.
minor.name: Fortune Teller
minor.description: Kunai hits launch 2 Healing Ofuda to an ally in front of you.

major.title: Ready Step
content: _“Swift Step grants Kiriko 40% increased attack and reload speed for 3 seconds."_
* When selecting Ready Step, your dives become more lethal. Wait to TP to your ally until they need assistance with an elimination.

* Be smart. strengths.title: Lock-on healing
content: When playing with high mobility allies, ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's lock-on primary fire makes a big difference in how consistently your allies will be receiving healing. Also, you don’t have to focus much on aiming and can give more attention to hero positioning and strategy.

strengths.title: Team verticality
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/d747d16d3747ce4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpetal-platform.png)Petal Platform has the unique ability to give vertical access to heroes who would have no other way of reaching high ground. It can be used multiple times in a row, so anyone who needs it can activate the Petal once placed. Even raising up the enemy can be the disruption your team needs to win a fight.

strengths.title: Instant save
content: Life Grip is the easiest way to instantly save an ally. No other Support ability has the ease and consistency of Life Grip when it comes to pulling a teammate from the grips of death.

weaknesses.title: Weak against dive
content: When a team running a dive comp sees the enemy is playing ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver, they just see a free kill every fight. Diving Lifeweaver poses no direct threat to the enemy as he primarily relies on evasion and team peel to survive.

weaknesses.title: Single-target abilities
content: Other than Tree of Life, all his cooldowns are single-target focused abilities. He can only heal one person at a time, and Life Grip’s long cooldown generally means only one teammate is getting saved per fight.

weaknesses.title: Struggles to be proactive
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's kit is very reaction-oriented. To get the most value out of his abilities, he has to wait for the other team to make a play and try to counter. While you can get creative, he lacks the playmaking potential that the other Supports possess. If your team isn’t making it happen, Lifeweaver struggles to force the win.

major.title: Superbloom
content: * The math

* * In 2.5 seconds, ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver will fire 55 thorns, and you need to land 16 of those to trigger the detonation.
* You miss ~1/3 of your shots and still trigger Superbloom.
* Self defense

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's attack pressure is pretty low, and the extra incremental burst damage is useful when forced into duels.
* Anti-tank
* * Especially against non-barrier Tanks who can’t block your attacks, you can pump Thorn Volleys into their large bodies and trigger Superbloom detonations over and over.
* Pair with another high healing output Support
* * When you want to focus more on damage, play with another high-healing Support. If your other Support is Zen, for example, your team can’t afford for you to be spending time triggering Superbloom.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
The best maps to pick Lucio on are those with lots of flat ground or a lot of space to cover. The team with Lucio will always be able to move and reposition faster than the team without, so maps with a lot of area to walk give more opportunity to benefit from the speed boost.
Also, maps with ledges near the objective create to possibility of instant kills by booping them off the map.
The maps where he struggles the most are those with long, narrow sight lines where the enemy has more time to attack him during his approach. Lucio himself does well on maps with strong high ground areas, but the teammates who benefit the most from speed boost tend to be weaker on those maps.

play_as: * Speed in your Tank. If your Tank is a brawl style Tank, speed boost enables them to close the gap on the enemy and run them over.

* Keep your allies in your aura. The indicator in the center of your screen tells you how many allies are being affected by ![](/data/assets/guide/646d7b1b049a69e3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcrossfade.png)Crossfade. Make sure to keep that number high.
* Protect your backline. Lucio’s speed and knockback allow him to be a great protector of his backline from enemy flanks and dives. Speed over and help with a counterattack.
play_against: * Knockback or stun him. Anything that stops or slows his momentum makes Lucio easier to eliminate.

* When you see Lucio use ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier try to disengage from the fight and wait out the overhealth instead of trying to fight through it.
* If you keep getting run over by Lucio’s team, pick heroes with good mobility. Their speed won’t matter if you can escape their attack.
team_comp_synergies: Team comps built around Lucio are equipped to take full advantage of his speed boost. Close range and melee heroes generally receive the most benefit from speed boost because they depend on getting close to the enemy to be effective.
Poke heavy comps can work with Lucio as well, but his speed will be used more often for defensive spacing and rotations instead of offensive approaches.

Lucio typically needs another Support with high healing output and burst healing capabilities to make up for his lack of sustain. In these teams, Lucio also functions as a backline protector by using his quick movement and knockback to keep his allies safe from enemy flankers.

strengths_weaknesses_summarized: * Doesn't need a lot of resources

strengths.title: Opportunist
content: With unmatched speed, Lucio can quickly react and move. Good Lucio players often wait for opportune moments, such as seeing the enemy use their defensive cooldowns, then speed boost themselves and their team in for the kill.

strengths.title: Large AoE abilities
content: Unlike many other Supports who can only assist one ally at a time, Lucio’s abilities can affect his entire team at once. Healing, speed boost, and ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier all have generous AoE and get huge value when his team is all playing grouped up.

strengths.title: Low demand for team resources
content: Riding vertically on walls, moving quickly and constantly changing up his positioning makes Lucio difficult for the enemy to target. Because of this, he doesn’t demand healing, damage mitigation, or protection resources from his team. The rest of his team can worry about themselves and use their abilities more offensively when Lucio is their Support.

weaknesses.title: High skill ceiling
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/808dcefc7ac05287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwall-ride.png)Wall Ride forward, backwards, in place, through windows, rollouts, and jump spots give Lucio nearly unlimited hero-specific tech. To maximize your Lucio play, you must dedicate many hours to fine-tuning your movement mechanics. He’s easy to pick up, but difficult to master.

weaknesses.title: Needs team coordination
content: You’re probably not a Reddit Lucio who can go off on their own and solo kill the entire enemy team one by one. So instead, you’re going to need your team to work as a unit to succeed. It doesn’t matter how good your timing is if no one moves in to attack during Amp it Up speed boost.

weaknesses.title: Close range LoS
content: Lucio can’t assist his team unless he’s within the 12m radius of ![](/data/assets/guide/646d7b1b049a69e3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcrossfade.png)Crossfade and there are no barriers or structures in his way. To maximize the value of his song aura, he needs to be positioned near his allies. Since the Tank typically needs speed boost the most, this means Lucio ends up front and in the open, where the enemy team can target him.

play_against_summary: * Knockback or stun him. Anything that stops or slows his momentum makes Lucio easier to eliminate.

* When you see Lucio use ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier try to disengage from the fight and wait out the overhealth instead of trying to fight through it.
