* If you keep getting run over by Lucio’s team, pick heroes with good mobility. Their speed won’t matter if you can escape their attack.

minor.title: Soundwave Rider
content: **Bass Blowout**
* Higher Value Minor Perk
* * Lucio can benefit from Bass Blowout every four seconds.
* Against dive, brawl, and rush comps, 100% take Bass Blowout as the extra knockback distance will keep you and your team safer.
* Easier environmental kills
* * On maps with lots of ledges, Bass Blowout makes knocking people off the map even more consistent.
minor.name: Soundwave Rider
minor.description: Wall Riding empowers your next Soundwave, increasing its knockback by 25% and damage by 50%.

minor.title: Beat Drop
content: * Stack Amp it Up uses

* * Use Amp it up before ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to maximize your benefit of Beat Drop.
* Amp it up lasts 6 seconds, and Amp it Up’s cooldown is 12 seconds. At most, you’ll only have to wait 6 seconds before another Amp it Up is available.
minor.name: Beat Drop
minor.description: Amp It Up is active during Sound Barrier.

major.title: Noise Violation
content: * Good in teams that are more spread out. If your team is running a lot of poke heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, and ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)Freja, you’ll be more likely to get them all in your AoE with Noise Violation.
* Lucio’s playstyle and positioning caters to allies who need speed boost the most already, so the extra Amp range isn’t really necessary.
major.name: Noise Violation
major.description: Crossfade's range is increased by 150% while Amp It Up is active.

major.title: Accelerando
content: * Better for aggressive Lucio players
* * When you solo or team speed into the enemy team, 50% attack speed can be the difference between getting an elim or your target surviving long enough to kill you.
* If you try for a lot of aggressive plays, or dive the enemy DPS and Supports, you should be running Accelerando.
major.name: Accelerando
major.description: Lucio’s attack speed is increased by 50% while Amp It Up is active.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga have small but open objective areas. If the objective is broken up by too much natural cover, it's easy for the enemy to rotate around him since he moves so slowly while firing both chainguns. Other Tanks can’t go toe-to-toe with ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga, so he excels on objectives that pull teams into close-range fights. The maps ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga struggles most on are those with lots of high ground, where dive comps are dominant. He has no vertical mobility, so ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun gets little to no value against enemies who can run away to high ground he can’t reach. The same can be said of maps with huge open areas where the enemy can keep their distance from ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga.

play_as: * Focus the enemy Tank. Double chainguns are the perfect Tank-busting weapon. Try to keep the enemy Tank close and run after them if they try to get away.

* Don’t always use ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun to hard engage; go for knockdowns instead. Mix it up by cancelling mid-run to stay with your team and bait out the enemy's cooldowns.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)Cage Fight prevents all movement abilities, so focus on trapping high mobility heroes.
play_against: * Save your damage mitigation or mobility abilities to prevent him from damaging you during ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga can’t be stopped during ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun. Position out of his charge range, or prepare to dodge him.

* When he has ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)Cage Fight ready, either play spread so you don’t get caught, or get everyone inside so you and your team can help each other survive the ult.
team_comp_synergies: Team comps built around ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga can support his all-out aggressive plays. ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga gets hard-focused by the enemy. Outside of a few seconds of ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive's damage reduction, he has no protection from damage. Due to this, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga requires a lot of team resources to be allocated to him, so he works best with heroes who are self-sufficient. Allies also need to be able to quickly react to ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's Overrun since he sometimes uses it to bait, and sometimes goes deep for a hard engage. Lastly, the best teammates position themselves somewhat close to ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, within the 10m range.
**Example of a team comp built around Mauga:**

* **Tank**: ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga, ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya (for 6v6)

* **DPS**: ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper

* **Supports**: ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko, ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana

strengths.title: Tank Buster
content: No Tank wants to duel ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga. The best ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga Tank counters are those who can mitigate his damage during ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive. No Tank can outdamage or out-sustain him on their own. When the enemy Tank is carrying, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga can shut them all down.

strengths.title: Self-sustain
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)Berserker passive constantly grants overhealth from critical hits and burning targets. ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive’s life steal and damage reduction make you nearly unkillable for 3 seconds. Although he takes a lot of damage, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga has strong self-agency in managing his health pool.

strengths.title: CC immunity
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun is the only Tank ability that makes you completely unstoppable and even unable to be Hacked. You can time ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun to counter enemy stuns and interrupt some movement abilities.

weaknesses.title: Relies on dealing damage to survive
content: Because ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's healing is based on damage dealt and being able to ignite enemies, abilities that mitigate damage or grant invulnerability counter him. Against teams with barriers or fast and small heroes, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga deals less damage overall, which translates into less survivability.

weaknesses.title: No vertical mobility
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun can be used for decent horizontal mobility, but ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga can’t deal with enemies on high ground. He can shoot them, but is then limited to single chaingun use because of the massive bullet spread using double.

weaknesses.title: Easy to avoid
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's movement is very linear. ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun's path can only be altered to a small degree, but when he’s firing both chainguns, he moves incredibly slowly. These make him easy to avoid, which is especially problematic given that his best ability has a short 3-second duration.

play_against_summary: * Save your damage mitigation or mobility abilities to prevent him from damaging you during ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga can’t be stopped during ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun. Position out of his charge range, or prepare to dodge him.

* When he has ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)Cage Fight ready, either play spread so you don’t get caught, or get everyone inside so you and your team can help each other survive the ult.

minor.title: Kinetic Bandolier
content: * Niche

* * In most scenarios where you’ve run out of ammo, you’ll also have used ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive and won’t have enough health to charge straight into the enemy to keep attacking.
* Plus, in these cases, you also won’t be running the full distance and therefore won’t get the max 150 ammo reloaded.
* Less downtime

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's reload animation is much longer than most, so cutting down reload time is beneficial.
* Useful into poke and dive comps where you spend more time poking, then suddenly need to rush in.
minor.name: Kinetic Bandolier
minor.description: Overrun reloads up to 150 ammo during the first second of charging.

minor.title: Pyromaniac
content: * Adds a small burst of instant overhealth whenever you ignite an enemy. Good for survivability, and best when having to play more passively.
minor.name: Pyromaniac
minor.description: Igniting enemies with Incendiary Chaingun grants 50 overhealth.

major.title: Firewalker
content: * Best Major Perk

* * Ignited enemies take 15 damage per second, and can immediately be auto-crit by Cha-Cha. Since ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga is unstoppable during Overrun, he can easily ignite multiple enemies with each use.
* Burst damage

* * Slam onto an enemy, and they're instantly ignited. If you center slam their head, you’ll even get healing from the slam's critical hit. Plus, you’ll be dealing damage faster because you don’t have to spend time igniting them with primary fire before getting in the auto-crits.
major.name: Firewalker
major.description: Overrun ignites enemies hit.

major.title: Combat Fuel
content: * Don’t need the extra Overhealth

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga heals himself and reduces so much damage that you won’t even notice 100 extra Overhealth during Overdrive.
* Plus, you need to land 50 critical hits in between each use? Realistically, you’ll probably be averaging 50-60 overhealth with each Cardiac use.
* Soft counter to anti-healing and damage mitigation

* * Where Combat Fuel can be useful is in matchups with anti-heal like ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana nade, or Tanks who can mitigate your entire Cardiac duration. The extra overhealth could theoretically keep you alive.
* Still recommend always selecting Firewalker.
major.name: Combat Fuel
major.description: Critical hits grant Mauga 3 temporary overhealth on Cardiac Overdrive's next use, up to 150 overhealth.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei tends to have an easier time finding value on non-payload maps. The stationary objectives of Control, Flashpoint, and Clash naturally have chokepoints for Mei to Wall off.
Regardless of the game mode, Mei likes maps with tight spaces and wants to avoid wide open spaces at all costs. Icicle gives her decent poke pressure, but she’s at a clear disadvantage against snipers on long sight lines. Since she lacks mobility, she also struggles on maps that favor dive and have a lot of high ground.

play_as: * Isolate the enemy Tank from their team by placing ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall right behind them.

* When Ice Wall and ![](/data/assets/guide/d3098a7cd908d5b1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcryo-freeze.png)Cryo-Freeze are both on cooldown, stay near your allies and away from the enemy.
* Use Ice Wall as a shield to protect yourself. It’s great for cutting off enemy LoS and keeping you and your team safe.
play_against: * Break her wall! Shoot a single pillar to quickly create an opening for trapped teammates to walk through.

* Play around her cooldowns. When she has ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall, don’t casually walk through a choke and get walled off. Wait until she’s used it before pushing up.
* Stay outside her primary fire range. Her secondary fire range is less consistent and easier to deal with.
team_comp_synergies: The biggest component of a team composition that helps ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei perform well is a strong frontline. Because she has limited range on her primary fire and wall, she wants her Tank to hold the front, so she can safely push up with them. Tanks like ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa and ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina all do this job well.

Also, when she uses ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall to split off the enemy, each of these can slam the enemy into the wall for a quick kill before the enemy has a chance to break wall.

For the rest of the team, it's mostly based on map and the enemy team comp. If they have fliers, she wants a hitscan as the other DPS, if the enemy is running dives, she wants Supports who can escape the dive on their own.

strengths.title: Divide and conquer
content: The main reason to pick Mei is for ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall. Splitting off enemies from their team is often the quickest and most consistent way to win fights.

strengths.title: Controls space
content: Mei’s presence and threat of Ice Wall are good for holding choke points and controlling areas. Anytime the enemy wants to get close, they’ll have to plan how to survive her primary fire, Ice Wall, and ![](/data/assets/guide/7578824db04164d2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblizzard.png)Blizzard.

strengths.title: Adaptable kit
content: She can be a frontliner, ranged poke, and an anti-dive hero. Mei’s kit allows her to adapt to what her team needs based on team comps and map selection.

weaknesses.title: Feast or Famine
content: Abilities like Ice Wall, ![](/data/assets/guide/7578824db04164d2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblizzard.png)Blizzard, and ![](/data/assets/guide/6f0829d84c10e9e2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fendothermic-blaster.png)Endothermic Blaster are either massive value or zero value. A poorly placed Ice Wall does nothing, and if you can’t hit secondary fire consistently, you’re contributing nothing to the fight.

weaknesses.title: Low damage
content: Damage output is not her strong suit. Sometimes this leads to slow Ult building and falling behind in Ult economy. If you aren’t getting elims from Ice Wall, you should probably swap off Mei.

weaknesses.title: No mobility
content: Other than using Ice Wall as an elevator, Mei has no mobility whatsoever. She can protect herself, but she can’t escape, reposition quickly, or chase down retreating enemies.

play_against_summary: * Break her wall! Shoot a single pillar to quickly create an opening for trapped teammates to walk through.

* Play around her cooldowns. When she has ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall, don’t casually walk through a choke and get walled off. Wait until she’s used it before pushing up.
* Stay outside her primary fire range. Her secondary fire range is less consistent and easier to deal with.

minor.title: Skating Rink
content: * Adds a defensive benefit to your Ult.

* Even if half the enemy team is not frozen and can shoot you, you can wall them, heal up yourself and your team while eliminating the enemies that are frozen. Then you have an easy clean up against those left.

* Good for survivine damage over time and so you don't have to spend so much time in ![](/data/assets/guide/d3098a7cd908d5b1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcryo-freeze.png)Cryo-Freeze during your ult.
minor.name: Skating Rink
minor.description: Allies within Blizzard gain 25% increased movement speed and heal for 50 health per second.

minor.title: Glacial Propulsion
content: * Best use is for taking and contesting high ground areas.
* Has a low maximum height, so you can't jump off high ground and activate it to get an extra boost.

* Especially good on high maps with a bit of high ground like King's Row and Blizzard World where ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei normally has a weakness against heroes with vertical mobility.
minor.name: Glacial Propulsion
minor.description: Double jumping creates a small ice pillar that launches Mei into the air.

major.title: Deep Freeze
content: * Play close and hold corners
* * The ability to freeze enemies means you’ll want to spend as much time in primary fire range as possible. Position up front with your tank, or find enemies you can flank.
* When defending, stay at the choke and any corners. This forces close-range fights. Anyone who approaches you has to deal with the threat of being frozen, on top of getting walled off.
* Anti-Dive
* * Freezing any dive DPS is a death sentence for them. When the enemy team has mobility heroes giving you a hard time, shut them down with the Deep Freeze.
major.name: Deep Freeze
major.description: Continuously hitting enemies with primary fire freezes them for a short time.

major.title: Cryo-Storm
content: * Big damage potential
* * Cryo-Storm deals 70 damage every second for up to 350 damage total.
* Try to trap an enemy in a corner or between Ice Wall and Cryo-storm.
* Block doorways
* * As noted in the Cryo-Freeze tips, blocking doorways is very strong for capturing and stalling objectives. Cryo-Storm adds damage as well, making the tactic even better!
* Ult charge
* * The extra damage Mei deals from Cryo-Storm adds up to a lot of extra ult generation over the course of a game. This is especially true when getting multiple enemies in your AoE.
* Blizzard combo
* * Similar to your primary fire, the slow effect of Cryo-Storm will speed up the freeze effect of Blizzard.
* The tech is OP since Mei’s invincible and slows enemies too fast for them to escape by walking out.
major.name: Cryo-Storm
major.description: Cryo-Freeze slows and deals 70 damage per second to nearby enemies.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy's best maps have lots of space for her to move around. In tight or cramped map areas, she has difficulty evading the enemy. She never wants to be close to the enemy, so always try to find areas that allow you to keep your distance, no matter the map. Because she pairs so well with ranged DPS like Ashe and Sojourn, ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy also works great on maps with long sight lines where these heroes are strong.

play_as: * Pocket the win condition. Always be on the lookout for who on your team is going for the all-in, win-or-lose play, and stay on them.
* Manage beam usage. If everyone has a lot of health, stay on Damage Boost until someone needs healing to live and attack.

* Use your movement to survive. ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy can’t defend herself, so you have to be evasive through Guardian Angel movement.
play_against: * Don’t let her get off free resurrections. If her teammate dies, expect her to be looking for an opportunity to rez. Be ready to punish her.
* Bait out Guardian Angel without using your movement ability. Then chase her for the kill.

* Target ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy . Eliminating Mercy first is more efficient than trying to kill her allies through her healing.
team_comp_synergies: The best comps for ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy tend to be poke-heavy since she can sit back and damage boost to give her allies the advantage. Other than during ![](/data/assets/guide/7df3cd0fb86c3ebf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvalkyrie.png)Valkyrie, she's limited to single-target healing, so brawly team comps have the worst team synergy.

The best Tanks are those that can survive without needing constant healing, and get benefits from short bursts of damage boost. Tanks like ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma fit both of these, and he's a staple of poke compositions.

For DPS, burst damage and pocketing the carry are where Mercy truly shines. Pretty much whichever hitscan or ranged DPS is on her team (e.g., ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn, ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)Widowmaker, ![](/data/assets/guide/e4d3354cf66c9e62.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Femre.png)Emre, ![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy, etc.) can have a Mercy attached to them and carry the whole team.

Of course, a shoutout must be given to ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah and ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo for the flying Mercy pocket. Unless the enemy team goes multiple counters, these duos are extremely difficult to deal with.

Generally, Mercy wants her other Support to have AoE healing to complement her single-target healing. Pretty much anyone other than ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari can provide enough sustain to pair with Mercy. These can work as well, but her team needs to be playing an all out offense and winning team fights quickly.

strengths.title: High reward plays
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy's whole playstyle is all about managing risk and reward. Going for a rez is always risky, but the payoff of instantly having your teammates back is massive. Additionally, pocketing an ally empowers them to get away with riskier plays than usual. A ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn, for example, can’t survive on a deep flank by herself, but with a Mercy pocket, she could wipe the whole enemy team.

strengths.title: Numbers advantage
content: Rez effectively forces the enemy to earn one more elimination than your team every fight. A resurrection completely negates the effect of whatever abilities and resources were invested to get the kill.

strengths.title: High survivability
content: Even though ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy doesn’t have any CC and no invincibility, she’s very difficult to kill. Guardian Angel makes her evasive and challenging to track or chase. She’s also healing herself anytime she’s healing an ally, and has the Support passive to self-heal as well.

weaknesses.title: Team reliant
content: No matter how insane your ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy play is, you still need your team to be securing eliminations. Mercy isn’t the kind of hero who can carry a team's poor performance. She can damage boost an ally all game, but if they're not landing meaningful damage, it doesn’t do much.

weaknesses.title: Poor self-defense
content: When ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy is being attacked, she’s primarily reliant on her allies to either defend her, or be in range to use Guardian Angel to escape. If she’s ever caught out on her own, or no one is helping her, she has almost zero chance of winning a 1v1 duel.

weaknesses.title: Single target assistance
content: Depending on her team's 2nd Support, the single-target nature of ![](/data/assets/guide/2c81fb62b0b54490.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcaduceus-staff.png)Caduceus Staff can be a major disadvantage. If multiple members of her team need healing all at once, they’re gonna have to get in line because outside of her Ult, ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy can only heal one at a time. Same goes for damage boost, if two teammates are making a play together, you have to pick just one to boost.

play_against_summary: * Don’t let her get off free resurrections. If her teammate dies, expect her to be looking for an opportunity to rez. Be ready to punish her.
* Bait out Guardian Angel without using your movement ability. Then chase her for the kill.

* Target ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy . Eliminating Mercy first is more efficient than trying to kill her allies through her healing.

minor.title: Angelic Resurrection
content: * Considering how impactful Resurrect is, but also how vulnerable ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy becomes during it, the Overhealth can be the difference between a won and lost game.
minor.name: Angelic Resurrection
minor.description: Mercy gains 100 overhealth after casting Resurrect.

minor.title: Divine Momentum
content: * Counter dive

* * Against teams that are running dive comps or have people constantly flanking and targeting you, the extra distance ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy travels by bunny hopping or crouch jumping can be your only means of survival
minor.name: Divine Momentum
minor.description: Increases Mercy's travel speed by 15% after cancelling Guardian Angel.

major.title: Chain Boost
content: * Good in poke and brawl
* * First off, you need two allies to be playing near each other most of the game. Secondly, you want both of those heroes to have kits that benefit from damage boost.
* If your team is running two ranged heroes, Chain Boost is great for increasing their pressure and threat.
* When your team is running a brawl comp, Chain Boost makes their deathball more lethal and helps them run over the enemy more aggressively.
major.name: Chain Boost
major.description: Secondary fire links to a second nearby ally.

major.title: Flash Heal
content: * Wait for your target to be below half health.
* * Never waste the 15-second cooldown on the base 50 healing. Always wait to get the triple healing on low HP allies.
* More time to damage boost
* * The burst healing cuts down the amount of time you need to spend healing a low-health ally, thus increasing the amount of time you can spend damage boosting.
major.name: Flash Heal
major.description: Flash heal can be used on Caduceus Staff's active target to restore 50 health, tripled on allies below half health.

play_as: * Prioritize healing resource management by consistantly finding opportunites to deal damage before critical teamfight moments.

* Use ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade reactively to escape crowd control abilities and enemy attacks. Reposition to a safer position where the enemy can't easily chase you.
* Throw Biotic Orbs with intention. Damage orbs are good for pressuring squishy targets during fights, but only use them when you have plenty of healing resources available.
play_against: * Track her ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade cooldown and pressure her aggressively once it has been used, as she is highly vulnerable without mobility.
* Avoid giving her free resource generation by minimizing unnecessary poke damage and positioning outside of her Biotic Grasp range.

* Focus her during ![](/data/assets/guide/c2024d883333803a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoalescence.png)Coalescence with burst damage or crowd control, she'll either be forced to Fade away, or be vulnerable to elimination during the ult.
specific_counters_81: ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va

* The mech flying Pro Gamer is the hardest counter to Moira. Defense Matrix easily eats every damage orb sent to her team, and D.Va can also fly in, eat heal orbs, and fly out. Booster’s cooldown is even shorter than Fade, making D.Va one of the best Moira killers around.
![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer

* Tracer's horizontal mobility far outclasses Moira’s. Three blinks can easily chase down Moira, no matter where she Fades to, and recall, let's Tracer get out after confirming the kill. At close range, Tracer melts Moira way faster than her Biotic Orb can heal her. Although Biotic Grasp makes damaging Tracer easy, Moira has no way to shut down Tracer or deal with Tracer harassing her allies.
![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana

* Anti-Nade is basically a death sentence against any ally that Moira is trying to keep alive. ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira has zero counterplay to Anti-Nade. Furthermore, you may be surprised at how often Ana players hit sleeps on an ulting Moira. Sleep Dart also makes it extremely dangerous for Moira to go in deep.
team_comp_synergies: The best team comps to play ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira in like to be grouped together as often as possible. This allows Moira to maximize healing output and farm her ult extremely quickly. The team also benefits from constantly receiving healing. On the other hand, Moira’s flexible kit also enables her to do well with dive comps since she can follow up on their aggression or survive on her own when the rest of the team spreads out.
**Example of a team comp built around Moira:**

* ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya, ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)Junkrat, ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira, ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio

strengths.title: Self-Reliant
content: Technically there are three ways for ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira to heal herself: Biotic Grasp damage self-heal, Biotic healing orb, and the Support heal passive.

Specifically for Moira, the heal passive becomes incredibly useful given that she can escape almost any encounter with ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade, and let the passive heal her up.

Never need to rely on her other Support for healing. When being attacked, Moira can easily disengage with ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade instead of needing to call for help.

strengths.title: Flexibility and Mobility
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade's short cooldown gives ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira the opportunity to quickly approach a target either alone or with an ally, then just 6 seconds later, escape to safety.

Close-range AoE healing of Biotic Grasp makes ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira great at playing behind her team and healing everyone together. Biotic Orb's infinite range allows her to provide support from any distance to teammates far away.

Also really strong in 1v1 duels. ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira basically never misses damage with Biotic Grasp’s auto tracking, simultaneously deals 65 Dmg and 30 HP of self-healing every second, and can output a burst of either damage or healing from Biotic Orb based on the situation.

strengths.title: Insanely high damage, healing, and elim stats
content: Very often you will see a ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira player have every top stat in a game. Biotic Orb is best used immediately off cooldown which has Moira sending out AoE damage or healing every 8 seconds!
A damage orb is also a great tool for confirming elims on low health targets,
AoE heal and lingering heal over time of primary fire make Moira unmatched in healing numbers on a team that plays closely grouped up.

weaknesses.title: Lacks any Utility Abilities
content: Other Supports have highly impactful utility abilities such as ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu, Anti-Nade, and ![](/data/assets/guide/3adb743da6c064fe.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fimmortality-field.png)Immortality Field. Compared to these abilities, ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira can only provide a moderate but consistent amount of help to her team at any given time whereas other Supports have single buttons that can save an entire team fight and game.

weaknesses.title: Predictability
content: Moira’s ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade use can become predictable to enemies, and when they catch her without ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade, she’s an easy pick.

weaknesses.title: Low DPS
content: While her total damage output is great, ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira can't critical hit and has no way to instantly apply huge damage to an enemy. If Moira’s target is being healed by an enemy Support, they often heal through any damage she can do.

play_against_summary: * Track her ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade cooldown and pressure her aggressively once it has been used, as she is highly vulnerable without mobility.
* Avoid giving her free resource generation by minimizing unnecessary poke damage and positioning outside of her Biotic Grasp range.

* Focus her during ![](/data/assets/guide/c2024d883333803a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoalescence.png)Coalescence with burst damage or crowd control, she'll either be forced to Fade away, or be vulnerable to elimination during the ult.

minor.title: Destruction's Divide
content: * Good for optimizing her Ult’s purpose. Especially if you like to dive in and use ![](/data/assets/guide/c2024d883333803a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoalescence.png)Coalescenceoffensively.
minor.name: Destruction's Divide
minor.description: Coalescence can be toggled between pure healing or pure damage, with 30% greater effect.

minor.title: Ethical Nourishment
content: * Amazing for giving ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira burst healing. Much more consistent value than Destruction’s Divide.
minor.name: Ethical Nourishment
minor.description: Biotic Orb’s first 30 healing is instant on each ally it encounters.

major.title: Reversal
content: * Gives you control over orbs. Use this to keep enemies attached and damage, or give your allies healing for longer.
major.name: Reversal
major.description: Reactivating Biotic Orb reverses its direction.

major.title: Phantom Step
content: * Good mobility. Best against dive comps to give you better escapes.
* Also enables more aggressive dive playtsyle for yourself since you have better access to high ground areas.
major.name: Phantom Step
major.description: Fade lasts 0.5 seconds longer and boosts jump height by 50%.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is always going to be a good choice on maps that favor poke comps. An objective area with wide-open space and long, straight payload routes that play into her strengths. Because she’s very tanky, she’s not bad on small maps either, but it makes it harder for her to execute her keepaway game plan. She can contest high ground with her ranged damage, but she can’t ever access the high ground herself, so she’s also at a disadvantage on maps with lots of high ground that favor dive comps.

play_as: * Rotate and maintain distance. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa should always move around the objective with her team, trying to keep the enemy team away.

* Don’t use all her abilities together. Use just ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin, then after it ends, use ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify, then ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin. Using them together greatly reduces her survivability.

* Always play near cover. Because there will always be gaps between ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify uses, ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa needs cover to hide behind to stay alive.
play_against: * Ignore ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa. The best way to counter ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is to avoid her and target the rest of her team. She’ll try to stop you, but she can’t chase you down.

* Wait out ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify. If you see her golden, either hide so you don’t take damage, or switch targets, and attack someone else.

* Go beams. If all else fails, the easiest way to counter ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is to play a beam hero. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is free ult charge to them.
team_comp_synergies: Pair ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa with other poke heroes and shut down the enemy team before they can even get close to your team. She's also an excellent protector, so when the enemy team is running dive or rush, she can be a nuisance to them, stop all CC, knock them around, and keep her team safe to attack freely.

Since she's pretty stationary, it's easy for Supports like ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste and ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari to keep her health nice and full.

strengths.title: Fortify
content: Becoming unstoppable and reducing all incoming damage by nearly half is ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa's greatest strength. She's the only tank who can simultaneously be CC immune while walking forward and attacking.

strengths.title: Great counterpick
content: Lore accurate, she counters ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist through her crowd control, and with ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify's knockback immunity. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is also an excellent counterswap to shut down ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra, ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog, and ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard.

strengths.title: Ranged damage
content: Most tanks have either very low or zero long-range damage. In the poke phases of fights, or from medium to long distance, ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa will be bringing more value to her team than any other Tank.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to beams
content: Because ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin does not block beam damage like ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya and ![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)Symmetra, ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa becomes weak against beams anytime she doesn't have ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify available.

weaknesses.title: No team damage mitigation
content: Unlike most other Tanks, ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa doesn't provide any overhealth or barriers for her team. She can only absorb attacks with her own body or ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin, but doesn't directly bring any extra survivability to her teammates.

weaknesses.title: Immobile
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa's biggest weakness is being slowed while firing, having no vertical mobility, and just a tiny bit of movement buff from ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin. Heroes with a lot of mobility can simply avoid ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa, and she can't do much about it.

play_against_summary: * Ignore ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa. The best way to counter ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is to avoid her and target the rest of her team. She’ll try to stop you, but she can’t chase you down.

* Wait out ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify. If you see her golden, either hide so you don’t take damage, or switch targets, and attack someone else.

* Go beams. If all else fails, the easiest way to counter ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is to play a beam hero. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is free ult charge to them.

minor.title: Defense Protocol
content: * Makes ![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)Terra Surge an ok panic button. The healing will help you take more damage, and can save you when you are at low health.
minor.name: Defense Protocol
minor.description: Regenerate 100 health per second while charging Terra Surge.

minor.title: Mobile Fortification
content: * Very powerful and enables aggressive play when ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is already at her most powerful. Feels unstoppable to the enemy team.
minor.name: Mobile Fortification
minor.description: While Fortify is active, Orisa has no movement speed reduction and no heat generation.

major.title: Charged Javelin
content: * Overall, the better Major Perk

* * In most scenarios, having to give up ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin is not worth the barrier. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is already very tanky, and ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin blocks all projectiles for almost 2 seconds. Moreover, the speed boost during and after, plus the CC is stronger than having a shield.
major.name: Charged Javelin
major.description: Energy Javelin can be charged to increase projectile speed and knockback. Pierces enemies at full power.

major.title: Protective Barrier
content: * Match up dependent

* * Against ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga, it could be considered the better Major Perk since it can be used to help counter ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* Against ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya, deploy a barrier anytime she uses bubble to block her damage and relieve the pressure of needing to break her barrier and charge her.

* In theory, you can use the Barrier to block ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra's ult LoS and try to end it early. The 600HP barrier may not survive long enough to rely on this tech, however.
* Double Barrier tip
* * When on defense or when the enemy team is returning from spawn, shoot the Barrier straight up. By the time it lands, you’ll only have 3 seconds before your next Barrier.
major.name: Protective Barrier
major.description: Javelin Spin is replaced with a barrier.

play_as: * Use natural cover from vertical map geometry such as walls and buildings to avoid exposing yourself to hitscan pressure.
* Play around off-angles and on highground so you can spam choke points with crossfire from your team.

* Use ![](/data/assets/guide/bdc23f8912816520.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrage.png)Barrage from unexpected positions or when coordinated with protection from an ally, such as a ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier or ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix.
play_against: * The best way to deal with ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah is to play a hitscan with range and burst damage like ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe or ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari.
* Deny her safe air space by controlling high ground and forcing her to play predictable sightlines.
* Track her Barrage and hold defensive cooldowns or burst abilities to punish her immediately when she commits. A slight delay will make the difference between dying and taking her out.
specific_counters_81: ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga

* When playing Tank, Mauga is your best choice for dealing with Pharah. Not only does his hitscan primary fire track on a flying Pharah really well, but once ignited, the extra 2 seconds of damage over time further delays her universal self heal passive from kicking in, thus keeping Pharah out of the fight for longer.
**All Hitscan DPS**

* Which of the Hitscan DPS will be the best counter against Pharah depends on Map and player preference. Long sightline maps like Circuit Royal make Ashe and Widow the best choices. Closer range maps like Arctic Peninsula are better suited to Cassidy or Soldier: 76. The main thing is to understand your heroes' damage fall off ranges and where to position to maximize damage output on the enemy Pharah.
![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste

* Baptiste can burn down Pharah with a few quick bursts of his primary fire. His Exo Boots keep him off the ground and in the air where Pharah has a difficult time landing rockets. Immortality Field is also a strong tool for keeping himself and his teammates alive against Pharah’s rockets and can give extra survivability time to a Barrage for the team to react and shut down the ult.
team_comp_synergies: Pharah’s newfound independence and adaptability allow her to be an effective member of any type of team composition. The ability to stay with her team and poke, or keep up any team's speed and movement mean Pharah is more map dependent than team comp dependent. Dive comps suit her best, however, and enable Pharah to get optimal use of every aspect of her kit. She can support team dives from long range with her rockets, or with a deep off angle flank. In either scenario, Pharah can be used to deal damage that the rest of her team follows up on and confirms elims, or as the one who is following up and getting the final blows.

strengths.title: Vertical mobility
content: The ability to take to the sky, fly over buildings, and remain in the air puts Pharah in a league of her own in controlling the vertical plane. For enemies shooting at Pharah, adjusting their aim vertically is generally accepted as being more difficult than horizontal adjustments. Correct usage of ![](/data/assets/guide/3ec5c760c0f9e4e4.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhover-jets.png)Hover Jets and ![](/data/assets/guide/b259920bedbf88ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-jet.png)Jump Jet creates consistent pressure from angles that only Pharah can position herself in.

Just the dividing of attention from the enemy team can be enough to make a team with a good Pharah playing feel unstoppable. Her vertical movement also allows her to create pathing options over environments that would typically not be possible for most of the cast.

strengths.title: Excellent at using cover
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/ce38aca322038472.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-launcher.png)Rocket Launcher’s slow rate of fire makes Pharah excel at quickly peeking in and out of cover, only exposing herself while firing a rocket. When grounded, she can do this by strafing around a wall. In the air, Hover Jets allow Pharah to use the tops of buildings and structures to peek above, shoot, and dip below to safety.

strengths.title: Quickly engage and disengage
content: Combining Rocket jumps, Jet Dash, and Concussive Blast self-knockback give Pharah access to multiple instances of high bursts of speed. Depending on the map and situation, she can quickly engage or dive a target with one of her cooldowns, get an elimination, then use her remaining abilities to retreat to safety until all her resources are restored.
Cycling Pharah’s movement cooldowns is extremely important for maximizing her impact and potential.

weaknesses.title: Slow projectile speed
content: From medium to long range, Pharah can struggle to land direct impacts due to the slow projectile speed of ![](/data/assets/guide/ce38aca322038472.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-launcher.png)Rocket Launcher. At very long ranges, enemies with movement abilities have plenty of time to reactively dodge incoming rockets.

Pharah players need to become really good at predicting movement in order to maximize damage output. Damage mitigation abilities like ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix and barriers can also be used reactively to prevent any rocket damage from being dealt.

weaknesses.title: Often dies during her own Ultimate
content: “Justice Rains fro… uggghhhh!” Pharah makes herself into a stationary bullseye while she ults. Headshots, CC abilities, damage mitigation abilities and every attack can easily save enemies from death and eliminate Pharah before she has a chance to move again.

Typically, players will need to coordinate with a teammate if they hope to survive using ![](/data/assets/guide/bdc23f8912816520.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrage.png)Barrage. Abilities like ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu and ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier can change Barrage from being deadly to herself to being deadly to the enemy team.

weaknesses.title: Hitscans
content: While the rework has given ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah much more counterplay against hitscans, she still can be quickly eliminated by players with good aim mechanics on a hitscan hero.

Pharah has the benefit of mobility and no falloff damage, but these struggle to make up for how reliably and quickly hitscan abilities deal damage to her. Pharah’s normal hover jet movement is rather slow and makes her an easy target for heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste, and ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga.

play_against_summary: * The best way to deal with ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah is to play a hitscan with range and burst damage like ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe or ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari.
* Deny her safe air space by controlling high ground and forcing her to play predictable sightlines.
* Track her Barrage and hold defensive cooldowns or burst abilities to punish her immediately when she commits. A slight delay will make the difference between dying and taking her out.

minor.title: Drift Thrusters
content: * Pretty much the only way you can expect to survive using your own ult. While the movement may not look like much, this perk has proven very effective at making Barrage more successful.
minor.name: Drift Thrusters
minor.description: Pharah can move while Barrage is active.

minor.title: Helix Shields
content: * Good self-sustain. Best when you are not able to get consistent healing from your Supports.
minor.name: Helix Shields
minor.description: Convert 125 health to shields. Direct hits with the Rocket Launcher triggers passive shield regeneration.

major.title: Fuel Stores
content: * Allows Pharah to stay in the sky for longer. Best on maps with lots of vertical cover like Watchpoint Gibraltar.
major.name: Fuel Stores
major.description: Jet Dash grants 50% fuel. Maximum overfuel is increased by 100%.

major.title: Rocket Salvo
content: * Considering Pharah has two movement abilities, you get to activate the mini-rockets pretty often. Good for extra damage and better AoE.
* New total on direct hit is 200
major.name: Rocket Salvo
major.description: After using a movement ability, the next primary fire shoots two spiraling mini-rockets, each dealing 40 damage.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Maps that favor close-range engagements, have smaller objective areas, and little to no high ground are best for Ram. He wants enemies to be close enough to rush them with ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form at any moment. Also, because he has good horizontal move speed but no vertical mobility, flat ground areas enable Ram’s play style best. Maps with wide open space and long sight lines are situationally difficult for Ram, depending on the matchup.
If the enemy is running more short-range heroes and ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank, then he has the advantage, but if the enemy runs long-range or high-mobility heroes, he’s at a disadvantage. He doesn’t want to waste time trying to approach, and high ground gives the enemy an easy escape from Nemesis and his ult.

play_as: * ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form is the core of your power. It enables aggression and survivability. Only activate it when enemies are already within ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) range.

* Save ![](/data/assets/guide/4430a4dc25f88f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fravenous-vortex.png)Ravenous Vortex for ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form to slow enemies and prevent escape.

* Activate ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation immediately after Nemesis ends to maximize survivability and Nemesis uptime.
