play_against: * ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra is less tanky and less lethal in Omnic Form. After Nemesis ends, that is your window to go on the offensive.

* Break line of sight (LoS) on his ultimate to end it quickly. Cutting off ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation's AoE for a total of 3 seconds will immediately cancel it.
* If Ram is walking toward you, expect a Vortex. Use mobility or cover before he throws it.
specific_counters_81: * Track Nemesis timing and punish him during his less threatening Omnic Form.
* Save mobility for dodging Vortex. If you are already in Vortex, don't use your mobility abilities until you've escaped.

* Break LoS during ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation. If you can't escape, barriers also count as breaking LoS so hold the barrier until the duration expires.
team_comp_synergies: Team comps built around ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra can follow and assist him when he goes all in during and . Because Ram gains a move speed buff and immediately becomes the focus of the enemy team, he’ll be taking a huge amount of the enemy team's damage and cooldowns.

His armor and Block help him to survive the attacks, but if he wants to get max value, he needs his team’s assistance with healing himself so he can ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) and damage the enemy, so he can get the kills. His Barrier can give short windows of protection to snipers and ranged allies, but is can’t be depended on due to its long cooldown.
Anyone who can give him additional speed boosts greatly helps him in bypassing the frontline and quickly killing the squishies.
**Example of a team comp built around Ramattra:**

![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra, ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard, ![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer, ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno, ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

strengths.title: High survivability
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra gains 300 bonus armor whenever he activates ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form, including during his ultimate. He can block for the entire Nemesis duration and deploy a high-health barrier in Omnic Form. Combined, this gives him exceptional durability and strong stalling potential.

strengths.title: Good at rushing down
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form grants bonus movement speed, and ![](/data/assets/guide/4430a4dc25f88f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fravenous-vortex.png)Ravenous Vortex applies a slow, allowing Ram to effectively rush down targets. Pummel’s barrier-piercing damage secures kills once he closes the gap.

strengths.title: Versatile hybrid kit
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra can function in brawl, rush, and poke compositions. Omnic Form pressures high ground and backlines with ranged damage, while ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form enables frontline brawling.

weaknesses.title: Obvious cooldown rotation
content: Ram’s use of ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form can feel very predictable and easy to play around. When the enemy has the mobility to kite Nemesis, Ram struggles to generate value for his team.

weaknesses.title: Countered by crowd control
content: Anytime Ram pops Nemesis, it's like he puts on a huge, “stun me” sign. He has no way of stopping stuns like ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart or Shatter. Also, because of the short range of ![](/data/assets/guide/c1e40f427ae57001.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form), knockback abilities shut down Nemesis just as effectively.

weaknesses.title: Giant Hurtbox with minimal shielding
content: Although Ram has high survivability thanks to his Block and armor, he’s also easy to turn into an ult battery. His large body allows heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)Freja and ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn to use Ram to farm ammo for their guns. Everyone else can use him to farm ult. During Nemesis, it's open season for long-range heroes, and Omnic Form is easy for close-range heroes to aggro on.

play_against_summary: * ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra is less tanky and less lethal in Omnic Form. After Nemesis ends, that is your window to go on the offensive.

* Break line of sight (LoS) on his ultimate to end it quickly. Cutting off ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation's AoE for a total of 3 seconds will immediately cancel it.
* If Ram is walking toward you, expect a Vortex. Use mobility or cover before he throws it.

minor.title: Void Surge
content: * Strengthen Ram’s weakness

* * The extra burst damage has more impact than it seems on paper. Also, compared to Prolonged Barrier, ![](/data/assets/guide/18b39bbccad34011.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-barrier-omnic-form.png)Void Barrier (Omnic Form) never breaks, and an extra second will rarely make a game-changing difference.

* Better damage in Omnic Form allows Ram to be more of a threat while waiting for ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form.
minor.name: Void Surge
minor.description: Void Accelerator periodically releases a burst of 6 additional projectiles during continuous fire.

minor.title: Relentless Form
content: * Most of Ram's value is generated while in ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form. Being able to extend the duration is really good. You won't always be able to get an elimination, but when you do, this is a very impactful buff.
minor.name: Relentless Form
minor.description: While Nemesis Form is active, eliminations extend the duration by 1 second.

major.title: Nanite Repair
content: * Bit of extra sustain
* * When inside Vortex for the full duration, Ram will heal for 150 health.

* Helpful when brawling because you can throw Vortex at your feet, and stay inside while Pummeling the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank.
major.name: Nanite Repair
major.description: Ramattra is healed for 75 health per second while within Ravenous Vortex.

major.title: Vengeful Vortex
content: * Better for poke
* * Being able to detonate Vortex in the air makes it easy to catch distant enemies without needing to hit a perfect placement. The 50 detonation damage also helps increase your poke lethality.
* Better rush downs
* * When chasing down an enemy, shoot Vortex in front of them and detonate to force them to walk through. This makes rushing down targets notably easier.
major.name: Vengeful Vortex
major.description: While Ravenous Vortex is airborne, use E again to detonate it, dealing 50 damage and pulling enemies downward.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: Reaper thrives on maps with tight spaces and lots of small rooms. He struggles most on maps with long sightlines, narrow hallways, and wide open spaces. Finding areas with cover and flank routes should be the primary focus of your pathing on Reaper. If one side of the objective has health packs or covered paths, spend most of your time on that side and avoid the other. Maps with high ground areas give him the extra option to TP up, then drop down for a lethal surprise attack.

play_as: * Look for isolated enemies in the backlines. They’ll be the easiest to eliminate and can quickly give your team the advantage.

* Save ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form to survive. Try to sneak in and attack, then only use Wraith once at low HP and needing to escape.
* Help your Tank win the Tank duel. Especially in Tank Mirrors, the extra damage from Reaper gives your Tank an easy win when fighting the enemy Tank.
play_against: * Focus him after Wraith. Even if you have to chase after him, a Reaper without ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form is an easy kill.

* Listen for ![](/data/assets/guide/e223d900c52de2b4.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fshadow-step.png)Shadow Step sound cue. Whichever direction you hear it from tells you he’s about to appear and attack you.

* Counter ![](/data/assets/guide/ffc140c6d6a32c46.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeath-blossom.png)Death Blossom with CC, damage mitigation, or focus fire. He’s moving slowly and can’t cancel Blossom, so he’s easy to target.
team_comp_synergies: Reaper's best ally is ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya because of ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier and her frontline presence.

When he dives in and gets bubbled, he has a couple seconds to delete the enemy without fear of getting stunned. Likewise, ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier is a great tool for enabling high-value ![](/data/assets/guide/ffc140c6d6a32c46.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeath-blossom.png)Death Blossoms.

He also works well with other brawl and rush Tanks, can dive with the mobile Tanks, but gets little value from poke Tanks like ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina and ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma.

Since he needs to be up close and personal, Supports who can heal him while he's in the enemy backline are the best choices. A couple examples are ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver who can heal, and save Reaper with ![](/data/assets/guide/70bdaf439d6cdcdd.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Flife-grip.png)Life Grip when needed. ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana can bust heal, anti-![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade for kills, and ![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)Nano Boost for an ultra deadly Reaper attack.

strengths.title: Tank buster
content: The wide bullet spread of Reaper’s Shotguns is perfect for shooting the large bodies of Tanks. They also serve as a large source of lifesteal health for himself. Between the high damage and lifesteal, most Tanks try to avoid Reaper at all costs.

strengths.title: Backline assassin
content: Shadow Step and Wraith Form are great flanking tools. Reaper can TP behind the enemy, surprise attack, secure an elim, then turn invincible and escape.

strengths.title: Self-reliant
content: Having life steal, mobility, and invincibility means Reaper doesn’t have to rely on his team’s resources. He’s a great hero to pick when you feel your team isn’t providing enough support. Between health packs and lifesteal, Reaper can keep his HP full all on his own.

weaknesses.title: Poor range
content: His only attack, being the Hellfire Shotguns with short falloff and wide bulletspread, doesn’t permit Reaper to find value outside of very close range. During poke phases, Reaper doesn’t do anything. Getting in close also puts himself in greater danger.

weaknesses.title: Easily countered ult
content: In Overwatch 2, ults are seen as game-changing abilities. Sadly for Reaper, however, his ult is difficult to get consistent value out of. The timing of the ult tends to be telegraphed, and there are endless ways to counter it, from damage mitigation and invincibility to stuns and burst damage.

weaknesses.title: Armor
content: Armor reduces Reaper's shotgun damage by half. So if he’s shooting a Tank with high amounts of armor like Orisa, he’s dealing very low damage until he and his team chip away down to her base health.

play_against_summary: * Focus him after Wraith. Even if you have to chase after him, a Reaper without ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form is an easy kill.

* Listen for ![](/data/assets/guide/e223d900c52de2b4.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fshadow-step.png)Shadow Step sound cue. Whichever direction you hear it from tells you he’s about to appear and attack you.

* Counter ![](/data/assets/guide/ffc140c6d6a32c46.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeath-blossom.png)Death Blossom with CC, damage mitigation, or focus fire. He’s moving slowly and can’t cancel Blossom, so he’s easy to target.

minor.title: Lingering Wraith
content: no guide provided
perk: Lingering Wraith
minor.name: Lingering Wraith
minor.description: Leaving Wraith Form grants 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.

minor.title: Soul Reaving
content: * Extra tanky
* * Soul Globes are useful for making Reaper even more tanky with the added self-sustain. Allow him to stay in the fight a bit longer.
* Especially good in brawly fights on the objectives where enemies are dying in close range.
* Don’t try to pick up every Globe

* * Just because you see a Globe doesn’t mean you should pick it up. They can be bait and waste time for very little healing in return. Only pick them up when at critical health or when they are on the path to your targeted enemy.
Lingering Wraith
* Dangerous Perk

* * The speed boost encourages using ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form to engage, but then you don't have it to escape. You need to be extremely confident you will get the elim, and still survive.
* Useful against mobile targets whose mobility lasts longer or moves them farther than your Wraith Form.
minor.name: Soul Reaving
minor.description: Collect Soul Globes from dead enemies to restore 50 health.

major.title: Dire Triggers
content: * Poke weapon
* * Greatly increased range damage and tightened bullet spread empower Reaper to finally be able to contribute to ranged fights.
* Before getting in close, start building ult charge, or pressuring the enemy team.
* Help with fliers

* * In matches with fliers like ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah or ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo, Dire Triggers' longer range helps to pressure or even finish them off.
* Don’t give away your position on flanks

* * The damage from Dire Triggers isn’t worth beginning your flank attacks with. It’s still much better to get as close as possible, then attack with ![](/data/assets/guide/ee63221cfd675de0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhellfire-shotguns.png)Hellfire Shotguns.
major.name: Dire Triggers
major.description: Use (RMB) to fire a volley with long range accuracy from both Hellfire shotguns.

major.title: Shadow Blink
content: * Enables safer escape with ![](/data/assets/guide/e223d900c52de2b4.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fshadow-step.png)Shadow Step. The best use of the faster cast time is being able to get out of fights when you don't have ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form.
* Recommended if you are using Lingering Wraith
major.name: Shadow Blink
major.description: Shadow Step's cast time and cooldown are 25% faster, but the range is reduced by 25%.

play_as: * ![](/data/assets/guide/1858a99948e6d377.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield and ![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)Charge as repositioning tools. Use both to take space and get yourself close to melee range.

* Start ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike behind cover and peek the moment it fires to minimize damage taken.

* Check your ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike charges and ally positions before using ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)Earthshatter so you don't end up knocking down the enemy team but having no follow up to actually eliminate any of them.
play_against: * Use stuns and knock back to shut down his approach. If he can't get into ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer range, he's very underwhelming.
* Burn his barrier from off-angles rather than stacking in front of it where his team can safely attack you.

* When you see the Enemy walking suspiciously far up, expect![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)Earthshatter. The moment you see him drop the shield and wind up, use your barrier or escape ability.
team_comp_synergies: Rein plays best in Rush style team comps where the entire team moves together. Other brawl and close range damage heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei and ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper pair strongly with Rein, though he can also benefit from having ranged heroes and flankers on his team to make up for his weaknesses.
**Two types of Reinhardt based team comps:**
1. Everyone plays hard grouped on him and runs over the enemy team.

**Example**: ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei, ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio, ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira
2. Teammates play to make up for Rein’s weaknesses such as range and high ground pressure.

**Example**: ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer, ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko
strengths_weaknesses_summarized: * Choose between dealing or mitigating damage

strengths.title: Taking space
content: Taking and controlling space is one of the primary jobs for tanks and this is exactly where ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt excels. A giant hammer swinging force walking with his team behind his huge shield can be extremely difficult to stand in the way of. The enemy team doesn’t want Rein to be close to them so as he walks forward, they walk back. When he is on defense, any enemy hero who wants to advance forward has to willingly put themselves into Rein’s optimal range where he is able to land ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer swings.

strengths.title: AoE damage
content: Against enemy teams that like to position multiple people grouped closely together, the huge AoE hitbox of his hammer deals massive cleave damage. Hitting three enemies per swing is not uncommon and results in dealing approximately 300 dmg per second! Additionally, the ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike projectile has a long hitbox and penetrates through enemies, further increasing Rein’s power against grouped enemies.

strengths.title: Damage mitigation
content: Damage mitigation is so important in Overwatch that it has its own designated column on the in-game scoreboard. No other tank can keep up with the sheer amount of damage mitigation ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt offers. Having a shield with no cooldown enables reactive blocking against core enemy cooldown abilities and ultimates. ![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)Barrier Field trades in Rein’s favor in every interaction. All he has to give up is a bit of shield health, and Rein can completely cancel out enemy abilities with 10+ second cooldown timers.

His shield also has by far the largest health pool of any shield and regenerates its own hp after not being deployed for a couple seconds. ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt's large shield health allows him to activate the passive during fights when his hp is low by simply not putting down his shield.

weaknesses.title: Has to choose between dealing or mitigating damage
content: The biggest weakness of having a shield in one hand and a hammer in the other is the inability to use both simultaneously. ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt is actually the only shield tank that cannot mitigate and deal damage at the same time. Consequently, when facing off against a tank like ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma or ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa, they will have the advantage in being able to damage ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt while not taking any damage themselves. Even ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va can use ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix and ![](/data/assets/guide/cb85107f12591c3b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmicro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles at the same time, and ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive and Ult both allow him simultaneous damage output and mitigation. ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt has to constantly choose between 100% defense or 100% offense.

weaknesses.title: Poor ranged damage
content: Two final and most severe weaknesses are being a melee hero and not having any vertical movement. While ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike does count as a ranged ability, the long cool down and slow speed make it unreliable when actually using it at range. On map areas with long lines of sights, Rein often has to burn up all his shield health while slowly trying to get into melee range, leaving him with little to no shield for aggressive plays, or to save himself if he gets low health. Most heroes in OW can rotate outside of his melee range and continuously fire damage without threat of retaliation.

weaknesses.title: No vertical mobility
content: On maps or objectives with a lot of high ground, Rein can feel pretty useless as he has no way of contesting or moving vertically. In these scenarios, the best move is often to simply shield teammates and hope they can get some picks. The only other options are to take long paths that allow access to high ground areas, or use a teammate's ability like ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver ![](/data/assets/guide/d747d16d3747ce4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpetal-platform.png)Petal Platform to move him. Either way, Rein has no means of moving back and forth between high ground and low ground areas which allows enemies with mobility to easily avoid him.

play_against_summary: * Use stuns and knock back to shut down his approach. If he can't get into ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer range, he's very underwhelming.
* Burn his barrier from off-angles rather than stacking in front of it where his team can safely attack you.

* When you see the Enemy walking suspiciously far up, expect![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)Earthshatter. The moment you see him drop the shield and wind up, use your barrier or escape ability.

minor.title: Crusader's Fire
content: * Guarantees you have a ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike to follow up on ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)Earthshatter.
* Standard 250 HP heroes can be killed by Shatter > Fire Strike(x2), so this perk makes your shatter's more consistently lethal.
minor.name: Crusader's Fire
minor.description: Refund a charge of Fire Strike When you stun an enemy, overfilling up to 3.

minor.title: Crusader's Resolve
content: * Good in matchups where you are forced to play more passive such as when facing ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa or ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga.
* Also a decent choice if your Supports have lower healing output.
minor.name: Crusader's Resolve
minor.description: While using Barrier Field, your passive health regeneration triggers 75% sooner.

major.title: Shield Slam
content: * Lose the ability to hold secondary fire down and look around without rotating.
* The slam itself is ok, but generally not worth taking over the increased attack speed.
major.name: Shield Slam
major.description: While Barrier Field is active, use Primary Fire to damage and knockback enemies.

major.title: Ignited Fury
content: * Save at least one ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike for when you get into melee range. The increased attack speed is very strong in brawls and will help you win the ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank fight.
major.name: Ignited Fury
major.description: For each enemy you hit with Fire Strike, gain 2 seconds of 25% increased attack speed.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog are those that encourage close-range fights, like most Control and Flashpoint maps. Because Roadhog has no mobility, he doesn't like high-ground maps like Watchpoint: Gibraltar, and with limited range, he doesn't want long-sightline maps like Circuit Royal.
No matter what map, the main thing Hog needs to use is corners to pull enemies around.
Also, there's a need to mention Ilios: Well because Hog just standing on the point threatening to pull you into the hole is a major threat that forces the enemy to reposition off the objective.

play_as: * Landing ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook on a DPS or Support is higher value than on Tanks. Be on the hunt for squishies in range of Chain Hook.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/b08074397e9cf795.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-a-breather.png)Take a Breather to heal whenever your Supports are preoccupied or out of LoS. You can also absorb more damage during Breather.

* Hook can be used before or during ![](/data/assets/guide/c112a0acc9386624.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhole-hog.png)Whole Hog to keep the enemy close. Try to aim ![](/data/assets/guide/c112a0acc9386624.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhole-hog.png)Whole Hog towards a wall so your target gets stuck instead of being knocked away.
play_against: * If you react quickly with healing, CC, or damage mitigation when an ally gets Hooked, you can save their life.

* When Hook misses or gets blocked, press the attack for a few seconds because ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog is not very lethal without ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook.

* If you have a damage mitigation ability, let ![](/data/assets/guide/c112a0acc9386624.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhole-hog.png)Whole Hog push you back so you get out of its optimal range before activating your barrier or damage absorption.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog doesn't need much healing since he can heal himself more than any other hero. What he needs is allies who can fill the gaps in his kit. Heroes with long-range damage and those who can contest high ground for him make his life much easier.

For Supports, ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta’s ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord makes every ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook even more lethal. ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu is pretty much required for Hog to survive if the enemy has anti-heal like ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade or ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)Rampage.

strengths.title: Displacement abilities
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook is easily the most dangerous Tank cooldown in all of Overwatch. Pulling someone around a corner and away from their team is almost always enough to get the kill. Additionally, Whole ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog can be used for environmental KOs or to push enemies off the objective.

strengths.title: Burst damage
content: His shotgun deals high burst damage at both very close-range and mid-range. He can also combo right-click > ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook > primary > melee for a rapid burst combo.

strengths.title: High self-sustain
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog is the only Tank who can heal himself anytime he needs health (granted, he has Breather resources). He can heal himself for 450 health every ~9 seconds. During ![](/data/assets/guide/b08074397e9cf795.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-a-breather.png)Take a Breather, he also gets damage reduction. This allows ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog to survive on his own and makes him difficult to kill.

weaknesses.title: Bullet sponge
content: Because he is large, slow, and has no damage mitigation, ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog is always taking a ton of damage. Feeding with ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog is easy to do, and even if you don’t die, the enemy team often gains an ult economy advantage.

weaknesses.title: Limited range
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2aaac1b9bc2b7dc1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fscrap-gun.png)Scrap Gun's slow projectile speed and wide bullet spread make it terrible at longer ranges. Enemies who can position outside of his Hook range can also ignore him as a threat.

weaknesses.title: Poor mobility
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog is the only Tank without any movement abilities. He does have Invigorate for a brief speed boost, but that is locked behind a Major Perk. Most heroes can easily play keep away with ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog, and maps with lots of high ground are extremely difficult for him.

play_against_summary: * If you react quickly with healing, CC, or damage mitigation when an ally gets Hooked, you can save their life.

* When Hook misses or gets blocked, press the attack for a few seconds because ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog is not very lethal without ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook.

* If you have a damage mitigation ability, let ![](/data/assets/guide/c112a0acc9386624.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhole-hog.png)Whole Hog push you back so you get out of its optimal range before activating your barrier or damage absorption.

minor.title: Scrap Hook
content: * Save yourself from embarrassment

* * The worst feeling every ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog player has experienced is Hooking an enemy and finding you have no ammo, so you just stand there reloading with the enemy in your face.
* Scrap Hook guarantees you’ll always have the ammo necessary for your Hook combos.
* Increase shotgun uptime

* * The extra 2 ammo effectively decreases the time ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog spends reloading by 30%
minor.name: Scrap Hook
minor.description: Chain Hook hits reload 2 ammo.

minor.title: Shrapnel Launcher
content: * The new range is about 15m for the explosion range, which actually makes you weaker in the 10-14m range than without the perk. Keep this in mind to help you make your choice.
* Great when you are confident in your aim. Opens up way more ranged damage during the poke phases of fights.
* Especially good on maps with longer sightlines, such as Colosseo.
minor.name: Shrapnel Launcher
minor.description: Extend the range of Scrap Gun's secondary fire by 50% and tighten its burst spread by 25%.

major.title: Invigorate
content: * Better for flank and solo playstyle. Can flank and reposition to and from off-angles more quickly.

* Good for disengaging as well. When you need to run away from something like ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra's Ult, Invigorate makes it possible.
major.name: Invigorate
major.description: Take A Breather rapidly increases Roadhog's movement speed by 30%.

major.title: Pulled Pork
content: * The extra sustain is very strong. Take Pulled Pork when the enemy team has been laying a lot of damage on you. You’ll be able to stay in fights longer and position more forward.
major.name: Pulled Pork
major.description: Gain overhealth based on how far you pull enemies with Chain Hook, up to 300.

play_as: * Position at mid-range poke distances to maximize ![](/data/assets/guide/30d2c2929a99f2d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres damage while keeping yourself outside of the enemy's optimal range.

* Use ![](/data/assets/guide/17f84ecf06b49c68.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fexperimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier to the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports damage and healing from reaching their ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank or your team.

specific_counters_81: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya

When pressing forward into ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma, ![](/data/assets/guide/b87166103290a2c3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faccretion.png)Accretions can easily be reacted to with a ![](/data/assets/guide/81b1062b5b25f966.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-barrier.png)Particle Barrier, preventing its CC effect and giving a burst of energy charge to ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya.
![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)Symmetra

* First off, her primary fire charges up insanely fast anytime ![](/data/assets/guide/17f84ecf06b49c68.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fexperimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier is in front of her. Then, when it's down, the high charge beam melts ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma. Secondly, ![](/data/assets/guide/442047e29c6772ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fteleporter.png)Teleporter can reposition her entire team in a way ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma has no hope of keeping up with or responding to. ![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)Symmetra vs ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma is one of the hardest counters in all of OW2 when played correctly.
![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio

* On his own, ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio can wall ride around and be a nuisance to ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma, who has difficulty tracking the speedy ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Support. The way ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio truly counters ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma, however, is by speed boosting his immobile allies into the ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma, who has no way of escaping without an ally's assistance. Many short-range heroes (![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei, ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)Symmetra, etc) are very strong against ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma but only if they can close the distance on him. ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio gives them all a consistent way to do just that.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma is best suited for poke team comps. ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma is really good at taking up enemy focus and resources which allows long range allies behind him to attack more freely. Shutting down enemy poke heroes is also an area ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma excels in, so the odds are in his teammates' favor. The whole team can work together to chip away at enemy health and resources before the enemy ever has a chance to fully commit to their attack.
**Ideal comp built around Sigma:**

![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma, ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)Hanzo, ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste, ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari

strengths.title: High AoE damage output
content: At the end of games, ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma will often lead the scoreboard with total damage dealt. Especially against teams that play grouped near their tank, ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma's direct impact damage on one enemy plus splash damage on multiple enemies quickly racks up. Additionally, the ricochet effect of ![](/data/assets/guide/30d2c2929a99f2d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres makes ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma extremely powerful at controlling tight spaces like hallways and choke points.

strengths.title: Movable shield
content: There are many shield abilities in OW2 but ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma alone has the ability to constantly redeploy his shield and set it anywhere he pleases. No other shield can be left floating in mid-air, perfectly blocking an enemy hero's LoS. Saving shield health and using it to react to specific ability usages, splitting off a target from the rest of their team or simply soaking up the full 700 HP of damage can all be great uses of his shield.

strengths.title: Survivability
content: Even when ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma's team has lost heroes during a team fight, it is never over if he is still alive. Excellent use of cover between shots of ![](/data/assets/guide/30d2c2929a99f2d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres, Barrier and Grasp combine to allow ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma to take very little damage and require little to no resources from his supports to stay alive. ![](/data/assets/guide/b87166103290a2c3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faccretion.png)Accretion also works as a great anti-dive CC tool to shut down enemy movement abilities or give ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma and his allies time to escape.

weaknesses.title: No mobility abilities
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma's greatest and most exploitable weakness comes in his complete lack of mobility tools. Other than during his ultimate, ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma has no way to speed himself up or move vertically and is technically the only ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank without any way to do so. Positioning is extremely important for ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma because he is essentially stuck wherever he is currently standing. The poor mobility also makes him weak against high mobility and dive comps.

weaknesses.title: Difficulty solo confirming elims
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma's highest burst combo (![](/data/assets/guide/b87166103290a2c3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faccretion.png)Accretion → ![](/data/assets/guide/30d2c2929a99f2d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres → melee) only deals 230 dmg leaving the standard 250 HP hero the chance to live, escape and keep fighting. Even though his ult combo (Flux → ![](/data/assets/guide/30d2c2929a99f2d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres → slam) can eliminate a single target, there are multiple abilities that counter ![](/data/assets/guide/c95892af1b952964.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux and enable enemies to survive the combo. While he has high overall high damage output, the damage tends to be too slow or inconsistent to consistently confirm elims without team assistance.

weaknesses.title: Slow primary fire projectile speed and fire rate
content: The speed of ![](/data/assets/guide/30d2c2929a99f2d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres is slow and requires a good deal of leading your shots in order to land direct hits. The small gap between each one of the two orbs in his double shots is also just large enough to make it difficult to land a direct hit with both orbs. Top all that off with the slow rate of fire and consistently hitting small hurtbox heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer and ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko becomes very challenging for ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma players.

play_against_summary: * Force ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma off his optimal mid-range poke angles by pressuring him with dive or flank threats, exploiting his lack of mobility.

* Beam heroes are strong against ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma because they can burn through his shield and ![](/data/assets/guide/7486123dd5edc842.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp doesn't absorb beams.

* Stun him out of ![](/data/assets/guide/c95892af1b952964.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux to immediately cancel his ult before he has a chance to activate.

minor.title: Kinetic Cycle
content: * Decent when struggling to maintain distance for dive and brawl ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks. Otherwise, take the other.
minor.name: Kinetic Cycle
minor.description: Absorbing projectiles with Kinetic Grasp also reduces Accretion's cooldown.

minor.title: Hyper Regeneration
content: * Barrier health is very important, and ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma deals a lot of damage from his primary fire. Your team gains a significant amount of increased shielding, and in turn, everyone has an easier time staying alive.
minor.name: Hyper Regeneration
minor.description: 40% of Hyperspheres' damage restores Experimental Barrier's Health.

major.title: Hyper Strike
content: * Interesting ability that is pretty good at countering any enemy with a primarily close-ranged kit. Send them floating and out of their optimal range.
major.name: Hyper Strike
major.description: Every 5 direct hits with Hyperspheres, your next successful Quick Melee levitates and knocks away enemies.

major.title: Levitation
content: * Very good as it gives ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma the one thing he is missing, mobility.
* Best use is to traverse between high ground areas where your poke pressure can dominate.
major.name: Levitation
major.description: Activate and hold Double Jump to briefly levitate upward.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: Sojourn’s versatility allows her to be played effectively on every map. That said, she performs best on maps with high ground, her Slide jump reaches. Also, medium range sight lines are best for her since her damage fall off begins at 40m. The maps that hinder her capabilities the most are those that don’t give her enough room to slide around and maintain that ideal mid-range fight distance. Additionally, if the map’s high ground is too tall, her Slide becomes much less useful, and she’s at a disadvantage compared to the heroes whose mobility allows them to take those vertical positions.

play_as: * Charge up ![](/data/assets/guide/e8c9519205769313.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frailgun.png)Railgun energy on Tanks, then target DPS and Supports with the charged shot.

* Save ![](/data/assets/guide/861b66a38565c2cf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-slide.png)Power Slide to escape. Always engaging with Slide leaves you vulnerable to counterattacks.
* Sojourn has long-range and close-range capabilities, so play against your enemies' weaknesses. If they are brawlers, keep your distance. If they are snipers, get in close.
play_against: * Watch for charged Railgun shots. When she hasn’t fired one for a few seconds, position out of her LoS.

* When you hear ![](/data/assets/guide/74549b59ef18f026.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverclock.png)Overclock, find cover and hide. On occasions where that isn’t possible, immediately focus her.
* After she uses Power Slide, quickly dive her. She won’t be able to escape and likely has low Railgun charge.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn DPS heroes in _Overwatch_. No matter what team composition she is paired with, she can find a way to provide value. There isn't really a team archetype that Sojourn simply will not work with.

strengths.title: Securing final blows
content: Rail’s charged shot is arguably the best ability in OW2 for confirming elims. Anytime an enemy gets low on health, Sojourn can instantly finish them off if she saved Railgun. She can patiently spam primary fire while waiting for the perfect secondary fire shot and target.

strengths.title: Hybrid Sniper
content: Unlike the other hitscan snipers, Sojourn has great mobility and decent poke spam. She doesn’t quite have the range of the rest of the snipers, but in most scenarios, her lethal range is more than sufficient.

strengths.title: Game-winning Ultimate
content: Whether you’re watching the OWCS or playing in ranked, there’s no doubt you’ve seen a Sojourn wipe the entire team with one use of her ult. Overclock is always a huge threat to the enemy team, especially when combined with another ult like Nano Boost or Graviton Surge.

weaknesses.title: Need to headshot during ult
content: One of the aspects of Sojourns kit making her so strong right now is the 150% charge from her Minor Perk. Headshots during her ult one-shot all 250 HP heroes. If you aren’t hitting those consistently, her ult will feel underwhelming.

weaknesses.title: Cooldown dependant
content: When Power Slide is on cooldown and she doesn’t have a charged Railgun, Sojourn becomes very weak. Misusing either of these abilities leads to wasting time at best, and often leads to an early death.

weaknesses.title: Feast or famine
content: Sojourn players are either a hard carry or a heavy burden on their team. Either you are getting consistent kills with charged Railgun shots, or you should be playing a dependable hero like Cassidy or Soldier: 76. Oftentimes, you’ll see a Sojourn player have one huge play where they single-handedly win the fight, only to be feeding the rest of the game.

play_against_summary: * Watch for charged Railgun shots. When she hasn’t fired one for a few seconds, position out of her LoS.

* When you hear ![](/data/assets/guide/74549b59ef18f026.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverclock.png)Overclock, find cover and hide. On occasions where that isn’t possible, immediately focus her.
* After she uses Power Slide, quickly dive her. She won’t be able to escape and likely has low Railgun charge.

minor.title: Deceleration Field
content: **Extended Mag**
* Weaker Minor Perk
* Build more charge
* * The one benefit of taking Extended Mag is that you can theoretically build charge shots faster because of the decrease in time spent reloading.
minor.name: Deceleration Field
minor.description: Enemies hit by Disruptor Shot are slowed by 25%.

minor.title: Overcharged
content: * Best Minor Perk
* One-shot 250 HP heroes
* * A 150% charged shot deals 255 damage on a critical hit. Since the majority of the roster falls within this threshold, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to delete heads.
* Primary fire between shots
* * Don’t forget to spam primary fire to generate charge faster and get off as many secondary fire shots as possible during your ult’s duration.
minor.name: Overcharged
minor.description: Railgun’s maximum energy is increased by 50 while Overclock is active.

major.title: Dual Thrusters
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Yes, you sacrifice a bit of vertical height, but getting a 2nd charge of Power Slide is incredibly powerful.
* New movement options

* * Normally, we urge great caution when engaging with Power Slide. With Dual Thrusters, however, you are free to go in deep with your first Slide, since you retain the option of disengaing with the second slide.
* Good for anti-dive
* * Being able to double slide raises Sojourn’s survivability by making her more difficult to catch and kill.
* The window of vulnerability where she has no slide is effectively cut in half, and harder for the enemy to track.
**Adhesive Siphon**
* Weaker Major Perk
* Damage is cut in half
* * Adhesive Disruptor only deals about 150 damage maximum. Even if you stick a target, you’ll also need to land a lot of extra damage if you want to elim.
* Rail and ult charge
* * The ability to stick Disruptor to an enemy boosts its consistency in dealing damage. Plus if the stuck target is close to other enemies, you get the AoE damage as well.
* Consequently, you’ll be generating both Rail and ult charge faster.
* A stuck target generates 36 energy for Railgun.
* Wait for an easy target
* * 15-second cooldowns need to be used carefully. Wait until you see an easy shot before haphazardly blasting away.
major.name: Dual Thrusters
major.description: Power Slide gains an additional charge and its jump height shifts to lateral movement.

major.title: Friction Generators
content: no guide provided
perk: Friction Generators
major.name: Friction Generators
major.description: While sliding, Power Slide generates up to 50 Energy.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps to play Soldier: 76 on are maps with lots of flank routes. Having excellent ground mobility, but not vertical mobility, means flat levels maximize his Sprint value and minimize his vertical weakness. If the high ground areas are easily accessible, however, he should certainly be looking to take them. You’ll also want to look for longer sight lines as his weapons are best suited for medium-range engagements. Maps that force close-quarters combat are difficult for Soldier as he gets outclassed by heroes like Tracer and Genji. Really long sight lines are also a problem for him if the enemy is running snipers like Widow Maker.

play_as: * Use ![](/data/assets/guide/ee9a27f9733b28b5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsprint.png)Sprint to run around the sides of maps and attack the enemy from a different angle than the rest of your team.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/fc8b8c45dbb1ed83.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhelix-rockets.png)Helix Rockets is your best burst of damage. Try not to shoot them into barriers and other damage-mitigating abilities.

* Combo ![](/data/assets/guide/5a0bd28ab2154772.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftactical-visor.png)Tactical Visor with a boost such as ![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)Nano Boost, ![](/data/assets/guide/a556e4ed6de03aaf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray, or Mercy’s ![](/data/assets/guide/2c81fb62b0b54490.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcaduceus-staff.png)Caduceus Staff to make your Ult more lethal.
play_against: * Dive him. Every role has heroes who can go with another ally and dive Soldier. He doesn’t have any CC and can’t attack while using his mobility tool.
* Block his poke damage. If all Soldier is doing is shooting barriers, he’s not bringing a lot of value to his team. Either use your own shield or play in the protection of a teammate.
* If you don’t see Soldier in front of you for a while, assume he is about to attack you from your flank. Play near cover so you can escape his surprise attack.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)Soldier: 76 is one of the most self-sufficient heroes in all of Overwatch thanks to his mobility and ![](/data/assets/guide/bf8d8ba901c24a9b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-field.png)Biotic Field. He doesn't directly need any particular heroes on his team to run around the map and do some soft flanking.

Barrier Tanks are nice to have since they offer great protection for him to spam the main lines. However, Rush and Dive Tanks get good value as well since he can keep up with their pace and follow up with damage from range for focus fire and quick kills.

The best Supports for him are those with a way to boost his damage output. Most Supports have a way to do this, such as using ![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)Nano Boost, ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush, ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy’s damage boost, ![](/data/assets/guide/d56469975ca68b87.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Famplification-matrix.png)Amplification Matrix, or ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord.
