content: * Best Minor Perk

* Increased lethality during ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage

* * Every time you ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)Jump Pack during ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage, you’ll deal more burst damage. The extra damage is surprisingly helpful in converting kills.
* The longer you’re in the air, the higher the resource meter fills up, and you’ll deal more damage upon landing.
* In general, it’s better to only go for a high Jump on the initial attack, then keep the Jumps low and quick.
minor.name: Heavy Landing
minor.description: During Primal Rage, Jump Pack's damage and area increase by up to 75% while airborne.

major.title: Chain Lightning
content: * Extra ult charge

* * Chain lightning deals an extra 72 damage when hitting 2 extra enemies. Compared to the 48 damage of a single hit, ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)Winston can generate 2.5x the amount of ult charge with every secondary fire.
* Potential for final blows
* * The bounce can hit enemies behind cover as long as they have a targetable teammate in range. You may be able to get some final blows if the enemy is one-shot.
major.name: Chain Lightning
major.description: Fully charged Secondary Fire hits bounce to up to 2 additional targets.

major.title: Revitalizing Barrier
content: * Self healing
* * Even a few seconds of healing while bubble dancing with an enemy can make the difference between winning the exchange and getting out alive.
* Extra ult charge

* * A full duration Barrier heals 240 HP to each hero inside. The healing you and your allies receive generates ult charge. When needing to farm ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage for a fight, you can use the bubble defensively and heal your allies.
major.name: Revitalizing Barrier
major.description: Barrier Projector heals allies within it for 30 health per second.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Because ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball can use ![](/data/assets/guide/e2a04628b040f9a1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgrappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw and ![](/data/assets/guide/d1ab2ae4c4cebd73.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Froll.png)Roll to move both vertically and horizontally, he performs well on maps with high ground as well as flatter layouts. Ideally, there is high ground or a ledge for him to use for a Piledriver or to sneak up on targets.
When the enemy team holds the high ground, Wrecking Ball is the best hero to roll through and knock them off. On flat ground, your goal should be to separate and disrupt: roll through, bait out cooldowns you can dodge, then return a few seconds later to fully commit with shields to secure eliminations.

play_as: * Scout before fully committing. Roll through without using ![](/data/assets/guide/a757c1f15c83012d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fadaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield to learn enemy positions and bait out their crowd control.
* Path to attack from the enemy's rear or flank. Don’t roll or swing head-on into the enemy because that will make it easy for them to stop you.

* Go airborne, drop ![](/data/assets/guide/fba9f0d37c01bf57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fminefield.png)Minefield, then slam down to boop and keep enemies in your Mines.
play_against: * Track his ![](/data/assets/guide/a757c1f15c83012d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fadaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield. If he hasn’t used them, don’t use your stuns yet, or he’ll easily survive.
* Pick a hero with kockbacks or stuns. Dealing with Ball is very hard without good CC.
* Don’t get isolated. Instead, position with at least one teammate so you don’t get caught in a 1v1 with Ball.
team_comp_synergies: Heroes played with Wrecking Ball need to be **self-sufficient** or paired with an ally who can protect them. Unlike most other Tanks, he offers no direct protection to his allies; if you pick a hero like Zenyatta, expect to fend for yourself against flankers.

For offense, two types of heroes work best with Wrecking Ball. First are fellow dive heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo, who can use her ![](/data/assets/guide/c917d6cf1c095fcf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsticky-bombs.png)Sticky Bombs and ![](/data/assets/guide/9ecb1957f6f092f0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffocusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam combo on his slams to blow up almost any target. Alternatively, ranged heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe or ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn can snipe enemies popped into the air by ![](/data/assets/guide/445ff36cea6a8e68.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpiledriver.png)Piledriver.
If you are waiting and ready, Wrecking Ball will hand you easy headshots.

strengths.title: Unmatched Mobility
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball can traverse enormous distances very quickly. ![](/data/assets/guide/e2a04628b040f9a1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgrappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw is also a short cooldown, so he can reposition often. There’s nowhere on a map that ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball cannot quickly access.

strengths.title: Disruptive
content: Boops and knock-ups break enemy positioning and force them into disadvantageous areas. ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball can knock the entire enemy team off high ground, and by the time they get back, he will definitely have another grapple.

strengths.title: Stalling
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a757c1f15c83012d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fadaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield, health packs, quick movement, and spin to win. No one is better than ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball at stalling objectives and buying time for the rest of their team to return to the objective. He’s very difficult to eliminate and often wastes a ton of the enemy's time.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to Crowd Control
content: Unless he’s using Adaptive Barrier, Ball doesn’t have much counterplay to CC outside of just tanking the damage. Against teams that have multiple heroes with stuns, he really struggles to do anything.

weaknesses.title: Relies on Game Sense
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball isn’t so lethal that he can just mow over a team. Instead, he needs to have a keen understanding of what the enemy is trying to do, and know how to interrupt or stop their plan. It’s also crucial for ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball players to track cooldowns and enemy positions. There is a lot to keep track of, and if you're just swinging and slamming without a clear purpose, you're going to lose a lot of games.

weaknesses.title: Niche Mechanical Tech
content: To really excel on ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball, you need to spend a good amount of time learning his specific tech. Wall jumps, double boops, sling shots, and grapple retraction are just a few of the things you’ll need to learn to maximize his kit. You also need quick reflexes to keep up with his speed, and excellent tracking to finish off enemies you booped and slammed.

play_against_summary: * Track his ![](/data/assets/guide/a757c1f15c83012d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fadaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield. If he hasn’t used them, don’t use your stuns yet, or he’ll easily survive.
* Pick a hero with kockbacks or stuns. Dealing with Ball is very hard without good CC.
* Don’t get isolated. Instead, position with at least one teammate so you don’t get caught in a 1v1 with Ball.

minor.title: Steamroller
content: * Not very impactful as an extra 60 damage on Tanks isn’t making a notable difference. Also, Tanks should not be your main target.
minor.name: Steamroller
minor.description: Roll impacts deal 100% more damage to Tanks.

minor.title: Multi-Ball
content: * Extra area denial and counterplay to escapes. For example, if you try to slam and drop mines on a ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira but they Fade away, chase them, then drop the additional mines to trap them for a kill.

* Even better when you save ![](/data/assets/guide/e2a04628b040f9a1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgrappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw for after your Ult. Use high ground to roll in instead of swinging so you can immediately chase.
minor.name: Multi-Ball
minor.description: Press Ultimate within 5 seconds after using Minefield to deploy 7 additional mines.

major.title: Hang Time
content: * Good against squishy heroes with poor mobility like ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)Hanzo.
major.name: Hang Time
major.description: Piledriver winds up longer, gaining air control and dealing up to 50% more damage.

major.title: Adaptive Barrier
content: * Very strong as it gives you direct counterplay against crowd control, such as ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook and ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana's ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart.
major.name: Adaptive Barrier
major.description: Adaptive Shield generates a 1.5 second barrier on activation.

play_as: * Build and maintain high energy by using Barriers on yourself only when actively attacking the enemy at closer ranges.
* Use your bubbles reactively to protect teammates rather than preemptively, prioritizing moments when allies are clearly under fire to maximize charge gain and impact.

* Cast ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge in coordination with your team’s follow-up ultimates or burst damage. Catching just one or two enemies is enough to win the fight.
play_against: * Force her to use bubbles early or inefficiently by threatening burst damage or dives, then momentarily disengaging.

* Play around her energy level. A high-energy ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya is far more lethal, so respect her threat in fights and avoid extended duels when she has maximum charge.
* Avoid clumping together when she has Grav. Position where it's difficult for her to target you, or save defensive abilities to save yourself and teammates.

The Slow effect of ![](/data/assets/guide/6f0829d84c10e9e2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fendothermic-blaster.png)Endothermic Blaster is a really strong punish against a ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya caught without a self bubble available. The danger for ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei is that if she messes up her ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall, ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya's close-range damage far exceeds ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei's close-range primary fire.
![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste

* Against ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya's big fight winning ultimate, simply placing an ![](/data/assets/guide/3adb743da6c064fe.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fimmortality-field.png)Immortality Field around a corner can keep his entire team alive. ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste's poke damage is also high enough to force out bubbles. When bubbling an ally trying to engage an enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste, he has so many survivability tools he likely won’t be defeated and you’ll be out a bubble.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can work well in both brawl comps and dive comps, but struggles with and against poke comps.

Brawl comps built around ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya have primarily close range heroes who move together, try to survive poke damage, and move to force only close range engagements.
**Example of a strong Zarya brawl comp**

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya, ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei, ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper, ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio, ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira

Dive Comps with ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya will have multiple DPS or ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Support allies going for aggressive plays on the enemy backline. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya has one of two roles in dive comps. Primarily to bubble her aggressive allies, shielding them from crowd control abilities and giving them the extra 225 HP. The other way she enables her diving allies is by maintaining her own survivability. Using cover and self bubbles allows the rest of your team's resources to be dedicated to the dive engagements instead of having to keep ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya alive.
**Example of a strong Zarya dive comp**

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya, ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji, ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer, ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko, ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana

strengths.title: Solo Carry Potential
content: Use bubbles selfishly to generate high charge and keep yourself alive until you reach 175 damage per second at 100% energy. A fully charged ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can melt every 250 HP hero in under 1.5 seconds! With that kind of damage potential, ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can always find a way to win. Furthermore, ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can save allies a good distance from her with ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier without having to give up her own position or aggression.

strengths.title: Mid-range Damage
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya excels in mid-range engagements (10 - 20m). When facing off against a close range heroes (![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper, etc), she can play at her maximum range just outside of their optimal ranges. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya doesn’t have to push up too far to put herself in range of pressuring enemies positioned behind their ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank. Secondary fire is also great for finishing off retreating enemies and its projectile speed is reliable at mid-range.

strengths.title: Survivability
content: The energy mechanics of ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya bubbles force the enemy team to make quick decisions to try and destroy the barrier, thereby giving ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya more energy, or wait out the full 2 seconds, giving her free rein to advance or retreat. These interactions can make it very difficult to eliminate ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya. Additionally, the combination of shield health and the self-heal passive allow ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya to hide behind cover briefly and quickly restore her health without the aid of ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports.

weaknesses.title: Heavily Reliant On Maintaining High Energy
content: A low charge ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya doesn’t threaten anyone and applies minimal pressure. When an enemy team avoids damaging bubbles and you get stuck at low energy with no cooldowns, you can’t really offer anything to your team until both bubbles come back up. A ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank being shot at by a low-energy ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can safely walk right past her and destroy her allies.

weaknesses.title: No Mobility and Weak Against Long Range Heroes
content: Enemies on the outskirts of a point, or on high ground areas are extremely difficult for ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya to deal with. She can offer ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier to allies attacking these enemies but that’s about it. While a secondary fire jump can give a bit of extra vertical movement, it’s too short to give her access to most high ground areas.

weaknesses.title: A Couple Bad Bubbles Loses the Fight
content: Optimal bubble use is complex and the choice of what, when, where and who to bubble constantly changes throughout a match. Using a bubble on an ally you thought was in danger but wasn’t, leaves other allies completely vulnerable. Using bubble on one enemy ability leaves ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya open to a different enemy ability. Getting caught wasting two bubbles in a row usually means that teamfight is lost and your team needs to reset.

play_against_summary: * Force her to use bubbles early or inefficiently by threatening burst damage or dives, then momentarily disengaging.

* Play around her energy level. A high-energy ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya is far more lethal, so respect her threat in fights and avoid extended duels when she has maximum charge.
* Avoid clumping together when she has Grav. Position where it's difficult for her to target you, or save defensive abilities to save yourself and teammates.

minor.title: Spotter
content: * Extremely powerful for enabling your allies. Healing and granting a speed boost can turn your teammates into carries.
minor.name: Spotter
minor.description: Projected Barrier activates ally health regeneration and increases their movement speed by 20%.

minor.title: Jump-Ups
content: * Best on maps with lots of high ground. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya normally struggles on these maps, but the extra jump height gives her more mobility options.
minor.name: Jump-Ups
minor.description: Secondary Fire's self-knockback is increased by 75%.

major.title: Energy Lance
content: * Best against brawly comps that play grouped up. Target the enemies behind and rotate to keep the front-most enemy in the beams path.
major.name: Energy Lance
major.description: Particle Cannon's beam pierces enemies.

major.title: Extra Oomph
content: * Stops decay, and builds more overall energy than just taking damage. Great when the enemy team is smart and trying not to charge you up.
major.name: Extra Oomph
major.description: While a Barrier is active, dealing damage with Particle Cannon’s beam generates energy.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta allow him to abuse his superior ranged poke damage. Long sight lines and plenty of corners to peek around make it easier for ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta to perform well. Because he has poor mobility, maps with very tall high ground either leave him at a disadvantage on the floor or force him to waste time finding a long walking path up. Small maps can also prove challenging to ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta since he wants to keep his distance and has trouble dealing with flankers. Game modes with payloads give him a natural moving cover to always play around. Additionally, his team benefits from Zen sitting on cart, since it allows the rest of them to push up.

play_as: * Charge secondary fire behind cover. Never charge out in the open where the enemy can attack you.
* Discord the enemy closest to your team. The more of your allies that can attack your Discord target, the more benefit you’ll gain.

* Use ![](/data/assets/guide/e02932bc2fe16c69.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranslocator.png)Translocator to counter enemy ultimates. Especially when the enemy has powerful ults like ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade or ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, save Trans to save your team when they use their ult.
play_against: * ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta can’t escape flank and dive attacks. Coordinate with at least one teammate and surprise attack him simultaneously for an easy kill.

* Cleanse ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord by breaking LoS before committing to your attack. You don’t want to move in deep just to get blown up by the extra Discord damage.

* If you don’t see ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta , assume he is charging up a volley. Get behind a barrier and watch your flank.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta is the master of poke comps. Not only is his ranged damage insane with no falloff, but ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord combined with a poke team's focus fire will delete any enemy. Pretty much any hero with ranged damage works great alongside him.

He can also be an extremely powerful asset in dive comps for similar reasons. The dive allies collapse on the discorded target, instantly turning the fight into a 5v4, and win from there. The only drawback is if the enemy team is also running dive; Zen will be the first one targeted, and he'll need an ally like ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste or ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko to help protect him.

strengths.title: High damage
content: He has the highest damage output of any Support. A fully charged volley can instantly delete most heroes, and neither of his attacks have damage falloff. This makes him an excellent choice when playing Support, and you feel your team is losing because of a lack of damage and pick potential.

strengths.title: Discord
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta is the only hero who can constantly boost his entire team’s damage throughout the entire match. ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord can be a reliable means of killing enemy Tanks or quickly shutting down an enemy DPS during their ultimate.

strengths.title: Strong defensive ult
content: During ![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)Transcendence, anyone in the AoE is nearly unkillable, and ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta is literally invincible. The enemy team could invest three ultimates to kill your team, only to have them all negated by your one ult.

weaknesses.title: Low healing
content: If you play ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta, be prepared to have your team ask for a swap to a, “main healer.” Other than his ult, his healing is extremely low and slow compared to the rest of the Supports. Because of this, he is difficult to make work if your other Support isn’t doing a ton of healing.

weaknesses.title: Glass cannon
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta has no damage mitigation, self-healing, or escape tool. He relies on his damage to defend himself. He has a large hurtbox and is always being targeted by enemy dive comps. Generally, Zen is considered an easy kill.

weaknesses.title: Poor mobility
content: Overwatch is full of high mobility heroes in every role. ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta is very slow-moving and has no movement abilities. The minor Perk, Ascendance, does give him limited air movement, but doesn’t give any sort of increased speed, or invincibility. On large maps or in team comps with a lot of mobility, Zen wastes a lot of time trying to catch up with the fight.

play_against_summary: * ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta can’t escape flank and dive attacks. Coordinate with at least one teammate and surprise attack him simultaneously for an easy kill.

* Cleanse ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord by breaking LoS before committing to your attack. You don’t want to move in deep just to get blown up by the extra Discord damage.

* If you don’t see ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta , assume he is charging up a volley. Get behind a barrier and watch your flank.

minor.title: Discordant Repair
content: no guide provided
perk: Discordant Repair
minor.name: Discordant Repair
minor.description: Zenyatta gains 10% lifesteal against enemies affected by Discord Orb.

minor.title: Ascendance
content: * New positioning possibilities

* * Instead of just increasing one of ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta's abilities, Ascendance gives him a completely new power that opens up a lot of new playmaking opportunities.
* Hover between high ground

* * Maps with lots of high ground are usually difficult for ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta , but with Ascendance, he can keep the high ground once he has it.

* Example: Numbani opening capture point. Zen can use staircases to get to any of the high ground areas. Afterwards, he uses Ascendance to float between high ground to reposition for either defensive protection or an offensive attack.
* Shoot over walls and barriers
* * Charge up a secondary fire, then double jump above a wall or a barrier and attack from an angle not possible without hover.
* Find new flank spots

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta loves flanking and looking to delete an unsuspecting foe with a fully charged right-click. Many maps have perimeter paths that ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta can only traverse with Ascendance. Be on the lookout and experiment.
minor.name: Ascendance
minor.description: Activate and hold Double Jump to hover for up to 3 seconds.

major.title: Focused Destruction
content: * Increased offensive threat
* One-shot 300HP heroes

* * Normally, a fully charged volley will kill the standard 250 HP hero. With Focused Destruction, ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta now eliminates all heroes up to 300HP like Mei and Reaper.

* You can spam secondary fire more often because of the faster charge speed, but the same tips and principles apply from ![](/data/assets/guide/a7f6469e50fb0458.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-destruction.png)Orb of Destruction (Charge) tips above.
major.name: Focused Destruction
major.description: Secondary fire charges 20% faster and can store 1 extra Orb of Destruction.

major.title: Dual Harmony
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* The net gain is +40% healing which translates to faster ultimate charging. Moreover, keeping two allies with sustain is a lot stronger than a bit more healing on a single target.
major.name: Dual Harmony
major.description: Gain a 2nd Harmony Orb but they both heal for 70% effectiveness.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
On _Control_ and _Flashpoint_maps (e.g., Nepal, Lijiang Tower, Suravasa), ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran thrives by leveraging verticality and flank routes to harass isolated enemies and secure early picks. She needs to use a get-in-get out strategy on these smaller maps or else the enemy team can peel for her target, then focus fire her to a quick death.
On _Escort_, _Hybrid,_ and _Push_ maps (e.g., New Queen Street, Dorado, Colosseo), use her mobility to similarly threaten Supports and DPS set up in the backlines of their team. The more linear layout of these maps merits longer poke phases compared to the two previous modes.
Anran’s kit rewards players who can read team rotations, abuse environmental cover to be difficult to predict or eliminate, and punish enemies whose anti-dive abilites are on cooldown (E.G., ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, ![](/data/assets/guide/f60c62173ce6fce8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fflashbang.png)Flashbang, ![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)Fade).
Because ranged combat is her primary weakness, on maps with long sightlines like Midtown and Circuit Royal, she gets outclassed by hitscans like ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe.

play_as: * Alternate between 2 Primary Fire > 1 Secondary Fire, to maximize DPS.

* Only use one ![](/data/assets/guide/b03c6c39b72fea97.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze dash to attack, and always save one charge to escape fights and survive.
* Both Ults are valuable. Although it’s better to secure elims with Ascent, bringing yourself immediately back into the fight and helping your team win is a great use of the revive ult.

* Crowd Control and stuns are very effective for shutting down ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran's rush. Target her and finish her off when she tries to escape.

* Quickly target ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran during her ult. If she’s at low HP or takes a second to aim, you can eliminate her while she’s channeling ![](/data/assets/guide/6a979f3121204210.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent.
team_comp_synergies: The best Tanks to have on your team are able to use damage mitigation to help you stay alive, or can follow up on your engages. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can give ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier to allow Anran to slip behind enemies, and safely attack without being CC'd. ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va can fly in with ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix and her burst damage for a coordinated dive assassination.

Since ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran lacks consistent pressure from her damage, she can also works well with heroes such as ![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)Soldier: 76 or ![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)Cassidy who can constantly apply poke pressure and can follow up on Anran's dive from range.

strengths.title: High survivability
content: High survivability thanks to mobility, dodge, and self-healing abilities. Although she has to play at closer ranges, her kit comes with plenty of tools to stay alive.

strengths.title: Good DoT and burst
content: Good combination of damage over time from burning, and burst damage from combos. While many heroes have one or the other, ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran has multiple methods of getting eliminations.

weaknesses.title: Short ranged
content: Needs to stay within the short range of her secondary fire to maintain high DPS output. Many heroes have the tools to make this a very difficult task. Against other highly mobile heroes, it can be difficult to chase. When the enemy is running longer ranged hitscans, getting into position is dangerous.

weaknesses.title: Difficult to play
content: Mechanically challenging. Requires the capability to quickly chain ability combos, track burning duration, and control quick rush speed.

weaknesses.title: Weak to Crowd Control

Other than a perfectly timed![](/data/assets/guide/b03c6c39b72fea97.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze, she's completely vulnerable to getting chain-stunned to death.
