Target her and finish her off when she tries to escape.

* Quickly target ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran during her ult. If she’s at low HP or takes a second to aim, you can eliminate her while she’s channeling ![](/data/assets/guide/6a979f3121204210.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent.

minor.title: Smoulder
content: * Extends the time of burning.

* Does **not** extend ![](/data/assets/guide/99e4dd776d3d372b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames amplified damage time.
* Useful for extending damage on enemies that retreat to cover. Will sometimes score an elim where the enemy could’ve just barely lived otherwise.
* Further delays the self-healing passive from activating.
minor.name: Smoulder
minor.description: Ignited enemies burn 1.5 seconds longer.

minor.title: Heat Shield
content: * Turns ![](/data/assets/guide/6a979f3121204210.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent into a survival tool. The large AoE makes it consistent and realistic to expect to hit multiple targets per use.
* Enables more aggressive use of your ult. Hitting 2 targets, for example, generates 150 overhealth.
* Use the overhealth generation mid-fight to as a form of healing, or at the start of an attack to make yourself more tanky.
* Recommended Minor Perk.
minor.name: Heat Shield
minor.description: Gain 50 overhealth when you use your Ultimate and for each enemy ignited by it.

major.title: Short Fuse
content: * Rushing through multiple targets in a scrambly fight is a great way to spread burning, inflict damage, and evade damage.
* Hitting the same target twice counts as double cooldown reduction (3s total).
* Be smart about where you position yourself when the Rush ends. You’d have to get 6 impacts to fully refresh the Rush if you don’t have either charge up.
major.name: Short Fuse
major.description: Impacting an enemy with Inferno Rush reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

major.title: Hungering Blaze
content: * Extremely potent survival ability.

* Being in range of multiple enemies is even more important when using Hungering Blaze. As mentioned under Ability Tips, ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran will stay invulnerable for longer and additionally heal herself more.
* Recommended Major Perk.
major.name: Hungering Blaze
major.description: Heal 50 health for each enemy hit by Dancing Blaze.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina performs best on maps with strong choke points and long hallways, such as **Havana**, **Junkertown**, and **Midtown**. These maps favor poke compositions, which Domina pairs well with and counters effectively thanks to her high barrier uptime and ranged attacks.
She struggles most with two types of maps. The first are those with very tight spaces, such as **New Junk City** and **Antarctic Peninsula**. While she can work with the right comps—provided you rotate and maintain optimal distance—it can be a significant struggle.
Maps with an abundance of high ground, such as **Watchpoint: Gibraltar** and **Numbani**, give her the most trouble. As stated under "Weaknesses" above, Domina struggles against high-mobility and dive heroes who thrive on these vertical layouts.

play_as: * Always play near cover. Peek out for the beam burst, and quickly hide between shots.

* Use your range to target DPS and ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports to get a quick elim or force them to retreat.
* Position around the perimeter of objectives so you can contest without getting surrounded.
play_against: * AoE and explosive damage can be used to destroy multiple barrier panels at once.
* Dive counters her playstyle. Overwhelm her by quickly getting behind her barrier.
* If a teammate gets imprisoned by her ult. Help them destroy the barrier from the outside.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina pairs well with heroes who need a large shield to stand behind while spamming ranged damage. Heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn, ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, and ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste share similar positioning strategies. Their poke pressure helps her control spacing and chip away at the enemy team's resources before they can fully approach. Since she lacks mobility, AoE and projectile healing provide the most consistent sustain.

strengths.title: Space and sightline control
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/921f50ca3ecba070.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-array.png)Barrier Array arc shape and segmented panels of health make it one of the best abilities in Overwatch for controlling sightlines. Allies are able to take wider angles behind the barrier and reposition as panels are broken. The enemy team generally won't be able to take out all panels. At chokes and in long narrow hallways map areas, ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina's barrier gives her team a huge advantage in the poke battle.

strengths.title: High damage from medium range
content: The burst damage and range of ![](/data/assets/guide/1f8db820974b857f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fphoton-magnum.png)Photon Magnum make her an extremely lethal threat at mid-range. The beam is the longest in the game, enabling her to play outside the optimal range of close-range enemies. Enemies positioned behind their Tank are often caught off guard by her deceptive range when she lands a crit with the explosion.

strengths.title: Fight-winning Ultimate
content: Many heroes lack the damage required to break through ![](/data/assets/guide/d21539d5998c3ac6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpanopticon.png)Panopticon before the barrier explodes. Unless their teammates break them out, catching a couple Supports with her Ult can secure the fight win all on its own.

weaknesses.title: Countered by shield buster
content: Team comps with heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion or ![](/data/assets/guide/2b23a0f925f80146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunkrat.png)Junkrat who excel at burning through barrier health leath ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina with very little counterplay. They can play outside her range, and take away her only form of safety.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to brawl Tanks
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina beats brawl Tanks by keeping her distance and controlling the spacing. When she's unable to do so, her only close-range tool is![](/data/assets/guide/2a769fd04e1536dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors knockback. One brawl Tanks like ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt and ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya get up close and personal, she quickly falls.

weaknesses.title: Weak against dive
content: With no mobility tools, ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina is unable to keep pace with high mobility dive heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)Winston, ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist and ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer. They can easily keep away from her, and she struggles to peel for her backline when they bypass her. Also, she offers little help to her own high mobility allies.

play_against_summary: * AoE and explosive damage can be used to destroy multiple barrier panels at once.
* Dive counters her playstyle. Overwhelm her by quickly getting behind her barrier.
* If a teammate gets imprisoned by her ult. Help them destroy the barrier from the outside.

minor.title: Efficient Design
content: * Best for defensive play.
* When using Efficient Design, always wait to take a bit of damage before deploying her barrier.
minor.name: Efficient Design
minor.description: After using Barrier Array, restore 50 shields and activate passive health regeneration.

minor.title: Extended Power
content: * Better for offense.
* Extending your primary fire by 5m is very powerful; do not underestimate the strength of this minor perk.

* After activating, experiment with the increased range. Keep rotating during fights, and abuse your superior range when battling ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks.

* Ignore the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank and use your Beam to Target squishy targets who think they are safe.
minor.name: Extended Power
minor.description: Increase the range of Photon Magnum by 20%.

major.title: Disruptive Detonation
content: * Aim to detonate ![](/data/assets/guide/a4c29a25893817ef.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcrystal-charge.png)Crystal Charge between two enemies to maximize the perk’s CC effect.

* Slow down the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank's approach, and hinder enemies trying to escape.
* Recommended Major Perk
major.name: Disruptive Detonation
major.description: Enemies hit by Crystal Charge's explosion are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.

major.title: Power Move
content: * Good to give ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina counterplay against melee heroes.

* Once the enemy is in melee range, first deploy barrier behind them, then use ![](/data/assets/guide/2a769fd04e1536dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors to wall slam them into your barrier.
* Power Move only causes barrier to act as a wall for Sonic wall slams. Enemies can still freely walk and move through it as usual.
major.name: Power Move
major.description: Barrier Array can be used as a wall to stun enemies with Sonic Repulsors with a 100% damage increase.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Emre performs best on maps with objective areas and sightlines that match his optimal range (e.g., Rialto, Nepal, Esperança). Ideally, he will play near Cyber Frag’s max range, where he can abuse the AoE damage paired with his rifle follow-up shots.
Smaller maps (e.g., Antarctic Peninsula, Oasis, New Junk City) feel cramped for Emre. Although he can get good value from grenades, he may struggle to utilize the rest of his kit effectively.
As long as he can maintain high ground, he performs decently on dive maps (e.g., Dorado, Watchpoint: Gibraltar), but he gets countered by dive heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va that are typically played on these maps.

play_as: * ADS as much as possible. Only unscope when there is no target, or when fighting at very close range.
* Keep yourself alive and don’t rely on Support healing. Use Siphon Blaster when you need healing.
* Throw Cyber Frag and quickly try to shoot the same target. Frag + headshot is his most lethal combo.
play_against: * If you don’t have good burst damage, try to escape during his Siphon Blaster, so you minimize how much life steal he can generate.
* Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.
* Listen for his Ult voice line, and prepare to shoot Emre out of the sky.
team_comp_synergies: Emre wants a frontline Tank who can set up and hold a position. Tanks like ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina and ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma are ideal choices, as their barriers protect him, and they have the damage and CC needed to help defend against aggressors.

Since he is fairly flexible as a DPS hero and has consistent output, he can pair with just about any other DPS. The main consideration is whether the other DPS is filling the same role (e.g., ![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn). If the enemy team is countering with dive or a barrier Tank, your team will lack counterplay.
For Supports, it is generally up to Emre to play within line of sight or healing range. Because he has some self-sustain, he can work with both high-healing and utility-based Supports.

strengths.title: **Good Medium to Long-Range Dueling**
content: Being able to hip fire and ADS his assault rifle gives him a decent amount of versatility in the ranges at which he is effective. ![](/data/assets/guide/7f0a804fdbeda034.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-emre.png)Take Aim (Emre) makes him very strong in medium to long-range duels.

strengths.title: **Fast Movement**
content: While he is not moving at the hyperspeed of ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)Jump Pack, Emre has the best ADS strafe speed in the game, and ![](/data/assets/guide/8bb0ce66b4fe8f61.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsiphon-blaster.png)Siphon Blaster gives him both vertical and horizontal mobility. He never has to sit still, making him a difficult target for the enemy team.

strengths.title: **Self-Sustain**
content: Self-sustain is a rare commodity in the DPS roster. Although the lifesteal from ![](/data/assets/guide/8bb0ce66b4fe8f61.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsiphon-blaster.png)Siphon Blaster is not an insane amount of burst healing, it can definitely keep Emre alive in 1v1s. Having movement paired with lifesteal makes Emre more self-sufficient and less reliant on team assistance.

weaknesses.title: **Vulnerable During Ultimate**
content: Floating around in the air during his ult makes him an easy target for enemy hitscans. Expect any enemy with anti-air capabilities to focus on taking him out before he can secure multiple kills.

weaknesses.title: **During Siphon Blaster, Damage Output Is Very Low**
content: Even though he needs it to survive, pulling out Siphon Blaster sacrifices a lot of damage. If his target is receiving healing, he struggles to secure the kill until he swaps back to his rifle or lands a direct hit with ![](/data/assets/guide/7432cc7ae0e02f92.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcyber-frag.png)Cyber Frag.

weaknesses.title: **Lags Behind in His Niche**
content: Emre competes with heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/29b626780c408560.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsoldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn, and ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe for the role of a mid to long-range hitscan on his team. These heroes all have well-rounded kits and high damage output. He can trade blows with Soldier, but compared to Sojourn and Ashe, it is difficult to justify picking Emre over them.

play_against_summary: * If you don’t have good burst damage, try to escape during his Siphon Blaster, so you minimize how much life steal he can generate.
* Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.
* Listen for his Ult voice line, and prepare to shoot Emre out of the sky.

minor.title: Suppressive Security
content: * Makes Emre’s Ult more lethal by making it easier to land follow-up Heavy shots.
* * Slow the enemy with light rounds, then finish them off with a heavy round.
* Enemies will be more hesitant to challenge your ult, thus making ulting a bit safer.
minor.name: Suppressive Security
minor.description: Override Protocol's light rounds slow enemies by 30% for 1 second.

minor.title: Enhanced Agility
content: * Decent for escaping and evading while Siphon Blaster cools off.
* Since the blaster is constantly overheating (without Heat Sink), you can take advantage of moments when you need to let it cool off.
* The 20% increase in movement speed, on top of the base movement buff, makes escaping feel more realistic.
minor.name: Enhanced Agility
minor.description: Siphon Blaster's movement speed bonus is increased by 20% while not firing.

major.title: Heat Sink
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* Fire more shots for more total time. Also results in greater life steal. If you are confident in aiming Siphon Blaster, this is a great Perk. Allows you to play more aggressively.
* Especially good for dueling, and for when Tanks are pressuring you (easier to land more shots on their large bodies).
major.name: Heat Sink
major.description: Direct hits with Siphon Blaster refund heat and increase its duration by 0.1 seconds.

major.title: Cyber Adhesion
content: * Transforms Cyber Frag into a cyber semtex.
* Sneak up on an enemy, throw the nade to stick, and immediately ADS headshot. You’ll delete DPS and Supports.
major.name: Cyber Adhesion
major.description: Cyber Frag now sticks on contact, dealing 40 extra damage to stuck enemies.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/5ecb2adb5abc123f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjetpack-cat.png)Jetpack Cat have plenty of vertical structures for her to fly around. High ground is especially strong since she can perma-fly. Numbani, Watchpoint: Gibraltar, and Paraiso, for example, all feature structural layouts that enable her to constantly reposition safely.
Flatter maps and those with wide open objective areas such as Samoa, Havana, and New Queen Street don't offer nearly as much room to play. On these maps, you'll typically need to position closer to your team and use them for safety.

play_as: * Fly outside of their range when faced against melee and close combat enemies such as Vendetta.
* Keep repositioning around vertical cover, walls, and structures to keep yourself out of enemy hitscan’s LoS.
* Target Tanks when going to environmental KOs with your ult. When there are no ledges, wait for an ally to use a high damage Ult like Death Blossom.
play_against: * Hitscan heroes are strong against Jetpack Cat. If they are giving you trouble, consider swapping.

* Jetpack Cat doesn’t generate a lot of sustain for their team. If your team has higher healing (Supports like Kiriko and Moira), you win team fights by slowly chipping away at their health while keeping your team alive.
* Immediately start shooting Jetpack Cat when they capture you or a teammate to stop them from getting an environmental KO.
team_comp_synergies: Jetpack Cat is extremely self-sufficient thanks to their combat ability, mobility, and self-sustain. Because of this, she doesn't need allies to sit around and protect her.

Heroes who can fly or move quickly are no problem to keep up with, so look for teammates like ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va, ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo, and ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer and be ready to ![](/data/assets/guide/5232ea25e34d2656.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffrenetic-flight.png)Frenetic Flight in to assist in their attacks.

For a second Support it depends on the rest of your team more than the specific pairing. If your team has a tank like ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga or ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt who demand a lot of healing resources, it's best to pair with someone like ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana or ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste.

However, if your team is running full dive or heroes with self-sustain, you can get away with pairing with a lower healing output Support like ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio or ![](/data/assets/guide/df34545acaf615da.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbrigitte.png)Brigitte.

strengths.title: Very Mobile
content: Extremely mobile. Only hero with permanent flying capabilities, and their boost is very fast, and refreshes quickly. Allows her follow up with teammates everywhere or escape defensively.

strengths.title: Transportation
content: Unique playmaking capabilities by transporting allies around the map. Flying ![](/data/assets/guide/4c3fdbb733566161.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeadeye.png)Deadeye, ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B., and ![](/data/assets/guide/5a0bd28ab2154772.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftactical-visor.png)Tactical Visor are just a few of the popular ways to combo ally abilities with ![](/data/assets/guide/7a678ebc365ae830.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Flifeline.png)Lifeline.

strengths.title: Versatility
content: Versatile and capable of both defensive and offensive playstyles. Her healing output is good when playing like a Support, but she's also one of the best solo-kill assassins in the game. Even after the nerfs, a Claws Out + Territorial will eliminate ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer without even firing a single shot.

weaknesses.title: Weak vs range
content: Weak against hitscans and long-range heroes. Anyone who can shoot Cat out of the air makes it difficult for her to utilize her best ability.

weaknesses.title: Ult is risky to use
content: Ult puts you at risk of being KO’d by enemies that were not knocked down. Even the enemy you grab can shoot and kill you after the stun ends.

weaknesses.title: Lacks a defensive ult
content: Whereas most Support heroes have an ultimate they can use to save their team from death, ![](/data/assets/guide/41958b3505632e51.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcatnapper.png)Catnapper can only be used offensively. Theoretically, she could use it to stun a solo aggressing enemy like an ulting ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji, but generally, she doesn't have a way to save her team from enemy ults.

play_against_summary: * Hitscan heroes are strong against Jetpack Cat. If they are giving you trouble, consider swapping.

* Jetpack Cat doesn’t generate a lot of sustain for their team. If your team has higher healing (Supports like Kiriko and Moira), you win team fights by slowly chipping away at their health while keeping your team alive.
* Immediately start shooting Jetpack Cat when they capture you or a teammate to stop them from getting an environmental KO.

minor.title: Ulterior Motive
content: * Refills fuel even during ![](/data/assets/guide/5232ea25e34d2656.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffrenetic-flight.png)Frenetic Flight.
* Significantly increases mobility and flight uptime when you are healing.
* Dealing Damage does not convert into fuel.
* Recommended default Minor Perk
minor.name: Ulterior Motive
minor.description: 15% of Biotic Pawjectiles healing is converted into fuel.

minor.title: Transport Shielding
content: * Best for strategic play-making. Allows you to take more damage while transporting an ally for a flank play. Also makes it safer to go for environmental KOs after your Ult.
* Recommended when playing with comms or frequently coordinating transport plays.
minor.name: Transport Shielding
minor.description: Gain up to 75 shield health while carrying another hero.

major.title: Headbutt
content: * Need to have almost half fuel and to travel ~8m to build enough momentum for the boop. (Displayed as VFX circling your screen)
* Works in transport mode
* Pair with Ulterior Motive for more frequent use.
major.name: Headbutt
major.description: Frenetic Flight can knockback an enemy on impact when flying fast enough.

major.title: Claws Out
content: * Best for consistent aggressive plays. If your team is using an aggressive closerange strategy such as brawl, rush or dive, having extra damage every 6-seconds on your melee is quite powerful.
* When your team is playing more distance or poke styles, you won’t have many opportunities to use Claws Out.
* Recommended Major Perk
major.name: Claws Out
major.description: Quick Melee becomes empowered every 6 seconds, wounding enemies for 40 damage and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
Maps that encourage close-range or brawly fights are the best for Mizuki to make full use of his kit (e.g., Oasis, Samoa, King's Row). Not only do these maps favor team comps he works well with, but they also allow him to get value from both his AoE healing and bouncing projectiles.
Long-range maps, such as Circuit Royal, and high-ground maps like Numbani are the two types of maps where ![](/data/assets/guide/90fbc15b3208bec3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmizuki.png)Mizuki will struggle the most. As long as he can stay with his team, he can make it work, but he'll often feel at a disadvantage compared to other heroes.

play_as: * Prioritize offense. Your healing is higher the more you deal damage.

* Save ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)Binding Chain to use on enemies that get past your Tank. Keep them trapped and secure the elim.

* Use ![](/data/assets/guide/d94973157497aac1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkekkai-sanctuary.png)Kekkai Sanctuary to protect and heal your team, and to counter projectile Ults such as Soujourn’s Overclock.
play_against: * Stay outside his effective range. His abilities are close to medium-ranged, so attack him from distances where he cannot coutner attack.
* His single-target healing is low; you can burst down his allies even when he’s trying to heal them.
* Go inside his ultimate and force his team out. If you have melee or beam abilities, you can penetrate the Sanctuary walls.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/90fbc15b3208bec3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmizuki.png)Mizuki has a hybrid kit that can adapt to multiple team comp styles. Ideally, he plays with rush comps where he can use ![](/data/assets/guide/7117e6d46ab75604.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkatashiro-return.png)Katashiro Return to push up aggressively with a Tank like ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)Junker Queen, then teleport back to safety.

Pairing him with a Support with high burst healing such as ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana makes for a great backline. They can use ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)Binding Chain and ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart to protect themselves, while her burst healing and ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade keeps the rest of their team alive.

strengths.title: Passive healing
content: Passive healing allows ![](/data/assets/guide/90fbc15b3208bec3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmizuki.png)Mizuki to focus on dealing damage and securing eliminations. He should be a strong source of damage for his team in every match.

strengths.title: Good CC
content: Powerful crowd control in ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)Binding Chain. It's like ![](/data/assets/guide/f60c62173ce6fce8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fflashbang.png)Flashbang and ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot rolled into one ability. Tethering any flanker will allow your team to get the kill unless the enemy team uses high value defense utility such as ![](/data/assets/guide/70bdaf439d6cdcdd.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Flife-grip.png)Life Grip or ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector.

strengths.title: Aggressive nature
content: Can play and position aggressively and has the tools to duel and keep himself alive. ![](/data/assets/guide/7117e6d46ab75604.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkatashiro-return.png)Katashiro Return is built specifically to go in, attack, and get out for free.

weaknesses.title: Ult is only good vs projectiles
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/d94973157497aac1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkekkai-sanctuary.png)Kekkai Sanctuary is only effective against projectile poke comps. Weak against dive and melee heroes. It also offers much less sustain than similar defensive ults.

weaknesses.title: Need to stick with team
content: Needs to stay positioned near allies to benefit from AoE healing. However, limited movement capabilities make it difficult to keep up with high-mobility allies.

If there's no ally nearby or in his LoS, he can't use ![](/data/assets/guide/215ca01bdeb99fbb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-kasa.png)Healing Kasa to heal himself.

weaknesses.title: Limited-range
content: Limited range combined with low-mobility means he is constantly in vulnerable to the enemy team making an aggressive play for him. He also has little counterplay against fliers.

play_against_summary: * Stay outside his effective range. His abilities are close to medium-ranged, so attack him from distances where he cannot coutner attack.
* His single-target healing is low; you can burst down his allies even when he’s trying to heal them.
* Go inside his ultimate and force his team out. If you have melee or beam abilities, you can penetrate the Sanctuary walls.

minor.title: Wellspring
content: * Helps keep your AoE healing higher and get it up sooner in fights.
* Good when your other Support lacks AoE healing.
minor.name: Wellspring
minor.description: Remedy Aura resource generation increased by 25%.

minor.title: Exposed Soul
content: * Considering enemies tethered by ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)Binding Chain can still attack you, it’s important to eliminate them as quickly as possible. Exposed Soul helps turn every successful chain into a KO.
* Best for duels and countering enemy dives.
minor.name: Exposed Soul
minor.description: Hitting an enemy with Binding Chain increases your damage dealt to them by 30% for 2 seconds.

major.title: Resonant Return
content: * To mazimize benefit of the extra bounce, try to use Healing Kasa when your team is positioned closely together.
* Good for increasing defensive capabilities.
* Best when you need to serve as the main source of your team’s sustain.
major.name: Resonant Return
major.description: Healing Kasa bounces one additional time. Each bounce increases its healing by 10.

major.title: Quickstep
content: * Best for rush and dive comps, as it enables a hyper-aggressive team initiation.
* Similar to Lucio’s speed aura, communicating with your team via VC, ping, or a voice line like “3-2-1” is important for coordinating ability timings.
* * The speedboost window is short, so your team will get more benefit if they are prepared, instead of having to react once they realize the speed aura is active.
major.name: Quickstep
major.description: While Katashiro Return is active, allies within Remedy Aura gain 25% increased movement speed.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](/data/assets/guide/52c34367e459b0af.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fvendetta.png)Vendetta is an versitile hero who can adapt her playstyle to most maps. The ones she'll struggle the most on are the traditional sniper maps like Circuit Royal and Havana. When playing these maps, take the extra time needed to path around the edges of the map and outside of the LoS of ranged enemies.
Her best maps have high ground she can set up on, drop down and engage without needing to use ![](/data/assets/guide/a4a69967a061e176.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsoaring-slice.png)Soaring Slice. Most maps have some areas where she can do this but Numbani and Watchpoint: Gibraltar are prime examples.

play_as: * Stage from off-angles and high ground to approach the enemy from angles they can’t see you coming.
* Prioritize high-value isolated targets, such as a Wuyang positioned behind the rest of his team.
* Use not only her block but also her mobility survive by evading enemy attacks.
play_against: * Maintain distance. Save your escape tool for when you see her use her sword toss dash. She can’t chase you if you reposition after.
* The moment she arrives, focus her. She won’t be able to escape for a few seconds, and that is your team’s best opportunity to punish her.
* Use crowd control to neutralize her. She can only try to dodge it as her shield does not absorb CC.
team_comp_synergies: Heroes who have a ranged protective utility such as ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier are the best for empowering ![](/data/assets/guide/52c34367e459b0af.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fvendetta.png)Vendetta to overrun a lobby. Dive in, receive the bubble, swing, kill, get out. This powerful gameplan is very difficult for the enemy team to deal with.

Additionally, she prefers consistent ranged healing from abilities such as ![](/data/assets/guide/8e97b1456138e53b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-rifle.png)Biotic Rifle and ![](/data/assets/guide/495517d449a60604.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-harmony.png)Orb of Harmony. When she has sustain from the team, she can take Extra Edge as her Minor Perk for increased projectile use.

strengths.title: Major advantage at close-range
content: Vendetta’s combos and mobility make her deadly in CQC duels. When she sticks to a target, her burst and sustained sword damage can overwhelm most heroes before they escape

strengths.title: Mobility and disruption
content: Abilities like Whirlwind Dash and Soaring Slice let her enter, reposition, or disengage quickly. This mobility makes her unpredictable and hard to pin down in brawls.

strengths.title: Snowballing
content: Her Onslaught passive increases movement and attack speed as she hits enemies. If the skirmish lasts for more than a few seconds, she becomes even more powerful, and her damage can overwhelm her target.

weaknesses.title: Extremely limited range
content: Vendetta struggles at long distances; ranged poke and hitscan harassment can peel targets before she gets within striking distance.

weaknesses.title: Glass cannon
content: Vendetta is as squishy as she is deadly. Misusing cooldowns or diving too many heroes at once will generally lead to her own death.

weaknesses.title: Vulnerable to crowd control
content: Her block does not stop CC, Sleep Dart, or stuns. Knockbacks can instantly shut down her engage if she already used her dashes and then gets booped while blocking.

play_against_summary: * Maintain distance. Save your escape tool for when you see her use her sword toss dash. She can’t chase you if you reposition after.
* The moment she arrives, focus her. She won’t be able to escape for a few seconds, and that is your team’s best opportunity to punish her.
* Use crowd control to neutralize her. She can only try to dodge it as her shield does not absorb CC.

minor.title: Raging Storm
content: no guide provided
perk: Raging Storm
minor.name: Raging Storm
minor.description: Whirlwind Dash continues to spin, hitting 3 more times for 30 damage in a wide area.

minor.title: Extra Edge
content: * The best tip for Extra Edge is to not use it.
* In theory, you can get an extra projectile in before recharging, but this is very low impact.
minor.name: Extra Edge
minor.description: Projected Edge costs 25% less energy.

major.title: Relentless
content: * Taking Relentless increases the Onslaught passive buffs from 25% attack speed up to 40%, and from 20% movement speed up to 32%.
* Incredibly strong when combined with Sihponning Strike, since you’ll be able to stay swinging for longer.
* Coordinate with your team because a pocketed Vendetta with full Relentless buff will feel unstoppable to the enemy team.
* Recommended Major perk
major.name: Relentless
major.description: Onslaught can stack 3 more times, increasing attack speed by 5% and movement speed by 4% per stack.

major.title: Siphoning Strike
content: no guide provided
perk: Siphoning Strike
major.name: Siphoning Strike
major.description: Overhead strikes gain 30% Lifesteal.

map_recommendations.maps_summary: The best maps for Freja complement her medium-long range positioning. She struggles one map areas with tight spaces and a lot of flat ground. Finding longer sight lines and high ground to set up on is the way Freja primarily wants to position on any map.

play_as: * Use Updraft to leap over walls and barriers, allowing you to attack enemies the rest of your team can't reach.
* Save at least one Quick Dash charge to dodge enemy flanks and dives.
* Focus on landing direct hits with Bola Shot to gain the Hindered and pull-in effects.
play_against: * Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
* If you see her use Updraft, know you have a 10-second window where she can’t target you behind cover or run away to high ground (unless she's using Rising Winds).
* Counter Freja by outranging her with a hitscan sniper, or overwhelming her with a close-range, high mobility hero.
team_comp_synergies: ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)Freja It is a hybrid character with short to long-range capabilities and good mobility. This allows her to adapt to most team comps.

Ideally, she has a strong frontline presence from a Tank like ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma or ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina, so she can position behind them and spam. These Tanks are also difficult for the enemy to bypass, so ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)Freja doesn't have to worry too much about getting rushed down.

For Supports, her favorite is a ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy pocket, but she works great with pretty much every Support. When using Aerial Recovery, she's less reliant on team sustain so she gets a lot of benefit from Support ulitility like ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade, ![](/data/assets/guide/47965eb66f5ed006.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord, and ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)Binding Chain.

strengths.title: High Mobility
content: Up to three charges of Quick Dash, vertical leap, and the float effect from Take Aim give Freja some of the best in-class mobility. The ability to dash, float, and leap synergizes well with her crossbow kit and allows her to take side angles, shoot over barriers, and disengage quickly.

strengths.title: Burst Damage
content: The explosive bolt from Take Aim deals 130 damage on a direct hit, and even without perks, Freja can fire three in a row with Dash refreshes. While she won’t always have the most consistent damage, when it matters most, she can burst down a single enemy very quickly.

strengths.title: Debuff Abilities
content: Her Minor Perk, Frost Bolts, applies a 20% slow debuff on targets and greatly helps to even the odds against high mobility enemies. Moreover, while it's not explicitly stated in the ability description, Bola Shot direct hits apply Hindered debuff to the enemy. Freja can use her ult to movement lock or cancel channeled abilities of an enemy and turn the tide of a fight in her team's favor.

weaknesses.title: Travel Projectile Sniper
content: Freja’s kit is best suited for medium to long-range combat. Landing shots with her primary and secondary fire at these longer ranges becomes more difficult because of the travel speed. She shares similar weaknesses to Hanzo, but trades the ability to one-shot for more consistent damage.

weaknesses.title: Situational Ultimate
content: Unlike many of the other DPS heroes, Freja’s ultimate isn’t typically going to win fights on its own. Bola Shot has good situational power and sets up her teammates for follow-up on the CC, but most often, she’s just hoping to get a single pick with each use.

weaknesses.title: Multiple ways to counter
content: Freja has weaknesses on both ends of the ranged spectrum. Close-range mobility heroes and long-range hitscans have favorable matchups against her. Whereas most heroes only have one easily exploitable range weakness, Freja gets countered by both types of heroes, so expect to always be playing into multiple counters.

play_against_summary: * Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
* If you see her use Updraft, know you have a 10-second window where she can’t target you behind cover or run away to high ground (unless she's using Rising Winds).
* Counter Freja by outranging her with a hitscan sniper, or overwhelming her with a close-range, high mobility hero.

minor.title: Relentless Barrage
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Significantly increases spam uptime. If you hit multiple direct hits in a row using the standard combo listed under ![](/data/assets/guide/3e91f745133fcd75.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) tips (6 primary fire > 1 Take Aim > repeat), you would have infinite ammo and never stop to reload.
minor.name: Relentless Barrage
minor.description: Direct hits with Take Aim refund 8 automatic bolt ammo.

minor.title: Momentum Boost
content: * Good use is as a counter pick against dive and melee heroes. The extra dash distance can give you the space needed to evade their attacks.

* Activating ![](/data/assets/guide/3e91f745133fcd75.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) mid-air still freezes Freja, which minimizes the benefit of this Perk.
minor.name: Momentum Boost
minor.description: Quick Dash distance is increased by 20%.

major.title: Aerial Recovery
content: * Recommended Minor Perk.

* Every time you jump and use ![](/data/assets/guide/af11f739171075dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fupdraft.png)Updraft + ![](/data/assets/guide/3e91f745133fcd75.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) slow, you'll heal for over 75 HP. Even more when used off a ledge.
major.name: Aerial Recovery
major.description: After using Updraft, heal for 30 health per second until Freja touches the ground.

major.title: Rising Winds
content: * Considering the long cooldown of ![](/data/assets/guide/af11f739171075dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fupdraft.png)Updraft, doubling its uptime is a considerable buff.
* * Best when playing maps with walls to jump and shoot over.
* Also good as a counterpick against melee and very close-range heroes
major.name: Rising Winds
major.description: Updraft gains an additional charge but has 20% reduced height.

map_recommendations.maps_summary:
![](/data/assets/guide/9f82e6ddaa52911f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwuyang.png)Wuyang has good horizontal and vertical mobility, long-range damage, and medium-range healing. These attributes allow him to adapt to most maps.
Regardless of the map, he wants to take advantage of his curving projectile to hit around corners, and jiggle peek cover to minimize his exposure to damage.
The maps he struggles most on are those with high ground areas that are outside his jump reach. Watchpoint: Gibraltar and Numbani, for example, have objective areas surrounded by high ground that Wuyang can't reach to contest or follow his team.

play_as: * Wait to use your Ult until you or your selected ally is right next to enemies, so it doesn’t expire before getting into attack range.
* Use Overflow to refill Wuyang’s healing resource while healing your Tank’s large health pool.
* Combine Guardian Wave with another Support’s AoE healing, such as Moira’s Biotic Orb.
play_against: * When you see the ![](/data/assets/guide/03b0e43c2c7db099.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fguardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave slam, back off, wait a few seconds, then hard re-engage to wipe his team because they won’t have burst healing.
* After you see him use Rushing Torrent (often to refill healing resources), immediately rush at him to eliminate Wuyang while he’s unable to escape.
* His Ult has a short 3.5s duration. Run away, use cover, and escape tools your hero has because it’s basically impossible to survive if you get caught.
team_comp_synergies: As a versatile Support, ![](/data/assets/guide/9f82e6ddaa52911f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwuyang.png)Wuyang can work with rush, dive, and poke team comps. He just needs to adapt his playstyle to fit his team. For example, on a dive team, make sure you have ![](/data/assets/guide/e2ee1807aea9c23a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frestorative-stream.png)Restorative Stream placed on the teammate playing most aggressively and taking up the enemy team's attention. To do this, you generally need to use ![](/data/assets/guide/821e6d2eeb6b1948.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frushing-torrent.png)Rushing Torrent to keep up with their movement and stay within healing range.

On the other hand, when playing on a poke-heavy team, you should primarily be saving ![](/data/assets/guide/821e6d2eeb6b1948.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frushing-torrent.png)Rushing Torrent as an escape tool to get away from enemy attacks, since you won't need it to keep up with your team's more stationary playstyle.

For Supports, try to play with a hero who has AoE healing like ![](/data/assets/guide/90fbc15b3208bec3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmizuki.png)Mizuki or ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio to make up for your single-target healing. Also, your team will get more benefit from ![](/data/assets/guide/03b0e43c2c7db099.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fguardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave's boosted healing when you hit multiple allies, and they are all being healed simultaneously by your other Support.

Just remember that if you are paired with an ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, healing boosts from ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenadeand ![](/data/assets/guide/03b0e43c2c7db099.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fguardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave do not stack. These are two extremely high-value cooldowns, and your team can't afford to waste them by layering them together.

strengths.title: Versatile Healing Options
content: Between ![](/data/assets/guide/e2ee1807aea9c23a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frestorative-stream.png)Restorative Stream’s passive and active modes, ![](/data/assets/guide/03b0e43c2c7db099.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fguardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave’s healing amplification, and Tidal Blast’s burst heal, Wuyang has plenty of options to choose from when teammates are under fire.

Additionally, ![](/data/assets/guide/e2ee1807aea9c23a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frestorative-stream.png)Restorative Stream is one of just a handful of healing abilities that can heal through barriers, giving him the advantage in many scenarios.

strengths.title: Consistent Ranged Pressure
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/9f82e6ddaa52911f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwuyang.png)Wuyang’s ranged damage is among the best in the Support class. Steering an orb blast to hit around corners is a unique strength that makes him a constant threat. While his damage potential is not quite as high as Zen’s, he offers much higher healing as a trade-off.

strengths.title: Fight Winning Ultimate
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/91b2239520de7052.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftidal-blast.png)Tidal Blast is one of the best Ults in the entire game. Overhealth, hard knockdown, burst healing all in one. Entire team fights can be won with just a well-timed Wuyang Ult.

weaknesses.title: Utility Focused Kit
content: Although this is technically one of his strengths, it’s also his weakness. To be a worthwhile pick, ![](/data/assets/guide/9f82e6ddaa52911f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwuyang.png)Wuyang players must be able to manage their resources, read fights, track enemy positions, and know when to use his high value cooldowns. His abilities are really easy to waste and cause your team to lose the game.

weaknesses.title: Tricky Aim Mechanics
content: All the time you’ve spent clicking heads with hitscans won’t help you much when steering water orbs across the map. To be consistent with curving shots around corners requires a decent amount of time dedicated to this unique mechanic.

weaknesses.title: Limited Escape Options
content: Unlike the original iteration of ![](/data/assets/guide/9f82e6ddaa52911f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwuyang.png)Wuyang, which was way overtuned and nearly impossible to dive, the current version is vulnerable to dive enemies. One of the main ways he keeps his Tank alive is by using ![](/data/assets/guide/821e6d2eeb6b1948.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frushing-torrent.png)Rushing Torrent with Overflow Perk to pump out more single-target healing. Doing this leaves him without an escape tool, so smart enemies will wait and punish him.

play_against_summary: * When you see the ![](/data/assets/guide/03b0e43c2c7db099.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fguardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave slam, back off, wait a few seconds, then hard re-engage to wipe his team because they won’t have burst healing.
* After you see him use Rushing Torrent (often to refill healing resources), immediately rush at him to eliminate Wuyang while he’s unable to escape.
* His Ult has a short 3.5s duration. Run away, use cover, and escape tools your hero has because it’s basically impossible to survive if you get caught.

minor.title: Overflow
content: * Grants the ability to give more burst healing to your allies, and less offensive downtime for yourself due to less time spent reloading.
* Recommended Minor Perk
minor.name: Overflow
minor.description: Gain 10 ammo and 50% healing resource when Rushing Torrent is activated.

minor.title: Balance
content: * Allows you to focus even more on dealing damage. As long as you keep hitting enemies, your selected ally will keep benefitting from increased healing.
minor.name: Balance
minor.description: When you deal damage with water orbs, increase Restorative Stream's passive healing by 30% for 2 seconds.

major.title: Ebb and Flow
content: * Not a terrible perk, but not worth taking over Falling Rain.
* May help with countering dive comps by improving your close-range capabilities.
* Try it out if you have been unable to get value out of your charged primary fire up to this point.
major.name: Ebb and Flow
major.description: Guardian Wave rewinds to its starting location. Has 50% less effectiveness while rewinding.

major.title: Falling Rain
content: * Very powerful for increasing total and burst damage.
* As soon as you unlock the Major Perk, you should start putting more emphasis on dealing damage.

* All the same tips from ![](/data/assets/guide/8fbe92ce7f53c900.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fxuanwu-staff.png)Xuanwu Staff apply as the use case does not change.
major.name: Falling Rain
major.description: Simultaneously control 3 water orbs that deal 60% decreased damage and have have 25% decreased empowered explosion radius.
